title: IT Project Manager
motivazione: Hai: Lead Generation, Analytics / KPI, Stakeholder C-level. Gap: Settore Luxury/Fashion, Settore Finance
testo_completo:
San Donato Milanese, Italy Italy San Donato Milanese, Italy Italy
Cerved è la tech company italiana che, grazie a segnali predittivi unici e a un patrimonio esclusivo di dati e analytics, supporta la crescita sostenibile, la gestione del rischio e la trasformazione digitale di imprese e istituzioni. Con Cerved Rating Agency, elaboriamo valutazioni sul merito di credito, rating ESG e analisi sulle emissioni di debito. Dal 2021 Cerved è parte di ION Group, uno dei più grandi operatori FinTech internazionali. Per Major1, business unit specializzata nello sviluppo e nell’evoluzione di soluzioni software per il mondo del credito e della gestione del rischio, siamo alla ricerca di un IT Project Manager da inserire all'interno del team. La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione e del coordinamento di progetti IT legati all'adozione e all'evoluzione dei prodotti Major1 presso clienti enterprise, garantendo il corretto presidio delle attività progettuali, il coordinamento dei diversi stakeholder coinvolti e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di qualità, tempi e costi. Collaborerà con team multidisciplinari interni ed esterni, contribuendo alla crescita e al consolidamento di soluzioni strategiche per il business. Cosa farai Gestirai e coordinerai progetti IT durante l'intero ciclo di vita, dalla fase di avvio fino alla chiusura del progetto. Pianificherai, monitorerai ed eseguirai progetti complessi, assicurando il rispetto delle scadenze, dei requisiti definiti e degli standard qualitativi attesi. Collaborerai con clienti, stakeholder di business e team tecnici per raccogliere esigenze, definire obiettivi progettuali e garantire il corretto avanzamento delle attività. Coordinerai team di sviluppo, infrastruttura e fornitori esterni, favorendo una collaborazione efficace e orientata al raggiungimento dei risultati. Presiederai le attività di gestione dei rischi di progetto, identificando criticità e definendo azioni correttive e preventive. Garantirai l'applicazione delle migliori pratiche di Project Management e delle policy aziendali durante tutte le fasi progettuali. Supporterai i clienti nella gestione delle problematiche tecniche relative ai prodotti Major1 adottati, coordinando le attività di analisi e risoluzione. Favorirai un contesto di lavoro collaborativo, facilitando la comunicazione tra i diversi stakeholder e contribuendo alla risoluzione di eventuali conflitti progettuali. Chi sei Hai maturato almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti IT complessi, preferibilmente in contesti software, fintech o servizi ad elevata componente tecnologica. Possiedi una solida conoscenza delle metodologie di Project Management e Service Management in contesti Lean e Agile. Hai esperienza nel coordinamento di team multidisciplinari e nella gestione di interlocutori sia tecnici sia di business. Sai pianificare attività progettuali, monitorare avanzamenti e gestire rischi, dipendenze e priorità in modo strutturato. Hai familiarità con strumenti di Agile Project Management come Jira, Trello o piattaforme analoghe. Sei in grado di analizzare problematiche complesse e individuare soluzioni efficaci con approccio pragmatico e orientato al risultato. Possiedi ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative e sai costruire relazioni di fiducia con clienti, stakeholder e team interni. Operi con autonomia, senso di responsabilità e forte orientamento alla qualità del servizio. Costituisce requisito preferenziale la conoscenza del linguaggio T-SQL. La sede di lavoro è San Donato Milanese (MI), con modalità di lavoro ibrida. La posizione è inquadrata 1 livello, secondo il CCNL Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi (Commercio) e il range retributivo iniziale previsto è compreso tra Euro 35.000 ed Euro 50.000. L'esatta attribuzione all'interno della fascia retributiva sarà determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi, trasparenti e neutrali sotto il profilo del genere (nel rispetto della normativa vigente). Cerved Group garantisce (ai sensi del D.Lgs 198/2006, D.Lgs.215/2003 e D.Lgs.216/2003) pari opportunità di accesso al lavoro a tutt* i/le candidat* e si impegna a favorire il rispetto delle diversità e l’inclusione sul posto di lavoro.

title: Field Business Developer
motivazione: Hai: HubSpot, CRM, B2B, Funnel / CRO (+1 altri). Gap: Salesforce. Non soddisfi: Salesforce richiesto
testo_completo: Milan, Italy Hybrid Field Business Developer About us Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. What you’ll be doing As our Field Business Developer, you’ll be the person who brings Satispay to independent merchants across Milan, owning your territory from the first knock to the signed deal. You’ll be on the front lines of our expansion, driving the adoption of Satispay’s solutions among independent merchants. You’ll work autonomously to hit and exceed ambitious sales targets. Here’s what your day-to-day will look like: Territory management & hunting - Analyse the Milan metropolitan area to find, target and win high-potential independent merchants. End-to-end sales cycle - Run the whole sales process on your own, from the first cold approach and product presentation to negotiation and closing. Pitching complex solutions - Explain the value of our business solutions clearly, tailoring your pitch to the needs of each merchant. Pipeline mastery - Keep your CRM spotless: log your daily activities, track your funnel, forecast your results and optimise your daily routes with data. Who we’re looking for We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you’re curious and ready for real ownership, you’ll fit in! Does this sound like you? Field sales experience - 3-5 years in B2B field sales to independent merchants, especially in hotels, restaurants and cafés (HoReCa) or local retail, selling either physical products or complex business services. Strategic & analytical approach - You can evaluate a territory, spot the best opportunities quickly and prioritise your daily hunting. Advanced commercial skills - You’re a natural negotiator with a consultative approach, able to break down and sell complex solutions to business owners. Autonomy & drive - You’re a self-starter who manages your own schedule, stays resilient under challenging targets and has a proven track record of overachieving. Local knowledge - You know Milan and speak the language of local business owners. CRM skills - You’re highly proficient with CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce) and digital tracking systems to manage leads and monitor your performance. Mobility - You hold a valid driving licence and own a vehicle to cover your territory in and around Milan. Languages - Full professional fluency in Italian and English (written and spoken). CareAbout: how we support your impact We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops) 💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you’re moving countries) ⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply) 🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours) 👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness) *We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. Initial salary: Starting from €30,000 gross per annum (+ variable) This baseline is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role’s core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value. testo_completo: Milan, Italy OnSite About us Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of. What you'll be doing As our Executive Assistant, you'll act as the primary facilitator for the executive daily operations. This is a high-visibility role requiring a gatekeeper mentality balanced with problem-solver execution. You will be responsible for the seamless coordination of the executive's professional life. Here's what that looks like in practice: Executive Calendar Management & Time Optimization – Proactively govern the complex calendars of multiple C-level executives, prioritizing high-impact engagements and safeguarding protected time for strategic focus and deep work. Meeting Governance & Executive Briefing – Deliver daily briefing packs, attend key meetings to document minutes, and ensure all action items are tracked and closed out across the executive leadership team. Global Travel & Logistics Coordination – Own end-to-end planning and execution of international travel and logistics, including conferences, roadshows, and external stakeholder engagements. Corporate Operations & Culture Enablement – Serve as Program Manager to drive alignment on company-wide milestones and deadlines, while orchestrating All-Hands meetings, team ceremonies, and recognition events that reinforce company culture. Executive Content & Materials Readiness – Partner with executives to ensure decks, data reports, and presentation materials are finalized and available at least 24 hours ahead of scheduled use. Administrative & Operational Excellence – Manage expense reporting, procurement requests, document management, and related operational processes to ensure efficient and compliant day-to-day business operations. Who we're looking for This role needs a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you? Proven Executive Support Experience – You have 3-5 years in a high-pressure support or operations role, ideally within scale-up tech, finance, or consultancy environments. Anticipation & Strategic Thinking – You have the ability to "see around corners"—solving conflicts or logistical issues before the executive even knows they exist. Tools & AI Proficiency – You have a mastery of Google Suite, Slack, and Notion, and you are proficient in using AI to optimize workflows. Strong Communication & Discretion – You are fluent in Italian and English and can maintain absolute confidentiality regarding sensitive financial or board-level data. Flexibility & Ownership – You have a "full flexible" approach, a willingness to go the extra mile, and are ready to be on-site as required to support the team. For this role, on-site presence in the office is required up to 5 days a week. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply. About Us: Let’s bring the Italian soul of chocolate to life! Since 1878, at Venchi we have celebrated chocolate in all its forms: from the authentic taste of our cocoa origins to the art of gelato. Today, we are a team of over 1,700 people across more than 200 stores worldwide, united by the same passion for quality and Italian excellence. At the heart of this journey are our values: Taste, Truth, Ingenuity, and Togetherness. They mean creating authentic experiences with care and precision; acting with transparency and responsibility; turning curiosity into impact through creativity and innovation; growing together by building trust and collaboration every day. Joining Venchi means embarking on an endless journey where tradition meets innovation, bringing quality, well-being, and the joy of positive indulgence around the world. Your Mission : We are looking for a highly motivated Wholesale Trade Marketing Manager to join our HQ in Milan! Reporting to the Global Senior Trade Marketing Manager, you will play a key role in translating our global marketing strategy into effective channel-specific plans and activations across Wholesale and Travel Retail, strengthening Venchi’s brand presence and supporting business growth across markets. Acting as a key partner for the Wholesale Team, you will develop and coordinate the wholesale marketing calendar across different sub-channels, including Traditional Trade, Distributors, Key Accounts and Travel Retail. You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product, Retail and Marketing teams to bring initiatives to life, from campaigns, promotions and assortments to merchandising, catalogues, events, pop-ups and in-store activations. The role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring that global brand guidelines are effectively adapted to different channels, customers and market needs while delivering a consistent and impactful Venchi experience. Key Responsibilities : Develop and coordinate the Wholesale marketing calendar and canvass, translating the global marketing strategy into channel-specific campaigns, promotional initiatives and commercial activations across Traditional Trade, Distributors, Key Accounts and Travel Retail. Define and roll out campaigns and promotional plans tailored to different Wholesale channels and key customers, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, commercial priorities and market needs. Partner with Sales and Finance on incentive programs, supporting the definition and implementation of incentive schemes for sales agents, distributors’ sales forces and Brand Ambassadors. Plan and coordinate Wholesale events and trade fairs, including buying events and key industry appointments, ensuring effective execution and a consistent Venchi brand presence across markets. Lead the development of channel-specific catalogues and trade marketing materials, working closely with Sales and Product teams to define product selection, content, layout and communication priorities. Design and coordinate pop-ups, in-store activations and promoter programs for Key Accounts and priority customers, managing their roll-out in collaboration with Sales, Finance and relevant external partners. Support assortment definition and channel performance analysis, leveraging sales data, best sellers and market insights to identify opportunities and inform commercial and marketing initiatives. Contribute to the definition of merchandising guidelines, tools and displays, developing solutions that strengthen brand visibility and ensure consistent execution across Wholesale touchpoints. The Ideal Candidate : At least 5 years of experience in Trade Marketing or Channel Marketing, preferably within FMCG, premium food, retail or consumer goods environments. Solid understanding of Wholesale channel dynamics, with exposure to one or more relevant channels such as Traditional Trade, Distributors, Key Accounts and Travel Retail. Proven experience in developing and executing trade marketing plans, including promotional campaigns, customer activations, merchandising and point-of-sale initiatives. Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret sales and channel performance and translate insights into actionable marketing plans. Hands-on project management skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple initiatives, stakeholders, markets and external partners while ensuring timely and effective execution. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Sales, Finance, Product and Marketing teams within an international environment. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, combined with a proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented approach. Fluent in English and Italian; knowledge of an additional language would be considered an advantage. … and of course a chocolate and gelato lover! What We Offer: Celebrate Success: Annual results-based bonus, with the option to convert it into welfare benefits. Flexibility and Balance: Benefit from flexible working hours and hybrid work options. Global Vision, Local Flavour: Join a passionate, creative team where innovation thrives. From our global HQ in the heart of the city, near our iconic stores, help bring the Venchi experience to life. Together, we craft excellence, from sourcing premium ingredients to delivering joyful moments worldwide. Exclusive Sweet Benefits: Enjoy a 30% discount in-store and 40% off our e-commerce platform. Plus, you will receive special gifts packed with Venchi’s finest chocolate. Benefit from tickets restaurant, access to two comprehensive welfare platforms, and additional private health insurance to enhance your personal well-being. Join us at Venchi and help us bringing the Italian way of life and delicious flavours to every corner of the world! We look forward to hearing from you! Market activation and capability Identify and scale best practices across Europe, agree rollout plans with clusters and share learning from local deployment Translate strategy and approved content into implementation requirements, scalable pilots and rollout plans tailored to market needs and readiness Build markets’ capability to plan, deliver and optimise HCP engagement, connecting European and global expert teams with marketing technology, SFE and media teams Measurement and optimisation Own performance tracking for key activities through a framework linking content and channel performance—including reach, acquisition, engagement and HHP metrics—with HCP recommendation outcomes Establish campaign analytics and test-and-learn standards. This role acts as the end‑to‑end product owner for BYD’s bus portfolio, serving as the primary interface between European operators, municipalities, HQ product teams, and regional commercial functions. The Senior Manager drives product definition, competitiveness, commercial offering, and lifecycle performance — from concept validation to launch and continuous improvement — ensuring that BYD buses meet market expectations, regulatory requirements, and outperform key competitors in the European public transport market. improvement — ensuring that BYD trucks meet market expectations and outperform key competitors. Reports to: The Head of Product Marketing Truck & Bus. Key responsibilities: Product Strategy & Roadmap: define and steer the European bus product strategy, ensuring alignment with operator needs, regulatory frameworks (EU TPL standards), and competitive benchmarks across citybus, intercity, and coach segments. Operator & Market Insight: integrate operator requirements, tender specifications, regulatory constraints, and market intelligence into product specifications and positioning. Competitive Positioning: shape the value proposition and differentiation vs. European OEMs, focusing on energy efficiency, TCO, passenger experience, and depot‑charging integration Go‑to‑Market Leadership: lead GTM strategy, launch governance, and cross‑functional readiness with sales, service, engineering, tenders team and HQ. Lifecycle Ownership: manage the full product lifecycle from introduction to phase‑out, ensuring continuous competitiveness, regulatory compliance, and commercial effectiveness. Commercial Enablement: ensure the bus portfolio is supported by strong sales tools, tender documentation, technical materials, and commercial catalogues. Main duties: Collect, validate, and structure operator requirements from public transport companies, municipalities, dealers, and key accounts. Translate market and regulatory needs into product specifications, technical targets, and configuration guidelines. Coordinate with HQ on product roadmap, homologation, safety standards, engineering changes, and technical development. Prepare product positioning documents, value proposition frameworks, and competitive benchmark analyses for citybus, intercity, and coach applications. Develop sales enablement tools: product sheets, tender documentation, technical files, catalogues, and training materials. Support pricing strategy, TCO modelling, and commercial offer definition (vehicle + charging + depot energy solutions). Lead launch readiness activities: product documentation, demo fleet planning, internal communication, GTM governance. Monitor product performance, operator satisfaction, and competitive landscape to identify improvement actions. Provide technical‑commercial support to regional sales teams, tender offices, and key account managers. Ensure compliance with European regulations, homologation requirements, safety standards, and market‑specific norms. Requirements & competencies: Technical Competences Strong product planning capabilities and understanding of EV systems (battery, powertrain, charging). Expertise in product marketing, positioning, and value proposition design. Solid knowledge of Go to Market strategy and launch management. Ability to translate customer requirements into actionable product specifications. Analytical mindset: market intelligence, competitor benchmarking, TCO modelling. Familiarity with European truck regulations, homologation processes, and fleet operational needs. Proven knowledge of bus products and the public transport business is a valued plus. Skills Cross‑functional leadership and stakeholder management (HQ, R&D, sales, service, tender offices). Excellent communication and ability to simplify complex technical topics. Structured and creative thinking, problem‑solving, analytical reasoning, and decision‑making. Customer‑centric mindset and strong business acumen. High ownership, accountability, and ability to operate in fast‑changing environments. Ability to work with teams from various countries and cultural backgrounds; positive attitude. Experience as Product or Sales Manager in the automotive field, preferably in Bus or Commercial Vehicles business. Engineering or Business‑related Bachelor’s degree. Excellent English and another European language. Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time. Segnala offerta di lavoro For our office in Legnano (Milan), within our Business Unit Personal Care, we are looking for a passionate Brand Manager for our TENA Brand , responsible for the Italian market. This opportunity is offered as a 12-month fixed-term contract , providing the opportunity to manage the brand across a full annual business and marketing cycle. About The Role As Brand Manager Continence Care, you will manage the implementation of the Marketing Strategy for the TENA Brand in Italy, ensuring delivery of sales and market share targets through effective execution and alignment with global guidelines. The role reports directly to the Marketing Manager IT, IB & CH. Working in an international and dynamic environment, you will have strong exposure to Sales, Customer Marketing and global stakeholders, contributing to the development of one of Essity’s key brands. What You Will Do Drive brand growth and profitable market share development, contributing to brand and business performance. Contribute to lead annual brand and marketing planning and manage A&P budget allocation, ensuring accuracy, efficiency and alignment with global strategy. Execute brand campaigns and product innovations, track performance and manage the product lifecycle, including phase-in and phase-out activities. Manage assortment, pricing and product strategy in collaboration with global and cross-functional teams. Analyse market performance and consumer/customer insights, including Nielsen data, translating findings into actionable business and marketing initiatives. Support the definition and execution of media plans, with a focus on digital and paid media effectiveness. Who You Are University Degree in Economics, Marketing or a related field. Around 4 years of experience in Brand Management or similar Marketing roles within an FMCG environment. Previous experience in a multinational environment is highly valued. Fluency in Italian and English is mandatory. Good experience in the development and execution of marketing plans. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret market data and turn insights into actions. Hands-on knowledge of Nielsen or similar market data tools, together with Excel, PowerPoint, and AI tools. Strong collaboration skills and previous exposure to Sales and Customer Marketing. Proactive, autonomous and comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. What We Can Offer You We offer a 12-month employment contract starting in January, with a gross annual salary starting from €36,000, in line with CCNL Carta Industria, Level B. The package also includes meal vouchers and an annual bonus. The role offers hybrid working, with up to two days of smart working per week. As the Legnano office is not easily accessible by public transport, having access to a car is recommended. Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-Being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment. At Essity, you'll feel valued, empowered to grow, and challenged to achieve business results in a collaborative and open atmosphere. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Humanitas Melania Mignano Melania Mignano Group Talent Acquisition e Employer Branding 📍 Sede di lavoro: Assago - Centro Direzionale 📄 Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo indeterminato - full time Perché Humanitas Scegliere Humanitas significa entrare in un contesto in cui la qualità della cura si costruisce ogni giorno attraverso competenza clinica, innovazione e lavoro di squadra dove ciascuno contribuisce al percorso di cura dei pazienti. Chi siamo Il Gruppo Humanitas, riferimento di eccellenza per la salute, la prevenzione e la diagnosi, è presente in Italia con 12 ospedali ad alta specializzazione, 25 Medical Care – la nostra rete di centri medici e punti prelievo, un Centro di Ricerca e Humanitas University, ateneo internazionale dedicato alle life sciences. Ogni anno, oltre 1.300.000 pazienti scelgono di affidarsi agli specialisti delle nostre strutture presenti in Lombardia, Piemonte e Sicilia. Il contesto All'interno della Direzione Digital, stiamo sviluppando un programma di trasformazione digitale con l'obiettivo di migliorare l'esperienza dei pazienti, ottimizzare i processi aziendali e introdurre nuove soluzioni basate sull'intelligenza artificiale e sull'automazione. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona che contribuisca allo sviluppo del CRM di Gruppo e alla gestione delle campagne di comunicazione, con l'obiettivo di rendere la relazione con i pazienti sempre più personalizzata, integrata e data-driven, nello specifico occupandosi di: CRM Strategy & Adoption: contribuire all'evoluzione del CRM e alla sua diffusione nelle diverse strutture del Gruppo, favorendo processi condivisi e best practice. Campaign Management: progettare, configurare e gestire campagne attraverso Salesforce Marketing Cloud, dalla definizione dei target all'analisi dei risultati. Patient Journey & Marketing Automation: sviluppare journey automatizzati e comunicazioni personalizzate lungo le diverse fasi del percorso del paziente, dalla prevenzione al follow-up. Performance & Optimization: monitorare i KPI delle campagne, analizzare i risultati e individuare opportunità di miglioramento. Stakeholder Management: collaborare con IT, Data & Analytics, Gestione Operativa, Customer Care, Operations e referenti delle diverse strutture per realizzare le iniziative CRM. La persona che cerchiamo ha un connubio di: Requisiti e competenze tecniche: Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Informatica, Matematica o discipline affini; 5–7 anni di esperienza in ambito CRM, campaign management o marketing automation; esperienza pratica e autonomia nell'utilizzo di Salesforce Marketing Cloud per la gestione di campagne e journey; esperienza nella progettazione di segmentazioni, campagne e comunicazioni personalizzate; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Attitudini e competenze comportamentali: Capacità di tradurre requisiti di business in specifiche funzionali e tecniche. Attitudine al problem solving e alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e di business. Capacità di analizzare KPI e dati per ottimizzare le performance delle iniziative. Esperienza nella gestione di progetti trasversali e nel coordinamento di stakeholder diversi. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di SQL, Salesforce Data Cloud e strumenti di Business Intelligence, oltre all'esperienza in ambito healthcare o in organizzazioni multisede. Cosa offriamo retribuzione fissa compresa in un range tra €47.000 - €55.000 lordi annui; compenso variabile compreso in un range tra €6.000 - €8.000; un programma di wellbeing che include anche iniziative dedicate alla salute fisica e psicologica; strumenti concreti per la conciliazione vita-lavoro, tra cui misure a sostegno della genitorialità e sostenibilità finanziaria; percorsi di formazione per valorizzare talenti e competenze in un contesto dinamico e innovativo. L'offerta è rivolta a candidati nel rispetto del Dlgs 198/2006 e dei Dlgs 215/2003 e 216/2003. Segnala offerta di lavoro Witailer ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Witailer. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 35.000,00 €/yr - 42.000,00 €/anno Witailer supporta brand e aziende nello sviluppo del business sui marketplace, combinando competenze di commerce, analisi dei dati e business intelligence. Nata nel 2017 come startup innovativa, Witailer è oggi un punto di riferimento per lo sviluppo di strategie di digital commerce e la gestione dei principali marketplace europei. All’interno dell’ecosistema di competenze di [Alkemy]+ – il brand di Alkemy Group che integra creatività, design, media e commerce –, Witailer supporta brand e aziende nella comprensione dello scenario competitivo e nella definizione di percorsi di crescita e consolidamento sui marketplace, con una focalizzazione particolare su Amazon. Attraverso strategie mirate, soluzioni software proprietarie e servizi di consulenza marketing dedicati, Witailer accompagna i brand nello sviluppo di una presenza più efficace, strutturata e misurabile nel commerce digitale Posizione: Abbiamo un’opportunità entusiasmante per entrare nel Team Advertising di Witailer , l’eccellenza italiana nella gestione e ottimizzazione dei marketplace. Nel ruolo di Digital Advertising Lead , avrai la possibilità di guidare la strategia pubblicitaria dei brand più innovativi, con un impatto diretto sui risultati di business dei nostri clienti e sullo sviluppo del team ADV. Se ti appassionano i dati, la strategia e la crescita continua — dei progetti ma anche delle persone — questa posizione è pensata per te. Il ruolo che ti aspetta: Come Digital Advertising Lead , sarai il riferimento per la definizione delle strategie media, l’analisi delle performance e la creazione di insight a supporto dei clienti e dei team interni. Ti occuperai di tradurre i dati di advertising in raccomandazioni strategiche, coordinare l’implementazione con gli Specialist e contribuire alla crescita complessiva delle competenze del team Advertising. Le tue principali responsabilità: Strategia e direzione ADV: Definire le strategie media omnicanale per i clienti, integrando logiche di Paid Search e Programmatic Display (incluso Amazon DSP). Tradurre le esigenze di business in piani di advertising misurabili e data-driven. Analisi e insight strategici: Analizzare i risultati delle campagne, individuare opportunità di crescita e costruire framework di analisi e raccomandazioni condivise con clienti e team. Fornire insight al management e contribuire alla definizione delle linee guida ADV aziendali. Gestione e ottimizzazione delle campagne: Supervisionare la pianificazione, l’esecuzione e l’ottimizzazione delle campagne su Amazon Advertising e piattaforme DSP, garantendo outcome concreti (ROAS, conversion rate, visibilità). Linee guida e knowledge sharing: Supportare la creazione e diffusione di best practice, processi e strumenti interni in collaborazione con gli altri Lead e Manager. Formare e affiancare gli Specialist nello sviluppo di competenze tecniche e analitiche. Budget e performance governance: Gestire budget e previsioni media; misurare l’efficacia delle azioni rispetto agli obiettivi strategici. Collaborazione cross-team: Collaborare con Data, Account e Operations per garantire coerenza strategica e allineamento sugli insight di performance e sulle raccomandazioni ai clienti. Chi cerchiamo: Non serve possedere tutto, ma queste caratteristiche ti permetteranno di esprimere il massimo potenziale nel ruolo: Formazione ed esperienza: laurea in discipline economiche o affini; almeno 3-4 anni di esperienza nel digital advertising o performance marketing. Competenze tecniche: esperienza comprovata in Paid Search, Amazon Ads o Display Programmatic; padronanza di Excel, PowerPoint/Google Slides e strumenti di analisi media. Approccio analitico: forte orientamento ai dati e capacità di tradurli in insight strategici utilizzabili dai clienti e dal team. Pensiero strategico e leadership collaborativa: sai unire visione e azione, favorendo coerenza, qualità e crescita nella community ADV interna. Competenze linguistiche: ottima conoscenza di italiano e inglese, per operare in un contesto internazionale. Jefferson Wells Italia ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Jefferson Wells Italia. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Livello retribuzione di base 80.000,00 €/yr - 90.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Jefferson Wells Italia Alessandro Chiara Alessandro Chiara HR Senior Consultant - Head Hunter - Sales & Marketing BRAND MANAGER – SALES PLANNING & NETWORK PERFORMANCE Jefferson Wells ricerca per primaria realtà del settore automotive Per conto di un'importante realtà operante nell'importazione e distribuzione di veicoli sul mercato italiano, siamo alla ricerca di un Brand Manager – Sales Planning & Network Performance. La figura avrà un ruolo chiave nel monitoraggio delle performance commerciali del brand, nel coordinamento della rete di vendita e nel supporto ai processi di pianificazione commerciale, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di crescita e sviluppo del business. Responsabilità principali Supportare la definizione e il monitoraggio dei piani commerciali a breve, medio e lungo termine. Analizzare l'andamento delle vendite, delle immatricolazioni e dei principali indicatori di performance, predisponendo reportistiche e analisi a supporto del management. Collaborare alla definizione di forecast, target commerciali e piani di sviluppo della rete. Monitorare le performance dei concessionari e delle strutture territoriali, individuando opportunità di miglioramento e azioni correttive. Coordinare e supportare gli Area Sales Manager nella realizzazione degli obiettivi assegnati. Garantire il corretto allineamento tra sede, rete di vendita e principali stakeholder aziendali. Collaborare con le funzioni Marketing, Finance, Operations e Network Development per assicurare la corretta implementazione delle iniziative commerciali. Raccogliere e analizzare dati di mercato, trend competitivi e feedback provenienti dalla rete, contribuendo ai processi decisionali e di business planning. Supportare il management nella definizione di iniziative finalizzate all'incremento di volumi, market share e redditività. Requisiti Laurea in Economia, Ingegneria Gestionale o discipline affini. Esperienza di almeno 7 anni maturata nel settore automotive all'interno di Case Auto, National Sales Company, importatori o realtà strutturate della distribuzione. Consolidata esperienza in ambito Sales Planning, Business Planning, Sales Operations, Network Development o Brand Management. Conoscenza approfondita delle logiche di forecasting, budget, KPI commerciali e performance management. Esperienza nel coordinamento di risorse field e nella gestione di reti di concessionari. Ottima capacità di analisi dati e utilizzo avanzato di Excel e strumenti di reporting. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Esperienza precedente con il ruolo di Area sales manager in una national sales company verrà considerata un plus. Completano il profilo Forte orientamento ai risultati e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali. Leadership e capacità di coordinamento di stakeholder interni ed esterni. Approccio pragmatico e orientato al business. Eccellenti capacità analitiche e decisionali. Spiccate doti relazionali e di comunicazione. Cosa offre l'azienda Inserimento in un contesto internazionale e in forte crescita. Ruolo ad elevata esposizione verso il top management. Concrete possibilità di sviluppo professionale. Pacchetto retributivo composto da: RAL compresa tra €80.000 e €90.000; sistema incentivante variabile; auto aziendale; Sede di lavoro Milano. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Kering Eyewear Greta Gazziola Greta Gazziola HR Business Partner at Kering Eyewear About us Kering Eyewear, part of the global Luxury group Kering, is the most relevant player in the Luxury Eyewear market segment. We design, develop, manufacture, and distribute eyewear that blends creativity, innovation, and quality. Our portfolio spans a wide range of iconic brands including Gucci, Cartier, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, McQueen, Valentino, Chloé, Alaïa, Montblanc, Dunhill, Puma, and our proprietary brands LINDBERG, Maui Jim, and Zeal Optics. By combining industry expertise with a commitment to sustainability, we help our brands redefine design and craft eyewear that captivates consumers worldwide. Your Opportunity You will be the technical heartbeat of our luxury Smart Glasses category, bridging the gap between luxury eyewear design and high-performance engineering. This role is a unique chance to introduce deep technical expertise — covering electronics, connectivity, and wearable systems — into a world-class design house. You will act as the primary translator between our engineering partners, our teams (design, marketing, commercial), ensuring that groundbreaking technology is not just functional, but market ready. Your mission is to own the technical product lifecycle, collaborating with a global Big Tech leader to build a category-defining wearable that feels as good as it performs. How You Will Contribute Bridge the Technical Gap: Serve as the internal expert on hardware specifications, connectivity protocols, and battery optimization to ensure tech features align with design and luxury standards. Master the Product Roadmap: participate in the management of the technical requirements for the Smart Glasses collection, translating complex specs into clear, marketable value propositions for consumers. Lead Technical Deployment: Partner with Technology Partners and Product teams to validate performance benchmarks, ensuring every feature, from AI integration to audio quality, is ready for global launch. Translate Tech to Story: Work closely with your peers in Marketing to transform "specs" into "benefits," ensuring our commercial teams and customers understand the magic behind technology. Analyze the Ecosystem: Stay ahead of the curve on emerging tech trends like AR components, miniaturized electronics, and firmware updates to keep our products at the edge of innovation. Drive Cross-Functional Excellence: Act as the technical point of contact for external tech partners, managing the integration of their hardware/software into our luxury frames. Who You Are You hold a degree in Business / Marketing / Engineering (Electronics, Telecommunications, or Computer Science) or a related technical field. An MBA or marketing background is a strong plus. Wearable Expert: 4+ years of experience in Product Marketing or Technical Product Management specifically within wearables, consumer electronics, or IoT. Deep Tech Literacy: You have a solid understanding of PCB design, wireless connectivity, sensor integration, and the challenges of miniaturizing electronics for the face. Translator: You possess the rare ability to explain complex technical architecture to a non-technical audience without losing nuance. Strategic Mindset: You do not just see parts; you see a product. You understand how technical decisions impact the final consumer experience and brand prestige. Global Collaborator: organized and capable of managing complex projects across different time zones and cultures. Fluent Communicator: Professional proficiency in English and Italian is required. Why work with us? This is an excellent opportunity to join the Kering adventure in a moment of extraordinary growth and become part of a thriving team in a global Luxury group that offers endless possibilities to learn and grow. Talent development is a managerial principle at Kering, and we are committed to fostering internal mobility. Our common vision promotes leadership skills and helps every employee to reach their full potential in a stimulating and fulfilling workplace environment. What we offer? Descrizione dell'azienda Publicis Groupe Fondata nel 1926 da Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet, Publicis Groupe è oggi il primo gruppo di comunicazione al mondo. Presente in Italia a Milano, Torino, Roma e Verona - con oltre 1.500 professionisti - il Gruppo agisce come partner strategico per la crescita dei propri clienti, offrendo un’ampia gamma di competenze e soluzioni integrate nelle aree della creatività, media, produzione e business transformation. Zenith , parte di Publicis Groupe Italia, è The ROI Agency - un posizionamento che adottiamo con orgoglio dal 2005. Nel tempo, abbiamo evoluto il significato stesso di ROI, adattandolo alla crescente complessità del panorama della comunicazione. Oggi, ROI non è solo Return on Investment, ma anche Return on Imagination: esperienze integrate e innovative che ispirano la crescita. Crescita per il business dei nostri clienti, crescita per le nostre persone, crescita per la nostra cultura. Publicis Groupe è l’unico player del settore capace di accompagnare i brand nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale, ovunque nel mondo. Panoramica La persona, inserita nel ruolo di Strategy Manager ha responsabilità diretta nella definizione di strategie media e communication per clienti assegnati, traducendo insight, dati, obiettivi di marca e priorità di business in framework strategici completi. Garantisce coerenza tra audience, positioning, canali, formati, journey, KPI e logiche di ottimizzazione. È responsabile della costruzione della strategia end-to-end su progetti complessi. Accountabilities Job Description: The Global PR & Communications Manager will work to strengthen MCM’s global visibility, reputation and desirability through an integrated communications strategy spanning PR, media relations, influencer engagement and paid media. They will drive brand awareness and cultural relevance across key markets through consistent storytelling and impactful earned, owned and paid media. The role requires a strong understanding of the evolving media landscape, including the application of Generative AI and Agentic AI to enhance media planning, execution, optimisation and measurement. Key Responsibilities Global PR & Communications Strategy Develop and execute global PR and communications strategies aligned with MCM’s brand positioning, business priorities and global marketing calendar. Define communication priorities, key narratives and media strategies across markets. Drive consistent brand storytelling and positioning across traditional, digital and emerging media channels. Identify opportunities to strengthen MCM’s cultural relevance, visibility and desirability. Media Relations & Earned Media Build and nurture relationships with key international media, editors, journalists, publications and relevant industry stakeholders. Oversee press releases, media briefings, interviews, press materials and editorial opportunities. Secure high-impact editorial coverage across fashion, luxury, lifestyle, business and relevant cultural media. Monitor earned media performance, quality of coverage, share of voice, reach and sentiment. Paid Media & Performance Integration Work closely with the global media and digital teams to integrate PR initiatives with paid media and performance strategies. Understand paid media ecosystems, including social advertising, digital publishers, programmatic media and sponsored editorial formats. Identify opportunities to amplify earned media, talent collaborations, launches and key brand moments through targeted paid investment. Leverage audience insights, segmentation and performance data to maximise media effectiveness. Monitor campaign performance and evaluate the contribution of media activities to awareness, engagement, traffic and brand consideration. AI & Agentic AI-Driven Media Innovation Demonstrate strong knowledge of Generative AI and emerging Agentic AI applications within marketing, communications and media advertising. Explore and implement AI-powered solutions for media planning, audience intelligence, campaign activation and performance optimisation. Understand the application of AI agents and automated workflows in media buying, bidding, budget allocation, audience targeting and campaign monitoring. Leverage AI-driven tools for media intelligence, social listening, competitive benchmarking, sentiment analysis and predictive insights. Explore AI-powered content generation, creative adaptation, personalisation and asset optimisation to increase campaign efficiency and relevance. Continuously identify and test emerging AI technologies to improve media effectiveness, operational efficiency and decision-making. Global Campaigns, Events & Stakeholder Management Lead PR and communications support for global launches, fashion moments, collaborations, events and key brand activations. Ensure alignment across global marketing, social media, talent, creative and regional teams. Coordinate with local PR agencies and media partners, ensuring consistency and quality of execution. Manage external agencies, budgets, timelines and deliverables. Measurement & Reporting Establish clear KPIs and reporting frameworks to measure communications effectiveness. Track media coverage, quality of exposure, share of voice, sentiment, reach, engagement and earned media value. Analyse the effectiveness of earned and paid media investments and identify opportunities for optimisation. Translate data and insights into actionable recommendations for the global marketing organisation. Requirements 7–10 years of experience in international PR, communications and media, preferably within luxury, fashion or premium consumer brands. Strong international media network and proven relationships with leading fashion and lifestyle publications. Solid understanding of the global paid media landscape, digital advertising platforms and performance marketing fundamentals. Experience working with media agencies, PR agencies and cross-functional international teams. Strong analytical capabilities and familiarity with media measurement, attribution and performance KPIs. Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of Generative AI, AI-powered marketing tools and emerging Agentic AI technologies, particularly in media advertising. Ability to translate technological innovation into practical applications that improve media effectiveness and operational efficiency. Excellent communication, project management and stakeholder management skills. Fluent English; additional languages are a plus. A strategically minded, digitally fluent and forward-thinking communications professional who combines strong PR fundamentals with a modern understanding of paid media, performance and emerging AI technologies. Someone curious, analytical and hands-on, able to challenge traditional communications models and help shape the next generation of integrated brand communications. Compensation: €50k–€60k Work Location/Arrangement: On-site, Full-time Working With Us With a highly collaborative workforce working from offices and stores around the world, MCM established a multinational/multicultural organization. To uphold the culture & value of MCM, we intend to fulfil our corporate social responsibility by implementing the following values and to comply with high degree of legitimacy and ethical standards. Our employees make the best efforts to become high-performing individuals who reflect the diversity of the communities in which we work and live. MCM’s commitment to diversity and inclusion includes recruiting and retaining employees from diverse backgrounds and experiences, creating awareness of diversity issues and benefits, and fostering a supportive environment where inclusivity is expected and prioritized. We have zero tolerance in any form of harassment, insultation, ostracization or groundless defamation of any other person. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Bozzetto Group Maria Chiara Lodovichi Maria Chiara Lodovichi Fondata nel 1919, Bozzetto Group è una realtà chimica italiana con sede a Filago (BG) e una presenza globale, con circa 700 dipendenti tra siti produttivi, laboratori e uffici commerciali nel mondo. Il Gruppo sviluppa e produce specialità chimiche avanzate destinate a diversi settori industriali, tra cui personal care, detergenza, tessile, edilizia, trattamento delle acque e agrochimica. Innovazione e sostenibilità guidano la nostra crescita: investiamo costantemente nel miglioramento delle performance dei nostri prodotti, nella riduzione dell’impatto ambientale e nella promozione di elevati standard di sicurezza e benessere per le nostre persone. Operiamo in un contesto internazionale, dinamico e diversificato, in cui competenze, culture ed esperienze differenti si incontrano, offrendo concrete opportunità di crescita e sviluppo professionale. Sede di lavoro: Filago (BG) Ruolo La risorsa sarà inserita nella Business Line Personal Care , riporterà al Business Line Manager Personal Care e avrà come riporto diretto il Personal Care Application Manager . Il Technical Marketing Manager – Personal Care avrà l’obiettivo di supportare lo sviluppo e la commercializzazione del portafoglio prodotti, mettendo le proprie competenze tecniche a disposizione di clienti, distributori e team commerciali. Avrà inoltre un ruolo attivo nello sviluppo della Business Line, contribuendo all’identificazione di nuove applicazioni, prodotti e opportunità di mercato e favorendo il collegamento tra esigenze commerciali, competenze tecniche e attività di innovazione. Principali responsabilità La persona selezionata si occuperà di: Fornire supporto tecnico a clienti, distributori e team commerciali sul portafoglio prodotti Personal Care. Predisporre report tecnici, presentazioni e documentazione a supporto delle attività commerciali e di sviluppo. Contribuire allo sviluppo e al posizionamento tecnico di nuovi prodotti e applicazioni, collaborando con R&D, Sales e Marketing e con i laboratori applicativi. Partecipare a incontri con clienti, presentazioni tecniche e dimostrazioni di prodotto. Rappresentare l’azienda in fiere, seminari, webinar e altri eventi di settore. Organizzare ed erogare attività di formazione tecnica rivolte ai team commerciali e ai distributori. Monitorare trend di mercato, nuove tecnologie, applicazioni emergenti e materie prime innovative. Raccogliere e analizzare le esigenze e i feedback di clienti e mercato, individuando nuove opportunità di sviluppo e traducendole in input per le funzioni interne. Requisiti Conoscenza avanzata di prodotti, formulazioni e applicazioni nel settore cosmetico. Conoscenza approfondita del mercato Personal Care e delle sue principali dinamiche. Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese. Disponibilità a trasferte per visite presso clienti, fiere ed eventi di settore. Costituisce titolo preferenziale una laurea in ambito scientifico e/o un Master o una specializzazione post-laurea in ambito cosmetico. La conoscenza della lingua francese e/o spagnola sarà considerata un plus. Competenze richieste Spiccate capacità di problem solving. Ottime capacità relazionali, comunicative e di presentazione. Capacità di collaborare efficacemente con clienti, colleghi e diverse funzioni aziendali. Ottime capacità organizzative e di gestione delle priorità. Forte orientamento al cliente e al risultato. Proattività, curiosità e orientamento all’innovazione. Capacità di operare efficacemente in un contesto internazionale e cross-funzionale. Processo di selezione Il processo di selezione prevede: Screening delle candidature. Colloquio telefonico conoscitivo con HR. Colloquio con HR e Hiring Manager. Eventuale colloquio di approfondimento. Definizione della proposta contrattuale. Inquadramento e retribuzione È previsto un pacchetto retributivo indicativamente compreso tra € 50.000 e € 60.000 di RAL , che sarà definito sulla base dell’esperienza maturata, delle competenze professionali e del livello di autonomia della persona selezionata. Pari opportunità e trasparenza retributiva Bozzetto Group promuove un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, fondato sui principi di pari opportunità, equità e non discriminazione. La ricerca è rivolta a tutte le persone qualificate, indipendentemente da genere, età, nazionalità, origine etnica, orientamento affettivo, convinzioni personali, disabilità o altre caratteristiche tutelate dalla normativa vigente. Durante il processo di selezione: non saranno richieste informazioni relative alle retribuzioni attuali o percepite in precedenti rapporti di lavoro; non saranno richieste informazioni personali non pertinenti alla valutazione professionale della candidatura, incluse quelle relative a stato civile, maternità, paternità, programmi familiari o altre informazioni riconducibili al genere; le candidature saranno valutate esclusivamente sulla base delle competenze, delle qualifiche professionali, dell’esperienza e dei requisiti previsti per la posizione. Bozzetto Group conduce le proprie procedure di ricerca e selezione del personale nel rispetto dei principi di parità di trattamento, non discriminazione e trasparenza retributiva , in conformità alla normativa vigente. Livello retribuzione di base 80.000,00 €/yr - 100.000,00 €/anno We are seeking a Head of Marketing & GTM to supercharge Treatwell's B2B and B2C growth in Europe. Reporting directly to the CMO, you will lead a core team of +10 marketers, combining analytical rigor and cross-functional leadership to drive business impact across 14 countries. This Role Carries a Dual Responsibility Global channel expansion: Drive global adoption and revenue generation by scaling new marketing channels, high-impact growth projects, and product launches across all markets. GTM execution: Own and lead the end-to-end Go-To-Market strategy, ensuring flawless, high-converting execution across Treatwell's 13 local operating countries. 💡 About Treatwell Hi, we're Treatwell. Nice to meet you. We're a team of 700 passionate and brilliantly talented people across Europe. We're the industry's smartest salon management software, all connected to Europe's leading bookings platform, working with over 95,000 salon partners across 14 countries, processing over 8 million bookings every month. And....breathe. But we're not done yet. We're on an exciting journey to digitally revolutionise the hair and beauty community. If this excites you, we might just have the role for you. 🧐 You Will Be Responsible For Growth & Impact: Own the marketing team's KPIs, driving data-informed decisions to maximize top-line growth and ROI. New Growth Channels: Test and scale new growth channels from Referrals to Partnerships and many others to be ideated and scaled to drive incremental growth (excluding the programmatic ones owned by Performance Marketing team) Key projects ownership: Own and ensure the seamless delivery and maximized impact of critical channels and projects (e.g., B2B Ambassadors, Sales enablement). Cross-channel Orchestration: Align all marketing channels - from performance to brand - to ensure narrative consistency and business impact. GTM Execution: Guarantee flawless execution of major GTM launches, key commercial projects (e.g., Referrals, Sales Enablement), and high-impact local campaigns. Cross-Functional Alignment: Collaborate seamlessly with Product, Product Marketing, and regional Market leads to align growth strategies. Requirements 🔝 About you: Tech Experience: 10+ years of Marketing experience in the Tech sector (mandatory). Marketplace background is a strong plus. Execution & Delivery Mindset: A strategic "doer" who pairs long-term vision with hands-on delivery. Agile & Data-Driven: Highly structured yet scrappy, with a proven ability to challenge the status quo through data-backed decisions. Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of influencing and aligning stakeholders across complex, international organizations. Languages: English fluency is mandatory. Any other European language is a plus. Hybrid set up: Available to work from the office, at least twice per week (Mon and Wed mandatory) (Via Carlo Farini 41, 20159, Milan) Benefits 💼 We'll treat you with: 28-days holiday, plus bank holidays 🏖️ Monthly £/€40 Treatwell vouchers so you can treat yourself too 💅🏻 Mental health support through our partnership with Open-Up 🧘🏻 Market-specific benefits ⚖️ Equal Opportunities Treatwell is an 'Open to All' employer and warmly welcomes everybody to the team. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Descrizione dell'azienda Publicis Groupe Fondata nel 1926 da Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet, Publicis Groupe è oggi il primo gruppo di comunicazione al mondo. Presente in Italia a Milano, Torino, Roma e Verona - con oltre 1.500 professionisti - il Gruppo agisce come partner strategico per la crescita dei propri clienti, offrendo un’ampia gamma di competenze e soluzioni integrate nelle aree della creatività, media, produzione e business transformation. Zenith , parte di Publicis Groupe Italia, è The ROI Agency - un posizionamento che adottiamo con orgoglio dal 2005. Nel tempo, abbiamo evoluto il significato stesso di ROI, adattandolo alla crescente complessità del panorama della comunicazione. Oggi, ROI non è solo Return on Investment, ma anche Return on Imagination: esperienze integrate e innovative che ispirano la crescita. Crescita per il business dei nostri clienti, crescita per le nostre persone, crescita per la nostra cultura. Publicis Groupe è l’unico player del settore capace di accompagnare i brand nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale, ovunque nel mondo. Panoramica La persona, inserita nel ruolo di Global Strategy Lead lavorerà per un importante cliente nel mondo luxury, guiderà la definizione e l’evoluzione della strategia media su cluster di clienti e aree di business complesse, assicurando l’integrazione tra obiettivi di marca, audience understanding, planning framework, touchpoint, dati e misurazione. Agisce come riferimento strategico e manageriale per il team, contribuendo alla costruzione di approcci scalabili, alla qualità metodologica della delivery e alla trasformazione delle raccomandazioni strategiche in opportunità concrete di crescita per i clienti. È responsabile non solo della qualità dei deliverable, ma della costruzione del modello di lavoro strategico nel tempo. Responsabilità Guidare la definizione di strategie media integrate per clienti complessi, collegando obiettivi di business, insight di audience, architettura dei canali e KPI di misurazione. Supervisionare progetti strategici multi-stakeholder, garantendo coerenza tra media strategy, digital planning, analytics, contenuti e attivazione. Definire framework strategici replicabili e scalabili, utili a consolidare metodo, qualità e consistenza della practice. Presidiare la relazione strategica con clienti senior, supportando discussioni su priorità di business, opportunità di crescita, innovazione media e ottimizzazione degli investimenti. Contribuire a new business, pitch e progettualità evolutive, trasformando insight e dati in raccomandazioni chiare, differenzianti e attivabili. Coordinare profili manageriali e specialistici, favorendo collaborazione tra team media, digital, analytics, content, account e creative. Promuovere l’integrazione nativa con le capability del Gruppo, includendo creatività, business transformation, PR, content, data e tecnologia nei principali percorsi strategici. Identificare opportunità di sviluppo su clienti esistenti, proponendo evoluzioni di approccio, modelli di planning e soluzioni più integrate. Garantire la qualità strategica e metodologica dei principali deliverable, assicurando solidità analitica, chiarezza narrativa e rilevanza per il business. Contribuire allo sviluppo delle competenze del team attraverso mentoring, condivisione di metodo e definizione di standard di lavoro. Qualifiche Esperienza in media strategy, communication planning, digital strategy o ruoli affini in contesti complessi. Segnala offerta di lavoro About Agoda At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world. Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. About Agoda Agoda helps people explore the world through accommodation, flight and travel bookings. Founded in 2005 and now a Booking Holdings company, we bring together more than 7,000 colleagues from 90 countries. Our culture combines technology, experimentation and creativity to make travel more accessible and rewarding. A bit about the Brand team Agoda’s Brand team brings together brand managers, media planners, project managers, designers and creatives. We shape how consumers, business partners and employees experience Agoda, building recognition and confidence in our brand. Working as an internal agency, we develop brand campaigns and marketing communications across digital channels and other brand touchpoints. This role connects our creative work with the everyday content customers discover, watch and engage with online. About the role We’re looking for a Japanese-speaking Social Media & Content Manager who combines strong agency management with hands-on social media expertise. Reporting to the Creative Manager, you will manage agency partners and execute a content programme that helps customers feel confident booking with Agoda. The programme spans creator content, product reviews, customer and partner testimonials, and practical product education videos. You’ll manage delivery from brief to publication, while personally executing the social calendar, writing captions and adapting content for Japanese audiences and different platforms. The ideal candidate You’re an experienced social media and content professional who combines creative judgement with strong organisation. You enjoy shaping content, giving agencies clear direction and seeing work through from the first brief to the published post. You might currently be a Social Media Manager or Senior Social Account Manager at an agency, managing consumer brands in Japan across several platforms. Alternatively, you could come from an in-house team where you manage external production partners and personally execute the social calendar. You bring around 3 - 5 years of relevant experience , supported by work examples that demonstrate your contribution and results. You speak and write Japanese fluently and understand the local social media landscape, cultural context and consumer expectations. You understand both what makes people watch and what makes content useful. You can turn a customer question into a clear video, adapt a message so it feels natural to a Japanese audience, and use platform knowledge and performance insights to improve the work. You’re proactive, comfortable expressing a creative opinion and dependable when managing deadlines and competing priorities. In this role you will get to Give agencies clear briefs . Turn business objectives into clear briefs, challenge ideas constructively and give specific feedback on scripts, edits and copy. Manage agency scopes of work, deliverables, timelines and budgets, ensuring work meets the brief and provides value for money. Know what makes social content work. Shape creator videos, product reviews and testimonials around Japanese audiences and the platforms they use. Consider the opening hook, length, subtitles, format and what will make someone keep watching or share it. Apply relevant cultural trends and platform developments to improve the work. Handle everyday execution confidently. Write and edit Japanese captions and calls to action, select relevant hashtags, coordinate content adaptations, manage approvals and execute the publishing calendar accurately and on time. Make product information interesting and useful. Understand customers’ needs, questions and concerns, and turn them into relevant content. Work with Product and customer service teams to create simple how-to videos covering important product features that are key in customer journeys. Learn from results . Use platform analytics to understand what holds attention, generates engagement and helps customers. Test different approaches and turn the findings into better briefs, content and publishing decisions. Keep people and projects aligned. Coordinate agencies, local market teams, Product, CEG, PR and Legal. Resolve conflicting feedback, secure approvals and flag delays early, ensuring content is accurate , locally relevant and delivered on schedule. What you will need to succeed Fluency in spoken and written Japanese , with the ability to write and review natural, engaging consumer-facing content. Previous professional experience delivering social media or content programmes for the Japanese market, with a strong understanding of local audiences, platforms and cultural nuances. Proven experience managing social channels and personally executing content calendars. Experience managing agencies or production partners, including scopes of work, briefs, feedback, budgets and deadlines. Strong copywriting and editing skills, with examples of Japanese captions, scripts or social content you have developed. A practical understanding of social platforms, their content formats, publishing tools and recommendation algorithms. Experience overseeing video production, from concept and scripting through editing, approvals and publication. The ability to translate customer needs and product information into clear, useful content. Familiarity with social analytics and the ability to use metrics such as reach, watch time, completion rates and engagement to improve content. Strong project management skills, attention to detail and confidence coordinating multiple stakeholders. It is great if you have Experience in travel, technology, e- commerce or another consumer-facing business. Experience with creator programmes , testimonials or product education content. Experience using tools such as CapCut or Canva to make simple video edits, add subtitles and adapt assets for different social formats. Familiarity with social listening and community management in Japan. Segnala offerta di lavoro Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us. At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us. THE ROLE The role: This is a 4-month maternity cover contract. If we have an open spot after the maternity cover and you loved your time at Foxelli, we'd be able to welcome you long term. What we're looking for: We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager (4-month maternity cover) who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role. This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in. You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people actually want to click, read, and buy from . If you love: mixing strategy with execution testing ideas improving funnels and making pretty things convert …and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person 👀 🚀 What You’ll Be Doing 🧠 Strategy & Growth Stuff Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes). Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities. Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps. Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns. Manage marketing projects from idea → launch → improvement. ✍️ Creative & Content Magic Write copy for ads, landing pages, and funnels that sounds human and sells. Review design work and give feedback so it looks on-brand and converts. Guide the creation and optimization of ad creatives with our design team. 🌐 Landing Pages & Website Optimization QA landing pages like a detective: checking UX, flow, and functionality. Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates. Work closely with developers to roll out website updates and improvements. 🤝 Team Glue (Cross-Functional Hero) Be the bridge between marketing, design, and development. Create clear briefs so everyone knows what to build and why. Track project progress and keep stakeholders in the loop. 🔍 Customer Research & Insights Collect and analyze customer feedback and data. Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. Use insights to scale sales and improve acquisition. 🤖 AI Tools & Smarter Execution Bring AI into our workflow as a competitive edge. Use GPT, image/video generators, and automation platforms to compress timelines, run more experiments, and beat our own ideas. 🧩 WHAT YOU BRING You’re probably someone who: Has experience as a Marketing Manager or full-stack marketer in e-commerce. Have hands-on experience building with AI tools - vibe coding, workflow automations, etc. Understands digital marketing and performance marketing deeply. Can write clear, persuasive, not-boring copy. Knows CRO and website optimization. Loves looking at data and asking: “What actually sells?” Is organized and good at managing projects. Has worked with designers and developers before. Can manage your own time and work remotely. Cares about customers and research. Gets excited about e-commerce growth. ✨ BONUS POINTS IF YOU: Have used marketing automation tools. Know your way around heatmaps, ad managers, and analytics tools. Enjoy experimenting, testing, and improving things nonstop. 🦊 WHY FOXELLI? We’re not into boring corporate marketing. We like: smart ideas quirky personality strong execution and people who take ownership You’ll have space to think, test, build, and grow with us - and actually see the impact of your work. THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space. Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together. FIXED SERVICE FEE €2,000 - €2,800 after taxes, depending on your skills, competencies, and experience. ❕Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement. Perks & Benefits Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Hubstaff ensures transparency and fairness. Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check. A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously. Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested. A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you. ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS ❕This role is 100% remote. Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported. For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy. (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.) Role Responsibility White‑Goods GTM Ownership End‑to‑end ownership of refrigerator and washing machine portfolio business for Italy market. Lead new‑product launch execution and deliver country‑level sales targets. Manage full product lifecycle from introduction, growth, maturity to end‑of‑life, and take accountability for country‑level volume performance, inventory turnover and category profitability. Product Roadmap & Localization Strategy Deeply understand local consumer behaviors, home‑appliance competitor landscape, and dynamics of offline KA retailers and e‑commerce channels. Submit market product requirements and category roadmaps to European HQ. Collaborate with HQ product team on SKU selection, local pricing and localized value‑proposition packaging, and deliver complete country‑specific new‑product launch playbooks. Sales & PSI Inventory Management Develop category sales forecasts, allocate stock, enforce stock & price discipline and maintain healthy omnichannel price integrity. Monitor PSI (Purchase‑Sales‑Inventory) metrics, flag inventory risks, drive slow‑moving SKU clearance to sustain solid inventory turnover, and align supply cadence for offline retail, operator channels, Amazon and local e‑commerce partners. Cross‑Functional Execution Partner with local sales, retail, marketing, after‑sales and supply‑chain planning teams to drive new‑product distribution, in‑store merchandising, sales associate enablement and campaign delivery. Translate European regional strategies into locally‑adapted execution, and build reusable operational playbooks for country‑level white‑goods business. Market & Competitive Intelligence Continuously track white‑goods market size, key competitors’ product portfolio, pricing, channel tactics and marketing initiatives. Produce regular business reviews and competitive analysis reports to iterate product and commercial strategies, and grow Xiaomi white‑goods market share in‑country. Risk & Project Management Act as project owner for new‑product launches, orchestrate end‑to‑end launch workflows and resolve bottlenecks for launch and sales operations. Align business with local home‑appliance compliance, energy‑efficiency standards and after‑sales installation service frameworks to ensure stable business operations. Proven track record of end‑to‑end overseas home‑appliance new‑product launches, with practical experience managing full product lifecycle for a single country. Profound expertise in PSI inventory governance, volume‑price control and country‑level category operation; capable of owning volume and profit KPIs independently. Fluent English for daily business communication; Italian is a plus. Comfortable working within matrix cross‑functional setups to drive projects between European HQ and local country teams. Strong data analytics and market‑insight capability: identify business opportunities and risks via data and formulate actionable country business strategies. Mature overseas business mindset with solid understanding of European home‑appliance consumer preferences and compliance requirements. Prior experience at Chinese home‑appliance OEM/brand expanding into Europe is preferred. Compensation: This is a local hire role. The gross annual salary is aligned with local market benchmark. Final offer will be determined based on candidate’s experience and competencies.
