Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Segment Strategy & Market Intelligence Analyze market trends, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and emerging technologies within the assigned segment. Identify growth opportunities, priority applications, and key use cases. Develop market assessments, business forecasts, and segment solution roadmaps. Define solution portfolio priorities and investment recommendations aligned with segment growth objectives. Solution Opportunity Management Gather, evaluate, and prioritize solution opportunities from regional teams, product groups, customers, and ecosystem partners. Collaborate with Application and Technology Architects to define solution concepts and assess technical feasibility. Own assigned solution opportunities from initial evaluation through commercialization. Drive alignment and execution across all stakeholders required to successfully deliver approved solution initiatives. Prioritize opportunities based on market potential, strategic value, business impact, and portfolio fit. Business Case Development Develop business cases and investment proposals for new system solutions. Assess market opportunity, revenue potential, costs, risks, and expected returns. Define solution success metrics and commercialization objectives. Develop investment recommendations and prioritization proposals for management approval Development Governance & Approval Prepare development approval packages and executive presentations. Drive alignment across Architecture, Engineering, Product Groups, Marketing, Sales, and Finance. Support management reviews and investment decision processes. Own execution readiness, ensuring resources, stakeholder commitments, and business objectives remain aligned throughout the approval process. Solution Development Leadership Oversee solution development from concept to launch. Represent customer and market requirements throughout the development lifecycle. Track progress against business objectives, milestones, and market requirements. Act as the business owner and execution leader for approved solution initiatives. Drive issue resolution, risk mitigation, and cross-functional decision making to maintain execution momentum. Escalate resource, priority, or execution risks when required to achieve approved business objectives. Go-to-Market & Commercialization Coordinate solution launch activities with Digital Marketing, Regional Solution Marketing, Product Groups, and Sales teams. Support development of value propositions, marketing collateral, demonstrations, and customer-facing materials. Monitor solution adoption, market impact, and launch effectiveness. Partner with regional teams and key customers to validate solution value propositions and commercialization plans. Monitor post-launch performance and drive corrective actions when business objectives are not achieved. Key Interfaces Internal Stakeholders Application Architects Technology Architects Product Groups Engineering Organizations Regional Solution Marketing Teams Digital Marketing Sales and Business Development Finance Executive Leadership Team External Stakeholders Customers Strategic Partners Technology Ecosystem Partners Industry Associations Research Institutions and Universities Qualifications Required Qualifications Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Business, Marketing, or related discipline. 8+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Segment Marketing, Product Management, Business Development, or Solution Management. Strong understanding of system-level solutions and technology-driven markets. Experience developing business cases and investment proposals. Demonstrated track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives from concept through commercialization. Ability to work effectively across global cross-functional organizations. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills. Critical Competencies Strategic Thinking Market Analysis Business Case Development Solution Portfolio Management Project / Program Management Technology and Application Understanding Cross-Functional Leadership Stakeholder Management Go-to-Market Strategy Commercial Acumen Executive Communication Success Metrics Segment growth and solution-related revenue Number and quality of approved solution investments Business case ROI achievement Solution adoption and design wins Time-to-market of solutions Portfolio health and strategic alignment Customer and stakeholder satisfaction Positioning Statement The Segment Strategy is the business owner of the segment solution portfolio, working alongside Application and Technology Architects, who provide the technical and architectural leadership, and alongside the Solution Marketing teams, who provide customer, market, and competitive insights. Together they form the core team responsible for identifying opportunities, defining solutions, securing investments, and delivering successful market launches.Triad Model Solution Marketing Market intelligence Customer insights Opportunity identification Regional requirements Commercialization support Segment Strategy Portfolio ownership Business case development Opportunity prioritization Cross-functional execution leadership Commercialization ownership Application Architects Customer requirements Solution definition System architecture Technology Architects Technology roadmap Platform strategy Innovation direction This structure tends to work very well in semiconductor system solution organizations because it balances market pull, application pull, and technology push. Segnala offerta di lavoro Social Media Manager About Us Founded in 2008, Negri Firman PR and Communication is an international communications agency offering innovative, tailor-made strategies to enhance brand awareness and reputation. With offices in Milan, London, New York, and Los Angeles, we provide integrated expertise across PR and media relations, digital communication, social media, influencer marketing, and event management, working with leading brands in the luxury and lifestyle sectors. Job Description Negri Firman is looking for an experienced Social Media Manager to collaborate with its Digital Team in Milan. The selected professional will be responsible for developing and implementing social media strategies for the agency's clients, overseeing editorial planning, content development, community management, paid social campaigns, and performance analysis. Responsibilities Develop and implement tailored social media strategies for assigned clients, and the Agency. Manage editorial calendars, content planning, copywriting, publishing, and community management. Coordinate with internal teams, clients, creative partners, and external stakeholders. Plan, manage, and optimize paid social media campaigns and advertising budgets. Monitor campaign performance, analyze KPIs, and prepare reports with actionable insights.·   Collaborate with the Global Creative Director and Digital Team to develop innovative and engaging campaigns. Research emerging platforms, trends, technologies, and digital opportunities to enhance clients' visibility and engagement. Ensure consistency with clients' brand positioning, communication objectives, and overall marketing strategies. Skills & Qualifications Minimum 5 years of professional experience in a similar role, either within a PR, communications or marketing agency, or in-house. Proven experience in social media strategy, content planning, and digital campaign management. Strong knowledge of major social media platforms, their algorithms, formats, and best practices. Proficiency in Meta Business Suite, Meta Ads Manager, social media management and analytics tools. Solid understanding of performance metrics, KPI analysis, ROI, and campaign optimisation. Company Description Publicis Groupe Founded in 1926 by Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet, Publicis Groupe is now the world's leading communications group. Present in Italy across Milan, Turin, Rome, and Verona—with more than 1,500 professionals—the Group acts as a strategic partner for its clients' growth, offering a broad range of integrated expertise and solutions spanning creativity, media, production, and business transformation. LePub is part of Publicis Groupe, the world’s third-largest communications group. What can we do as Publicis Groupe? Renowned worldwide for its creativity, best-in-class technology, digital capabilities, and consulting expertise, Publicis Groupe is the only player in the industry able to fully accompany clients throughout their digital business transformation journey—anywhere in the world. And what makes us unique? We are a Connecting Company , driven by a shared purpose, a strong spirit, common behaviors, distinctive character, and a relentless focus on our clients: the Power of One . About LePub You can either adapt to change, ignore it, or lead it. What will you choose? Our Mission We believe that today's world requires a combination of strategic, creative, and digital thinking capable of helping brands Lead the Change . The only constant in this world is change. You can either adapt to it, ignore it, or lead it. Lead the Change is both our mission and our call to action. It reflects our entrepreneurial spirit and our agency roots. It defines how we approach brands, ideas, and relationships, and it comes to life through the work we create every day. Publicis Groupe is the only player in the industry capable of supporting brands throughout their digital transformation journey, anywhere in the world. Overview We are looking for a Global Business Lead. the successful candidate will join the team and bring 15+ years of experience, ideally gained within an agency environment similar to LePub. Responsibilities Key Responsibilities: Lead and nurture senior client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner. Drive the development and delivery of integrated communication projects, ensuring excellence across all touchpoints. Oversee account profitability, growth opportunities, and long-term business development. Provide strategic guidance based on market trends, consumer insights, and competitive landscape analysis. Lead, mentor, and inspire cross-functional and account teams, fostering collaboration and high performance. Ensure seamless coordination between clients and internal teams, guaranteeing timely and high-quality delivery. Participate in business development activities, pitches, and client presentations to support agency growth. Champion the highest standards of client service, operational efficiency, and team performance. Qualifications Who you are: 15+ years of experience managing integrated communication campaigns within international advertising and creative agencies. Proven experience leading global and multi-market clients, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and driving business growth opportunities. A strong background in team leadership, mentoring, and developing high-performing account teams. Extensive experience overseeing complex projects, budgets, and account profitability. Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, international environments. A proactive, entrepreneurial, and solution-oriented mindset, combined with a genuine passion for communication and brand building. Professional fluency in English; knowledge of Italian is a plus. Additional Information We are committed to creating an environment where people can unlock their potential and build a long-term growth path. What We Offer Continuous Development Personalized learning and development opportunities available at every stage of your career. Growth Culture Challenging projects within a collaborative and innovation-driven environment. People Care Initiatives dedicated to physical and mental wellbeing, fostering a culture of collaboration, respect, and inclusion. Compensation Annual Gross Salary Range (RAL) €80,000 – €100,000 The salary range has been determined based on objective and neutral criteria, including role responsibilities, required competencies, organizational level, market benchmarks, and internal equity considerations. The indicated salary range is valid at the time of publication. The Company reserves the right to update it if necessary. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion This vacancy is open to candidates of any gender, age, and nationality, in compliance with applicable equal opportunities and anti-discrimination legislation. This job advertisement has been drafted in accordance with the principles of UNI/PdR 125:2022, the Italian standard for gender equality. Publicis Groupe's motto is “Viva La Différence.” We promote inclusive and non-discriminatory recruitment processes. Job titles, evaluation criteria, and language have been designed to be neutral and fully aligned with equal opportunity principles. If you have any specific requirements (for example, accessibility needs), please feel free to let us know during the initial contact. We are committed to ensuring a fair, inclusive, and accessible recruitment process for everyone. Segnala offerta di lavoro Job description: Scope of the Role Within the Global Commercial Operations & Execution Team, the Regional RX Commercial Operations Lead is accountable for accelerating the global development and in-market performance of the Prescription Medicines portfolio, working in close partnership with country organizations. The role acts as a senior Global–Local commercial leader, ensuring alignment with global brand and franchise strategies for strategic products, while enabling superior country planning, launch execution and sustained in-market performance. Covering established and innovative products across primary care, specialty care, hospital and rare disease segments, the role requires a deep understanding of local market dynamics, regulatory and market access environments, and complex stakeholder ecosystems, and plays a critical role in building long-term commercial capabilities across RX markets. What will you do Provide global commercial leadership to RX markets, working closely with Country General Managers and local RX leadership teams to drive performance, accountability and execution excellence across the portfolio Act as a senior strategic partner to country organizations, supporting and challenging country business plans, launch strategies and key commercial initiatives to ensure alignment with global priorities and local market realities Serve as the primary two-way Global–Local interface, translating global franchise, brand and go-to-market strategies into integrated, executable country plans, while channeling structured market insights, risks and opportunities back to Global teams Oversee ongoing execution and performance management across the RX portfolio, monitoring progress against agreed country plans, driving corrective actions where needed and ensuring disciplined, structured performance management across markets. Support launch excellence for strategic RX assets across countries, in line with global strategies, by providing senior oversight and hands-on support on launch readiness, sequencing, execution quality and post-launch optimization. Develop a deep, ground-level understanding of market dynamics, including competitive landscape, treatment paradigms, pricing & reimbursement environments and stakeholder needs (HCPs, payers, institutions), leveraging country insights to inform portfolio and lifecycle decisions Identify and address commercial capability gaps across countries, acting as an enabler for RX markets by developing targeted capability-building initiatives in partnership with Global Capability lead Represent country and regional needs towards Global Franchises and Corporate functions, influencing global strategy, investment prioritization and operating model choices based on real-world execution experience Partner with the Global Non-Strategic Portfolio PMO to identify, assess and prioritize opportunities within the non-strategic RX portfolio, supporting robust business case development with strong country input Champion innovation and continuous improvement, promoting best practice sharing across countries and driving initiatives to enhance commercial effectiveness, launch excellence and operational efficiency Who are you Professional Experience Minimum 12–15 years of progressive leadership experience within the pharmaceutical RX environment Proven success in senior commercial leadership roles (e.g. Business Unit Head, Country Commercial Head, Global or Regional Commercial Lead), with strong exposure to country-level execution Demonstrated executive-level P&L ownership, including strategic planning, performance delivery and resource prioritization Strong track record of multiple successful RX launches, ideally across different markets and therapeutic areas Solid experience operating in global matrix organizations, with the ability to influence and lead country teams without direct reporting lines Education Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business or related disciplines MBA or equivalent executive education strongly preferred Key Skills & Leadership Capabilities Deep understanding of RX commercial models and country-level execution dynamics, including regulatory frameworks, pricing & reimbursement and access complexity Ability to combine global strategic thinking with strong local market orientation Proven capability to lead, influence and align country leadership teams across geographies and cultures Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills, spanning Global Franchises, Local Leadership Teams and Corporate functions Strong financial and analytical acumen, leveraging qualitative and quantitative insights to guide decisions Expertise in brand strategy implementation, launch governance and execution monitoring Demonstrated ability to build sustainable commercial capabilities across Segnala offerta di lavoro Sanofi ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Sanofi. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 81.600,00 €/yr - 108.800,00 €/anno Job Title: National Commercial Lead Rare Hematology Mastocitosi Area di lavoro: Intero Territorio Nazionale Il nostro Team Sanofi è un'azienda della salute, innovativa e globale, guidata da una ragion d'essere: sfidare i confini della scienza per migliorare la vita delle persone. La Franchise Rare Diseases rappresenta uno degli ambiti più strategici e distintivi di Sanofi, in cui l'impegno verso i pazienti con bisogni terapeutici non soddisfatti si traduce in ricerca scientifica avanzata, innovazione terapeutica e presenza capillare sul territorio. All'interno di questa realtà, l'area Rare Hematology è focalizzata sulla Mastocitosi, una patologia rara e complessa, caratterizzata da un'elevata eterogeneità clinica e da un percorso diagnostico e terapeutico ancora oggi sfidante per la comunità medica. In questo contesto, la Franchise Rare Diseases è alla ricerca di un/una National Commercial Lead che guidi la performance commerciale nazionale per l'area terapeutica Mastocitosi, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di business in piena coerenza con la strategia Sanofi Rare Diseases, e che sappia guidare e far crescere un team sul campo capace di operare efficacemente in un contesto complesso e altamente specialistico. Responsabilità principali Riportando al Franchise Head Rare Diseases, avrà le seguenti responsabilità: Guidare la performance commerciale nazionale per l'area terapeutica Mastocitosi, assicurando il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di business. Tradurre la strategia di brand in piani di business nazionali e regionali concreti, identificando account prioritari, centri di eccellenza e stakeholder ad alto impatto, in collaborazione con la funzione Marketing. Monitorare le performance di business attraverso un'analisi data-driven, anticipando le dinamiche competitive e l'evoluzione del mercato per adattare proattivamente le tattiche commerciali. Coordinare il proprio team nelle fasi di pre-lancio e lancio, garantendo l'allineamento con la strategia di brand e i piani cross-funzionali, in collaborazione con le funzioni Market Access e Marketing. Sviluppare e implementare i piani di launch readiness, inclusi stakeholder mapping, formazione del team sul campo e prioritizzazione territoriale, monitorando i KPI di lancio e i segnali di performance per adattare rapidamente le tattiche commerciali. Collaborare in modo trasversale con Medical Affairs, Marketing e le altre funzioni aziendali per garantire la performance del brand e un'esecuzione di lancio di impatto. Guidare, far crescere e motivare il team, definendo obiettivi chiari e aspettative di performance in linea con la strategia nazionale. Garantire coaching, mentoring e sviluppo professionale continuo ai membri del team, attraverso visite sul campo, cicli di feedback e piani di sviluppo individuali, in un contesto terapeutico altamente specialistico. Promuovere una cultura di eccellenza scientifica, centralità del paziente e condotta etica all'interno del team. Profilo del candidato / della candidata Esperienza Esperienza professionale in ruoli commerciali nel settore farmaceutico; costituisce un requisito preferenziale un'esperienza nell'area delle malattie rare. Esperienza in ruoli di leadership manageriale o di guida di team di territorio. Un track record di successo, con elevati livelli di integrità, in ruoli sul campo. L'esperienza nel supporto o nella guida di lanci di prodotto è considerata un plus significativo. Competenze Tecniche e Soft Skills Conoscenza approfondita delle dinamiche del mercato delle malattie rare e del contesto commerciale, con particolare focus sull'area terapeutica di riferimento, e comprensione del contesto delle politiche sanitarie nazionali e regionali Solida conoscenza dei percorsi di gestione del paziente nei centri specialistici e multidisciplinari per le malattie rare Forti capacità analitiche: abilità nell'interpretare dati eterogenei per sviluppare piani di business efficaci nell'ambito delle malattie rare Eccellenti capacità comunicative e solide competenze di team management, formazione e coaching per team sul campo operanti in un contesto di malattie rare Provata capacità di guidare e coordinare iniziative di launch excellence in ambito specialistico o di malattie rare Forte attitudine alla collaborazione cross-funzionale e al lavoro in team con le diverse funzioni aziendali Formazione Laurea in discipline economiche o scientifiche. Lingue Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese (parlata e scritta). Pursue Progress, discover Extraordinary Il meglio è da scoprire. Migliori cure, migliori risultati, migliori scoperte scientifiche. Ma non può esserci progresso senza le persone – persone di diversa estrazione, di diverse origini, che svolgono ruoli differenti, tutte accomunate da un intento comune: il desiderio di far accadere ciò che è straordinario. Quindi, vogliamo essere quelle persone. In Sanofi offriamo pari opportunità a tutti indipendentemente da etnia, colore, discendenza, religione, sesso, nazionalità, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere. Guarda il video ALL IN e scopri le nostre azioni di Diversity, Equity & Inclusion su sanofi.com! Tutte le candidature verranno prese in considerazione senza alcuna discriminazione di sorta. Nell'ottica della massima inclusività e parità di merito, l'annuncio è aperto a candidature appartenenti a categorie protette o svantaggiate (L.68/99). Livello retribuzione di base 40.000,00 €/yr - 45.000,00 €/anno Vibram S.p.A. is an Italian multinational leader in the production and marketing of high-performance rubber soles, a symbol of innovation and design. In addition to the Italian Headquarters and its central offices in Milan, Vibram boasts international locations with production sites, research and development centers and representation in the United States, China, Japan and Brazil. Position The candidate will be responsible for defining, managing, and promoting the company’s historical heritage. They will coordinate the Vibram Heritage Archive and its dedicated resources, lead cultural, publishing, and exhibition projects, and develop special initiatives of high value to the brand, ensuring they align with the brand’s identity and values. The role operates within the Global Marketing team, working closely with Brand, PR, Digital, Product, and Design, as well as with the relevant corporate and regional functions. Main Responsibilities Heritage • Define, in line with the brand strategy, priorities, guidelines, and an annual plan for Heritage initiatives. • Develop the internal and external narrative of the company’s historical heritage, linking history, products, people, innovation, design, and corporate culture. • Ensure historical accuracy, narrative consistency, and the proper use of heritage materials, information, and assets in company projects. • Identify opportunities to promote the company’s heritage through cultural collaborations, exhibitions, publications, events, content, and special projects. Exhibitions, cultural and communication projects • Conceive, develop, and coordinate exhibitions, installations, publications, and other cultural projects related to the brand’s history. • Oversee the concept, selection of content and objects, storytelling, and coordination of exhibition design, in collaboration with specialized partners and suppliers. • Manage relationships with museums, foundations, cultural institutions, curators, designers, authors, researchers, and other external stakeholders. • Collaborate with PR, Social & Marketing, and other communications teams to integrate Heritage content into communications initiatives. • Coordinate loans and participation in national and international exhibitions, ensuring compliance with organizational, conservation, insurance, and logistical requirements. • Oversee the updating and enhancement of the company’s exhibition spaces. • Manage and coordinate external consultants and their contracts. Governance and Development of the Heritage Archive • Oversee the management, cataloging, preservation, digitization, and development of the physical historical archive at HQ in Albizzate (VA) and the digital archive. • Coordinate historical research, the acquisition of new materials, and the collection of testimonies, ensuring the archive’s progressive completeness, including corporate archives in other countries such as the U.S. and Japan. • Define priorities, standards, and processes for the collection, classification, documentation, and accessibility of documents, images, products, prototypes, and other historical materials. • Coordinate and support a Heritage & Archive Specialist, defining their priorities, objectives, and operating procedures. This position reports to the Global Marketing Director. Requirements • Bachelor’s degree in the humanities, cultural heritage, archival science, museology, communication, marketing, design, or related fields. • 5–7 years of experience managing heritage, cultural, exhibition, publishing, communication, or brand experience projects. • Strong project management skills, including the planning and management of budgets, timelines, priorities, and deliverables. • Experience coordinating resources, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders, with people management skills and a collaborative leadership style. • Ability to develop concepts, storytelling, and content consistent with the brand’s identity, history, and positioning. • Experience managing exhibitions, installations, events, publications, and complex cultural projects, with an appreciation for art, design, and product culture. • Excellent research, writing, summarization, and presentation skills, combined with precision, attention to detail, and cultural sensitivity. • Knowledge of integrated communication processes, including PR, social media, and digital marketing. • Strategic vision, proactivity, and autonomy, with the ability to transform historical heritage into contemporary value for the brand and a strong results-oriented mindset. • Excellent command of written and spoken English (C1), and the ability to work in international, multicultural, and cross-functional environments. Knowledge of additional languages is a plus. • A passion for the mountains and outdoor sports. Availability • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally (at least two intercontinental trips per year are expected). Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Condé Nast Rajul Lal Rajul Lal Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business. Job Description Location: Milano, MI The Role Condé Nast Italia is looking for a Head of Project Management with solid experience in the Creative Project Management of Digital, Social and Experiential assets. Having a line report to the Condé Nast Commercial Creative Director, the successful candidate will be responsible for leading, motivating and developing the CNCC Italy Project Management team and directly managing the most important projects, including cross-platform and multi-client projects. The person will play a key role both in the pre-sale phase, supporting the Brand Marketing and Sales teams in defining project planning and sustainability, and in the post-sale phase, with full responsibility for the execution, production, profitability and final quality of custom and tentpole projects (content, video, social media, events). They will be the main internal and external point of reference for all delivery activities, ensuring alignment between the sold project and the delivered outcome. Primary Responsibilities Lead all execution and delivery activities for cross-platform commercial projects, including video productions, advertorials and branded content, social media & editorial campaign assets, events and in-event activations Define and manage the project by collecting and defining all the information necessary to complete the project plan, including activities, timeline and project planning (deliverables, milestones, deadlines, approval steps) Manage the internal Project Management team (5 people) and coordinate external teams (2 People) supporting the projects Supervise the exchange of information and approvals with the Editorial team Identify, share, and manage project risks Manage all suppliers involved in the project (journalists, videographers, photographers, technical suppliers) Maintain the interactions with clients and internal teams during all post-sale phases of projects Complete supervision of production budgets and timelines, with direct responsibility for project P&L Support to the Brand Marketing team in the preparation of final reports and case studies (custom and tentpole) Ensure constant qualitative and quantitative alignment between commercial proposals and final deliverables Primary Skills & Qualifications 7+ years of professional experience as a Lead Project Manager, Head of Project Management or Senior Project Manager in Media Companies, Creative Agencies, Event Management Companies or similar contexts Proven experience in end-to-end production of creative and cross-platform content (videos, advertorials, branded content, social media campaigns, events, and in-event activations) Professional working fluency in Italian and English, written and spoken Experience in direct client management and supervision of productions, shoots, and events Experience in team management, or proven strong and solution-oriented leadership attitude Solid budgeting skills, P&L management, and project margin monitoring Commercial mindset and ability to mediate between editorial, creative, and commercial requirements Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills Academic Degree in Marketing, Communication or Segnala offerta di lavoro The Role.. As the Membership Manager (MM) you will be responsible for curating and growing the Cities Without Houses (CWH) Membership across select cities across Europe. Your main focus will be recruiting new members and retaining existing ones while delivering a seamless exceptional member experience. You will work closely with local committees, build strong relationships with key creative communities and ensure that Soho House values and brand are reflected in every member interaction. As the MM you will oversee all aspects of the member experience from inductions through to events and communications. You will also be the day to day contact for your members managing member enquiries while being Soho Houses eyes and ears on the ground. As the MM you will need to be highly social and content media savvy, with an ability to ideate and execute mini campaigns with measurable positive impact delivering the conversion of leads to new members. You will report into the Head of Membership, ensuring membership targets are achieved and that the overall member experience is consistently high quality, friendly and memorable. This role is a highly autonomous role and you are accountable for managing your time, achieving your goals and meeting members expectations. Therefore, although you will have help through your colleagues, such as an event producer and Member Liaison, success will largely be down to you. Key Responsibilities.. Recruitment & retention Drive regional membership recruitment, expanding Soho House's network specifically across select cities throughout Milan and Italy. Leveraging your existing network in the creative industries to attract high-profile members from sectors such as film, art, fashion, media, and tech. Develop and execute strategies to meet quarterly membership targets, ensuring that the member base is diverse, inclusive, and reflective of the cities' creative communities. Oversee and be responsible for the recruitment and management of liaisons in your cities, setting them objectives and managing their performance Committees & Local Leadership Build, grow, and motivate local membership committees, ensuring they reflect Soho House's diversity and inclusion pledge. Foster relationships with committee members to ensure active participation in the membership process and support the recruitment of high-caliber new members. Member Experience & Events Curate the attendance of members and prospects to engaging activity and impactful events, working with Event Producer to ensure that every experience delivers the unique "Soho House magic" and promotes member engagement. Ensure that new members feel welcomed and integrated into the Soho House community, managing their onboarding process and hosting introductions as necessary. Communications, social and content Media Execute a communications plan that keeps members informed, engaged, and excited about the offerings in your region. Partner with membership leaders to create content and manage internal communications to deliver a seamless experience. Build relationships with regional Press and people of influence. Drive Mini Content media campaigns that drive signups. Local Outreach & Networking Conduct significant outreach within the creative communities across Milan and Munich to establish key contacts, connectors, and opinion leaders. Build strong relationships with local creative groups and individuals to promote Soho House and drive brand awareness. Membership Quality & Admin Review membership applications to ensure all new members meet the high standards expected of Soho House. Oversee membership administration, ensuring all internal processes are followed, and manage member data through CRM systems such as Salesforce. Member Behaviour & Support Handle member concerns and behavioural issues, making difficult calls when necessary, and documenting the outcomes in line with Soho House policies. Local Intel & Market Awareness Continuously gather insights on the local creative scenes, including trends, challenges, and opportunities. Stay informed about the social and cultural landscape across cities to ensure Soho House stays relevant and competitive. Collaboration with Wider Membership Team Participate in international membership calls, meetings, and brainstorms to share best practices and ideas. Work closely with Soho House teams across events, marketing, and content to ensure consistent member engagement and a high-quality member experience. Brand Ambassador Represent Soho House globally, embodying the brand's core values, ethos, and commitment to fostering creativity, diversity, and inclusion. Experience Required.. Minimum of 4+ years' relative experience with a proven track record of leading a professional, efficient, high quality, service-oriented operation 3+ years Management experience Milan based and native speaking Italian Strong Network: Established network of contacts across Milan, Italy and Europe. Entrepreneurial Mindset: Self-motivated, driven, and able to work independently to deliver results. Content Media and Social Media Savvy: A proven ability to ideate and deliver mini campaigns. Excellent Communication Skills: Strong written skills for marketing content, member communications, and event copy. High emotionally intelligence supporting difficult conversations. Highly Organised: Capable of managing multiple tasks, prioritising workload, and overseeing team performance across the region. Commercial Acumen: Understanding of how to balance membership targets with quality engagement. Charismatic & Creative: A confident, engaging personality with a passion for creative industries such as fashion, art, music, and film. Event Experience: Prior experience in programming or producing events (or a willingness to collaborate closely with an events producer). Diversity & Inclusion Advocate: A commitment to fostering diversity and inclusion in line with Soho House's global pledge and values. Proficient in Technology: Familiarity with Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, Trello, or similar systems. Flexible and Adaptable: Willingness to travel frequently within your region and work flexible hours, including late nights and weekends. Who we are At OPENLANE , we make wholesale easy so our customers can be more successful. We're a technology company, building the world's most advanced - and simple - digital marketplace for used vehicles. We're a data company, helping customers buy and sell smarter with clear, actionable insights they can understand and use. And we're an innovative company accelerating the future of wholesale remarketing through curiosity, collaboration, and an entrepreneurial spirit. OPENLANE offers its customers the best digital marketplace for used cars in Europe. Our B2B clients enjoy operational excellence when working with us. Our Values Driven Waybuilders: We pursue challenges that inspire us to build, create and innovate. Relentless Curiosity: We seek to understand and improve our customers' experience. Smart Risk-Taking: We transform risk into progress through data, experience, and intuition. Fearless Ownership: We deliver what we promise and learn along the way What are we looking for? Do you have a strong commercial mindset, a sharp analytical eye and a passion for driving business performance? OPENLANE Europe is looking for an experienced Head of Commercial Excellence who understands what drives commercial success and knows how to translate insights into measurable results. With operations across more than 20 countries, we're looking for someone who sees the bigger picture, understands the dynamics of different markets and recognizes opportunities to improve. Someone who enjoys working closely with commercial teams, bringing fresh perspectives and helping turn business insights into better decisions. As our Head of Commercial Excellence, you'll have the opportunity to build and shape this function from the ground up . Working alongside country managers and senior leadership, you'll play an important role in strengthening commercial decision-making and driving performance across our European organization. What will you do? Segnala offerta di lavoro Claire Joster | People first ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Claire Joster | People first. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 60.000,00 €/yr - 70.000,00 €/anno Tipi di retribuzione aggiuntivi Bonus annuale Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Claire Joster | People first Sergio De Stasio Sergio De Stasio Vertical Leader Italia Life Sciences, Sales&Marketing, ICT and Finance | HR | Tax&Legal presso Claire Joster | People first Claire Joster , per conto di una realtà internazionale in forte evoluzione, specializzata in Digital Advertising, Media Strategy e Performance Marketing, siamo alla ricerca di un Sales Director / Chief Revenue Officer che assuma un ruolo strategico nello sviluppo del business sul mercato italiano. L’azienda opera come partner consulenziale di importanti brand nazionali e internazionali, integrando competenze in media planning, performance marketing, data analytics e soluzioni tecnologiche innovative. La figura ricercata avrà l’opportunità di guidare una nuova fase di crescita, contribuendo direttamente alla definizione della strategia commerciale, allo sviluppo di clienti ad alto potenziale e all’evoluzione del posizionamento competitivo dell’organizzazione. Un’opportunità per un leader commerciale con visione imprenditoriale, capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, innovazione e costruzione di un’organizzazione commerciale ad alte prestazioni. Il ruolo A diretto riporto del General Manager Italia, la risorsa avrà la responsabilità di definire e implementare la strategia di crescita commerciale, con particolare attenzione all’acquisizione di nuovi clienti, allo sviluppo delle partnership esistenti e alla generazione di ricavi profittevoli. Sarà chiamata a operare con ampia autonomia strategica e organizzativa, guidando il team commerciale e contribuendo all’evoluzione dell’offerta attraverso l’integrazione di soluzioni Media, Performance e Programmatic Advertising. Principali responsabilità | Business Development & Revenue Growth • Definire e implementare la strategia commerciale sul mercato italiano, in coerenza con gli obiettivi di crescita del gruppo. • Identificare nuove opportunità di business presso brand di medio-grandi dimensioni, sviluppando relazioni dirette con CMO, Marketing Director e decision maker. • Gestire personalmente le trattative strategiche e le opportunità commerciali a maggiore valore. • Promuovere strategie di upselling e cross selling, valorizzando l’intero portafoglio di servizi. • Presidiare gli obiettivi di marginalità, pricing e sostenibilità economica delle iniziative commerciali. Sales Strategy & Team Leadership • Guidare, sviluppare e organizzare il team commerciale, definendo ruoli, responsabilità e obiettivi. • Strutturare processi di vendita efficaci, introducendo metodologie condivise di gestione della pipeline, forecasting e reporting. • Definire KPI commerciali e sistemi incentivanti orientati alla crescita sostenibile. • Favorire una cultura commerciale basata su accountability, collaborazione e orientamento ai risultati. Market Development & Innovation. • Contribuire all’evoluzione del posizionamento aziendale attraverso lo sviluppo di un’offerta integrata di Digital Media, Performance e Programmatic Advertising. • Supportare l’acquisizione e lo sviluppo di clienti enterprise con investimenti media significativi. • Collaborare con i team Operations, Marketing e con le strutture internazionali per costruire proposte commerciali innovative e ad alto valore aggiunto. • Valorizzare l’utilizzo di dati, tecnologie e AI come elementi distintivi della proposta commerciale. Il profilo ideale Desideriamo incontrare professionisti con una solida esperienza nello sviluppo commerciale nel settore Digital Advertising, capaci di combinare competenze strategiche, leadership e una forte attitudine al new business. Requisiti principali • Esperienza consolidata, idealmente di almeno 10 anni, nel mondo Digital Advertising, Media Agency, AdTech o Performance Marketing. • Almeno 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione e nello sviluppo di team commerciali. • Track record significativo nell’acquisizione diretta di brand di medio-grandi dimensioni e nella gestione di trattative complesse. • Conoscenza approfondita dell’ecosistema Digital Media, con competenze trasversali in Performance Marketing, Brand Awareness e Programmatic Advertising. • Esperienza nella costruzione di strategie commerciali, processi di vendita e modelli di crescita orientati alla marginalità. • Network consolidato di relazioni con CMO, Marketing Director e responsabili degli investimenti pubblicitari. • Familiarità con CRM, strumenti di sales forecasting e analisi delle performance commerciali. • Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo • Leadership autorevole, collaborativa e orientata allo sviluppo delle persone. • Approccio imprenditoriale e capacità di operare in contesti dinamici e in trasformazione. • Forte orientamento al risultato, unito a sensibilità economica e visione strategica. • Attitudine hands-on, con disponibilità a gestire direttamente clienti e negoziazioni. • Curiosità verso l’innovazione tecnologica e le nuove frontiere dell’AI applicata al marketing. Cosa offre l’azienda • Ruolo strategico e ad alta visibilità, con impatto diretto sulle scelte di sviluppo del business italiano. • Ampia autonomia nella definizione della strategia e nell’organizzazione della funzione commerciale. • Opportunità di contribuire all’evoluzione dell’offerta e al consolidamento del posizionamento su clienti enterprise. • Contesto internazionale, dinamico e imprenditoriale, con accesso a competenze e soluzioni tecnologiche innovative. Modalità di lavoro Full Remote, con trasferte sul territorio nazionale e occasionalmente all’estero. Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato, inquadramento Quadro CCNL Commercio, piano incentivi. About this Job Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid – 3 days/week in the office, 2 remote) Type: Full-time – with a clear path to Head of Marketing About Flottando Company cars are boring. We need someone crazy enough to make them exciting. 🚗 At Flottando we build AI software for corporate fleets. That means invoices, multe, fringe benefits, contract renewals and the Excel files that HR, Procurement and Finance trade back and forth every month. Hundreds of Italian companies already use us, and many of them are happy to tell their story. Now we need someone to go out and tell it, loudly. The role Let's be honest about this role. There's no marketing team waiting for you, no agency, no big budget and no brand guidelines. There's you, a laptop, a small and hungry founding team, and a product customers love. You'll write the post, film the video, book the guest, run the webinar, set up the event booth, send the follow-ups, and check on Monday whether any of it turned into pipeline. Then you'll do it again, better. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the best job ever, keep reading. Where this goes 🚀 You start as our first marketer. As Flottando grows in Italy and expands into Europe, you grow with it: you'll hire the team, own the budget and become our Head of Marketing. We're not hiring someone to fill a seat. We're looking for the person who will lead marketing here. What you will do • Call happy customers and turn them into case studies, videos and LinkedIn posts, starting in week one • Run our social channels yourself: writing, filming, editing, posting • Organize webinars and events from scratch, including topic, speakers, promotion, hosting and follow-up • Generate leads, hand them to sales, and track what becomes revenue • Launch our new AI products and make people understand why they matter • Do our employer branding so great people want to join us • Test, measure, kill what doesn't work and double down on what does • Challenge the founders. The CEO sets the strategy, and you push back when the data says otherwise Here's an example. In a demo, a fleet manager says she used to spend three days a month building cost reports in Excel. You hear it. You call her, record a 60-second video, turn it into a LinkedIn post, build a webinar around it, and check two weeks later how many demos it brought in. That's the mindset we're looking for. Who we are looking for You're probably a great fit if: • You're hands-on: you've done the work yourself, not just managed others doing it • You love startups: chaos, speed and building from zero excite you • You're entrepreneurial: you don't wait for a brief, a budget or permission. You ship • You're analytical: you care about leads and revenue, not likes • You're a strong communicator in writing, on camera and on stage • You're creative enough to make fleet management fun (yes, really) • You're high-energy and positive. People leave a call with you smiling Requirements • At least 1 year of hands-on experience in digital marketing with B2B SaaS products • Strong expertise in content marketing, SEO and GEO (getting found on Google and in AI answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity) • Strong experience with HubSpot: workflows, lead tracking, reporting • Native Italian, fluent in English • Bonus: experience at an early-stage startup or scale-up What we offer • RAL: 25k–38k EUR based on experience • A clear path to Head of Marketing, earned by results rather than seniority • Huge ownership from day one • A direct line to the founders, with no layers in between • AI at the foundation of our product, not as a buzzword • The chance to help build Italy's leading fleet platform and take it to Europe • A hybrid setup, with 3 days per week in our Milan office Hiring process We like to keep things simple, fast, and transparent. 01. Intro Call – 30 minutes Meet one of the founders. We'll talk about your motivation, what you've built so far, and what you're looking for. 02. Practical Case A short, real challenge: show us how you'd make Flottando impossible to ignore in the next 60-90 days from day 1 u join us. 03. Final Interview – 45 minutes: Walk us through your case with the CEO and the team. 04. Offer We aim to complete the process within 2–6 weeks. One last thing: We can teach you fleets, fringe benefits and how fines management work. What we're really looking for is harder to teach: Hunger. Ownership. Creativity. And the instinct to ship. If you read this and thought "finally, a job where I can just build," we'd love to meet you. Join Flottando and help us make fleet management exciting. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Data pubblicazione: 16 nov 2026 Città: Lombardia Paese/Regione: IT Tipo di contratto: Permanent Richiesta lavoro ID: 13355 AREA MANAGER_LOMBARDIA Servier è un gruppo farmaceutico indipendente, governato da una Fondazione e presente in oltre 130 Paesi, che coniuga la leadership mondiale in cardiologia con l’Ambizione 2030 di guidare l’innovazione in oncologia e neurologia. Ponendo il paziente al centro di ogni progresso scientifico e terapeutico, sviluppa soluzioni mirate per rispondere alle sfide mediche del futuro. Con oltre 50 anni di storia in Italia e la gestione di Malta, Servier Italia rappresenta un’eccellenza con 360 dipendenti e 221 milioni di euro di ricavi (2025/26), risultando la terza filiale in Europa e la sesta al mondo per fatturato. Per la nostra Business Unit CMVD (Cardiovascolare e Metabolica), siamo alla ricerca di un/una Area Manager che opererà sul territorio della Lombardia . In questo ruolo, la risorsa riporterà direttamente al Sales Director e avrà la responsabilità della gestione diretta di un team di Informatori Scientifici del Farmaco (ISF). L'obiettivo principale della posizione sarà quello di contribuire al raggiungimento degli obiettivi della Business Unit attraverso l'efficace implementazione delle strategie di informazione scientifica e la promozione dei prodotti nel territorio assegnato. La missione include: Guidare, sviluppare e supportare il team di Informatori Scientifici del Farmaco, promuovendo una cultura orientata ai risultati, alla compliance, alla qualità dell'informazione scientifica e al miglioramento continuo. Garantire la creazione di valore verso gli stakeholder e la costruzione di partnership di lungo periodo interpretando le evoluzioni del mercato per offrire soluzioni che rispondano a bisogni complessi e posizionando l'azienda come un consulente di fiducia. Garantire che tutte le attività svolte nell'area di competenza siano coerenti con le strategie aziendali, i valori dell'organizzazione, le normative vigenti e le procedure interne. Responsabilità e Attività: Pianificazione e Organizzazione: Contribuire alla definizione degli obiettivi e dei piani d'azione territoriali in coerenza con la strategia aziendale e con le priorità della Business Unit. Assicurare l'efficace implementazione delle strategie di informazione scientifica e delle iniziative promozionali nel territorio assegnato. Garantire la corretta traduzione sul territorio delle strategie e delle priorità definite dalla Business Unit, assicurandone l'attuazione attraverso il coordinamento e il supporto del team di Informatori Scientifici del Farmaco. Monitorare l'efficacia delle attività di informazione scientifica e promozione attraverso l'analisi degli indicatori definiti dall'azienda. Analizzare il contesto di riferimento, le dinamiche del mercato farmaceutico e le esigenze degli stakeholder sanitari al fine di identificare opportunità di miglioramento e sviluppo. Formulare proposte volte a ottimizzare la copertura territoriale, l'allocazione delle risorse e l'efficacia delle attività di informazione scientifica e promozione. Gestire il budget assegnato nel rispetto delle linee guida aziendali e degli obiettivi definiti. Raccogliere e condividere insight provenienti dal territorio e dagli stakeholder rilevanti, contribuendo all'adeguamento delle strategie aziendali. Collaborare attivamente con le funzioni Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access e Business Excellence per garantire un approccio integrato e coerente alle attività sul territorio. Supportare l'organizzazione e la realizzazione di iniziative ed eventi rivolti agli operatori sanitari nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e della normativa vigente. Leadership e Gestione delle Persone: Guidare, motivare e sviluppare il team di ISF promuovendo una cultura di responsabilità, collaborazione e miglioramento continuo. Effettuare regolarmente attività di affiancamento sul campo, coaching e feedback al fine di favorire la crescita professionale e il raggiungimento degli obiettivi assegnati. Definire, comunicare e monitorare obiettivi individuali e di team coerenti con le priorità aziendali e con gli indirizzi strategici di informazione scientifica e promozione. Contribuire ai processi di valutazione della performance fornendo feedback strutturati e valutazioni oggettive relative a risultati, comportamenti e competenze. Supportare l'inserimento e l'integrazione delle nuove risorse. Identificare bisogni formativi e opportunità di sviluppo professionale del team. Contribuire ai processi di talent review e succession planning in collaborazione con la funzione Human Resources. Promuovere un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, rispettoso e orientato al benessere delle persone. We are a rapidly growing pan-European digital wealth manager, serving over 167,000 active investors with more than £7.5 billion invested on our platform. We began in Milan in 2011 with the purpose to help more people improve their financial well-being by making personal investing simple and accessible through technology. Fast forward to today, and we are recognised as one of the most innovative fintechs, headquartered in the heart of London. With a team of 220+ people across 4 offices in Italy and the UK, we are proudly backed and funded by major partners including Poste Italiane, Cabot Square Capital, United Ventures, and Allianz. Our vision Our vision is to combine passion, expertise, and technology to provide best-in-class investment solutions and advice that protects and grows client wealth over time. Our Core Values We've built our business on three Principles Relationships are our first asset: We're one team, built on trust, honesty, and transparency. We value our relationships above all else Trust drives success: We give each other the space to grow. We empower our employees to succeed, so they can make a real impact Our customers dream big, just like us: We see the bigger picture and we make sure our customers see it, too. We're always focused on the best outcomes for our clients and for each other, no matter what the goal, or how big the dream What this means in practice At Moneyfarm, our success comes from the impact each of us makes. We move with purpose, urgency, and ambition, focused on delivering outcomes that matter for our clients and our business. Everyone is empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and turn bold ideas into results. As we evolve, we embrace AI as a catalyst for sharper thinking, smarter decisions, and even greater impact. Our diversity makes this possible. Different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences fuel our creativity and drive better decisions — it's our competitive edge. We value people for who they are and their unique strengths: that's why we offer flexible ways of working to support them in doing their best work. About The Role You will own our Italian and UK websites as a growth engine. You will find where users get stuck, form hypotheses, build variants and run experiments that turn visitors into clients. You will also feed the product team with analysis and test ideas for our onboarding, and own our SEO and AI search performance together with our external agency. Roughly 50% of your time goes to the websites and experimentation, 20% to onboarding insights for the product team and 30% to SEO and AI search. This is a hands-on individual contributor role, with scope to manage a direct report as the team grows. Key Responsibilities Own the Italian and UK websites: performance, structure and experimentation roadmap across key journeys and landing pages Run A/B tests on key site journeys and landing pages with VWO, with sound hypotheses, sample sizes and statistical rigour Apply user psychology to raise conversion, especially on landing pages: use behavioural principles such as cognitive load, social proof, loss aversion, defaults and trust signals to shape hypotheses and page structure — ethically, with no dark patterns, and within financial promotion rules Analyse conversion and user behaviour with Contentsquare and Heap, from first visit to activated client Vibe-code new components and interactive widgets with AI tools such as Claude Code. Working with Design, you extend our design system rather than reinvent it, and every component goes through design and engineering review before release Turn product marketing briefs into pages. Our Product Marketing Managers own USPs and page briefs; you translate them into structure and components, and challenge them with data when something does not add up Give sharp feedback on copy. Our copywriters write; you know what works, show it with data and propose copy tests Contribute to onboarding experimentation. The product team owns onboarding; you bring funnel analysis, insights and test hypotheses Own SEO and AI search (GEO) outcomes with our external agency: set priorities, brief and challenge the agency, track organic and AI visibility KPIs, and make sure experiments do not hurt search performance Work within a regulated environment, getting variants and new pages through compliance review in both markets What Success Looks Like In Your First Year A running experimentation programme on both sites, with a steady cadence of tests on key journeys and landing pages Measurable conversion uplift on our priority landing pages and journeys A set of reusable components and widgets, built with Design and Engineering and used across the site Onboarding test ideas taken up and shipped by the product team Growing organic and AI search visibility, driven by a clear agency plan and KPIs Requirements 4+ years in CRO, experimentation or web growth, with measurable results you can walk us through Hands-on A/B testing experience (VWO or similar) and solid statistics foundations Solid knowledge of user psychology and behavioural science applied to conversion, with examples of how it shaped winning landing pages or journeys Strong analytics skills with Contentsquare or similar digital experience analytics tools; product analytics (Heap, Amplitude, Mixpanel) is a plus Real experience building with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar). Show us something you built Familiarity with Wordpress, headless CMS (Strapi, Contentful, Sanity or similar) and component-based content modelling Experience in a regulated or high-consideration sector is essential (financial services, insurance, lending, utilities). Fintech or wealth management is a strong plus Good understanding of SEO and AI search, enough to lead an agency and judge its work Strong stakeholder and agency management: you align product marketing, copywriters, design, engineering, product and external agencies, and keep work moving without formal authority Fluent English and Italian Who You Are Curious and a tinkerer: you imagine new components and widgets and build them to see if they work An owner: you spot a problem and move on it without waiting to be asked Fast: you shorten the time from insight to live test Ambitious: you benchmark against the best digital wealth experiences in the world Customer-obsessed: you optimise for clients who are the right fit, not just more sign-ups Solid: your recommendations are rigorous, and you ask questions before building what you are asked Level & Compensation: We will apply CCNL Credito with an estimated base salary (RAL) for this role ranging from €40.000 to € 50.000 gross per year, plus a discretionary bonus. Chi siamo Il Gruppo Humanitas, riferimento di eccellenza per la salute, la prevenzione e la diagnosi, è presente in Italia con 12 ospedali ad alta specializzazione, 25 Medical Care – la nostra rete di centri medici e punti prelievo, un Centro di Ricerca e Humanitas University, ateneo internazionale dedicato alle life sciences. Ogni anno, oltre 1.300.000 pazienti scelgono di affidarsi agli specialisti delle nostre strutture presenti in Lombardia, Piemonte e Sicilia. Il contesto All'interno della Direzione Digital, stiamo sviluppando un programma di trasformazione digitale con l'obiettivo di migliorare l'esperienza dei pazienti, ottimizzare i processi aziendali e introdurre nuove soluzioni basate sull'intelligenza artificiale e sull'automazione. Siamo alla ricerca di un/a Digital Product Manager che guidi l'evoluzione dei canali digitali del Gruppo, con l'obiettivo di migliorare l'esperienza dei pazienti, favorire la crescita dei servizi digitali e generare risultati misurabili, nello specifico occupandosi di: Product Strategy & Roadmap: definire la strategia e la roadmap dei prodotti digitali, tra cui sito web, app e Book & Pay, in linea con gli obiettivi del Gruppo. Growth & Performance: identificare opportunità di crescita e miglioramento, monitorando KPI di adozione, conversione ed esperienza dei pazienti. Patient Journey: ottimizzare i percorsi digitali, semplificando l'accesso ai servizi e migliorando l'esperienza end-to-end. Product Innovation: individuare nuove opportunità e guidare l'evoluzione dei prodotti attraverso analisi dei dati, sperimentazione e miglioramento continuo. Delivery & Stakeholder Management: tradurre la roadmap in iniziative concrete, definendo priorità e coordinando gli stakeholder coinvolti per assicurare un rilascio efficace. La persona che cerchiamo ha un connubio di: Requisiti e competenze tecniche: Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Informatica, Matematica o discipline affini; almeno 10 anni di esperienza in ambito Digital Product Management, con responsabilità su prodotti e canali digitali; esperienza nella definizione di strategie e roadmap di prodotto e nella gestione di KPI di performance e crescita; competenze nell'ottimizzazione delle conversioni, nella digital customer experience e nell'analisi dei comportamenti degli utenti; buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Attitudini e competenze comportamentali: Capacità di coordinare stakeholder multidisciplinari, gestire priorità e guidare iniziative di prodotto con orientamento ai risultati; approccio analitico, autonomia decisionale e capacità di tradurre obiettivi di business in iniziative concrete. Costituisce un plus l'esperienza in contesti complessi e multisede e la conoscenza dei settori healthcare, servizi digitali o piattaforme di prenotazione e pagamento. Cosa offriamo retribuzione fissa compresa in un range tra €57.000 - €65.000 lordi annui; compenso variabile compreso in un range tra €8.000 - €10.000; un programma di wellbeing che include anche iniziative dedicate alla salute fisica e psicologica; strumenti concreti per la conciliazione vita-lavoro, tra cui misure a sostegno della genitorialità e sostenibilità finanziaria; percorsi di formazione per valorizzare talenti e competenze in un contesto dinamico e innovativo. L'offerta è rivolta a candidati nel rispetto del Dlgs 198/2006 e dei Dlgs 215/2003 e 216/2003. Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement. This isn’t another content job. Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale. Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖 Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make. Our creative machine has to be able to: Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now. Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain. Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English. Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform. Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes. Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting. This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day. OUR MISSION At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken. Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change. People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them. That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics. We do that by merging: Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors) Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals) Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys) To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS. Short history Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world. YOUR MISSION 🚀 You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity. Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe. In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste. 🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization. Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry. Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn. ❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision. Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart. Deliver what you pitch. ❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules. Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it. ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar. Fuel the Growth Engine Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works. ❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human. Go global, and keep the soul We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated. And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do. How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t. THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍 Experience : Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes. Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics. AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate. Traits : Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces. Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them. A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it. No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy. Language French: Native / Bilingual English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues. Con Rendi basta una scatola: il genitore ci manda i vestiti che non vanno più, noi li controlliamo uno per uno, e in cambio arriva credito da spendere su capi nuovi o di seconda mano. Abbiamo dato una nuova vita a oltre 100.000 capi, per più di 20.000 famiglie. Abbiamo appena chiuso un round con investitori solidi per crescere nei prossimi 24 mesi. Questo ruolo è il primo pezzo di quella crescita. Il ruolo Il lavoro è fare. Poi far fare. Racconti Rendi sui social: pensi i contenuti, li giri, ci metti la faccia, li monti e li pubblichi. Quando i volumi crescono, guidi chi lavora con te: creator, grafica, montatori esterni. Cosa farai davvero Reel e creatività. I video sono tuoi dall'idea al montaggio: li scrivi, li giri e li monti. In camera spesso ci sei tu, altre volte una mamma o qualcuno del team. Il set è il nostro magazzino, dove ogni capo viene controllato a mano. Per i contenuti più elaborati ti affiancano la grafica e i montatori esterni, che coordini tu. Social. Instagram, TikTok e LinkedIn sono tuoi: piano editoriale, pubblicazione, commenti e messaggi. Le domande che i genitori ci fanno ogni giorno sono i tuoi prossimi contenuti. Roster di UGC e creator.
