Description Amazon Key is building an infrastructure-agnostic access layer for the housing sector that overlays intelligent keyless access onto existing electrical systems for communal entrance without replacing what is already installed. For contractors and staff who work across multiple buildings and portfolios, it replaces fragmented keys, codes and sign-in processes with a single seamless UX on their phone. For property teams, it creates a centralized process, with tamper-proof audit trails that becomes the one system of record for every non-resident entry, every day. For delivery drivers, it grants secure, time-bound access to communal entrances so parcels arrive safely inside the building instead of being left exposed or bounced back as failed deliveries; no keys, fobs or resident buzz-in required. We have a proven product and now we need an engine: a repeatable, instrumented, signal-driven machine that finds the right accounts, reaches the right decision-makers with the right message at the right moment, and hands Sales a warm, qualified, prioritized queue every single day. We are looking for a B2B Growth marketer to design, build, and own that engine. This is a founding, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will treat go-to-market like software: define the signals that indicate a housing provider is ready to buy, build the enrichment and outbound workflows that act on those signals, wire them into the CRM, measure conversion at every stage. You will be the technical architect of lead generation, outbound, and signal detection for Amazon Key across the. This role is highly cross-functional. Key job responsibilities Design the signal layer. Define and codify the buying signals that indicate an housing provider is in-market. Build the pipelines that detect them continuously. Build the lead-gen engine end-to-end. Own sourcing → enrichment → scoring → routing → sequencing → attribution as a versioned, monitored system. Turn target-account lists into instrumented outbound programs. Automate enrichment and data quality: Build data extraction and scraping flows from scratch. Stand up custom web-scraping and data-extraction pipelines where no clean source exists, feeding them into enrichment so target lists are built, not bought. Generate account-specific outreach at scale. Build AI-assisted systems that produce personalized, on-message outreach for named accounts and multi-channel cadences with strong deliverability hygiene. Instrument and report conversion. Define the funnel metrics (reply rate, meeting rate, pilot rate, stage conversion, time-to-money) and build the dashboards that feed conversion heartbeat. Integrate the GTM stack. Run experiments like an engineer. Ship, measure, iterate, and deprecate. Read the commercial picture, not just the tech. You understand how a housing deal actually gets won, where demand comes from, how a prospect moves from first touch to signature, and which numbers predict revenue. That lets you decide what to build and what to drop based on impact on the funnel, so the engine is judged by deals closed, not workflows shipped. Run your own show end to end. Give you a problem and a goal, not a spec, and you'll scope it, build a first version, put it in front of users, and keep refining until it holds up in production. You chase down what's broken yourself, close your own knowledge gaps, and carry a problem all the way to a working result rather than handing it off half-solved. A day in the life The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience. About The Team The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs. Basic Qualifications Experience in in a GTM Engineering, Revenue Operations, Growth Engineering, Marketing Operations, or Sales Engineering role with hands-on system-building ownership. Demonstrated experience building automated lead-generation or outbound systems end-to-end (sourcing, enrichment, scoring, routing, sequencing, attribution). Lead generation and enrichment: proven experience sourcing target accounts and contacts (including custom data extraction and web scraping) and enriching them with firmographic, technographic, and intent data to produce sales-ready, prioritized pipeline. CRM integration and funnel management: proven experience integrating automated flows and data inputs into a CRM and managing the commercial funnel end-to-end, including lifecycle stages, handoffs, and reporting reliable enough to forecast from. Expert-level CRM proficiency (Salesforce or HubSpot) at an administrator level, including objects, workflows, lifecycle logic, and reporting. Hands-on experience with GTM automation and enrichment tooling (e.g., Clay, n8n/workflow automation, enrichment and intent-data APIs) and with multi-channel outbound (email + LinkedIn) including deliverability best practices. Working proficiency with SQL and with integrating tools via APIs. Proven ability to define metrics and build dashboards that measure funnel conversion and pipeline impact. Description Amazon Key is building an infrastructure-agnostic access layer for the housing sector that overlays intelligent keyless access onto existing electrical systems for communal entrance without replacing what is already installed. For contractors and staff who work across multiple buildings and portfolios, it replaces fragmented keys, codes and sign-in processes with a single seamless UX on their phone. For property teams, it creates a centralized process, with tamper-proof audit trails that becomes the one system of record for every non-resident entry, every day. For delivery drivers, it grants secure, time-bound access to communal entrances so parcels arrive safely inside the building instead of being left exposed or bounced back as failed deliveries; no keys, fobs or resident buzz-in required. We have a proven product and now we need an engine: a repeatable, instrumented, signal-driven machine that finds the right accounts, reaches the right decision-makers with the right message at the right moment, and hands Sales a warm, qualified, prioritized queue every single day. We are looking for a B2B Growth marketer to design, build, and own that engine. This is a founding, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of Marketing, Sales, and Revenue Operations. You will treat go-to-market like software: define the signals that indicate a housing provider is ready to buy, build the enrichment and outbound workflows that act on those signals, wire them into the CRM, measure conversion at every stage. You will be the technical architect of lead generation, outbound, and signal detection for Amazon Key across the. This role is highly cross-functional. Key job responsibilities Design the signal layer. Define and codify the buying signals that indicate an housing provider is in-market. Build the pipelines that detect them continuously. Build the lead-gen engine end-to-end. Own sourcing → enrichment → scoring → routing → sequencing → attribution as a versioned, monitored system. Turn target-account lists into instrumented outbound programs. Automate enrichment and data quality: Build data extraction and scraping flows from scratch. Stand up custom web-scraping and data-extraction pipelines where no clean source exists, feeding them into enrichment so target lists are built, not bought. Generate account-specific outreach at scale. Build AI-assisted systems that produce personalized, on-message outreach for named accounts and multi-channel cadences with strong deliverability hygiene. Instrument and report conversion. Define the funnel metrics (reply rate, meeting rate, pilot rate, stage conversion, time-to-money) and build the dashboards that feed conversion heartbeat. Integrate the GTM stack. Run experiments like an engineer. Ship, measure, iterate, and deprecate. Read the commercial picture, not just the tech. You understand how a housing deal actually gets won, where demand comes from, how a prospect moves from first touch to signature, and which numbers predict revenue. That lets you decide what to build and what to drop based on impact on the funnel, so the engine is judged by deals closed, not workflows shipped. Run your own show end to end. Give you a problem and a goal, not a spec, and you'll scope it, build a first version, put it in front of users, and keep refining until it holds up in production. You chase down what's broken yourself, close your own knowledge gaps, and carry a problem all the way to a working result rather than handing it off half-solved. A day in the life The applicable collective agreement for this role is CBA for employees of Telecommunication Sector. The position is classified at level 7 or above, depending on the candidate's skills, competences and experience. About The Team The Amazon Key team sits within the Amazon Devices team alongside Ring and other Home Security teams. Key is a uniquely cross-functional team within Amazon, and often serves as the connective tissue between Smart Home/Devices, Logistics, Operations, and Retail/Shopping. We are the bridge between device management and physical services, and our team indexes highly on ownership and collaboration. We have lots of stakeholders, and we have relentlessly high standards for our high-visibility programs. Basic Qualifications Experience in in a GTM Engineering, Revenue Operations, Growth Engineering, Marketing Operations, or Sales Engineering role with hands-on system-building ownership. Demonstrated experience building automated lead-generation or outbound systems end-to-end (sourcing, enrichment, scoring, routing, sequencing, attribution). Lead generation and enrichment: proven experience sourcing target accounts and contacts (including custom data extraction and web scraping) and enriching them with firmographic, technographic, and intent data to produce sales-ready, prioritized pipeline. CRM integration and funnel management: proven experience integrating automated flows and data inputs into a CRM and managing the commercial funnel end-to-end, including lifecycle stages, handoffs, and reporting reliable enough to forecast from. Expert-level CRM proficiency (Salesforce or HubSpot) at an administrator level, including objects, workflows, lifecycle logic, and reporting. Hands-on experience with GTM automation and enrichment tooling (e.g., Clay, n8n/workflow automation, enrichment and intent-data APIs) and with multi-channel outbound (email + LinkedIn) including deliverability best practices. Working proficiency with SQL and with integrating tools via APIs. Proven ability to define metrics and build dashboards that measure funnel conversion and pipeline impact. Segnala offerta di lavoro About Incubeta Incubeta is a digital marketing agency with a focus on technology, data, and people. Our specialists build solutions that embrace the power of technology, the truth of data, and a spark of human creativity. We help advertisers, agencies, and publishers get the most from digital for their business. As Google’s most experienced EMEA Sales Partner we have overseen hundreds of deployments across the Google Marketing Platform. We address ad tech infrastructure, data management, integration, and media management and provide clients with relevant and up-to-date digital marketing services and consultancy. Established in 2001, with 22 offices in 18 countries, we are part of the Incubeta group. A global partnership of leading digital technology, media, and creative specialists. Together, we are experts in end-to-end digital advertising services and media solutions. The Position Are you a strategic data leader ready to revolutionize digital analytics within the Southern Europe market? Join our team in Milan as a Lead Data & Analytics Consultant during an exciting period of rapid growth. In this senior role, you will evolve your mindset from tactical business planning to high-level business strategy. You will be directly responsible for growing key client relationships (in collaboration with Incubeta client teams), developing their marketing intelligence maturity, and positioning our data and analytics expertise to maximize business value. By tracking how Incubeta's Marketing Intelligence proposition helps clients attract, convert, and delight their target customers, you will provide the visionary recommendations necessary to keep them competitive. Role and Responsibilities Own the long-term strategic roadmap for your portfolio, proactively identifying opportunities to upscale client data maturity and driving the expansion of Marketing Intelligence services to maximize account growth . Act as the primary advisor for key decision makers , acting as a strategic partner. Define and oversee the overarching delivery strategy for all projects within your portfolio, ensuring technical excellence and business relevancy. Own and animate Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for MI clients , translating complex data outcomes into clear business value and future investment cases. Lead high-impact workshops (Discovery, Ideation, Roadmapping) to align client stakeholders on long-term data and AI visions. Manage, mentor, and guide the consultants dedicated to your account & projects, ensuring their professional growth and the quality of their day-to-day deliverables. Direct high-complexity initiatives, with a specific focus on Agentic AI implementation and navigating complex stakeholder environments. Address high-level roadblocks in digital activity management and ensure that data architectures are built to scale with the client’s business objectives. Your character Business acumen. Strategic Visionary: You don’t just see the data; you see the business move. You are obsessed with how technology can drive measurable ROI for a client portfolio. Natural Leader: You enjoy developing talent. You feel as comfortable coaching a junior consultant as you do challenging a CMO’s perspective. Influential Communicator: You possess exceptional storytelling skills, capable of simplifying the 'Agentic AI' buzz into actionable strategic pillars. Relationship Builder: You prioritize long-term partnerships over short-term wins, building trust through consistency and proactive problem-solving. Resilient Navigator: You thrive in high-complexity environments and remain the 'calm in the storm' when managing multiple senior stakeholders. Innovation Catalyst: You have a knack for finding the 'next big thing' for your clients, always staying ahead of the curve in the D&A ecosystem. Your profile 5-7 years of experience in digital analytics or strategic consulting, with a clear track record of managing and growing client accounts/portfolios. Demonstrated experience in managing consultants or cross-functional teams in a project environment. High proficiency in Google Marketing Platform (GA4, GTM, SA360) and Google Cloud (BigQuery), specifically in how they integrate to create a 'Marketing Intelligence' ecosystem. Expert level in business analysis frameworks and translating technical KPIs into P&L impact. Sound understanding of the Southern European/Italian advertising landscape, including tech providers, agency dynamics, and the shift toward privacy-centric data. Fluent in Italian and English (professional/strategic level). Additional European languages (Spanish, Portuguese) are a distinct advantage. Advanced certifications or equivalent experience in managing high-stakes, multi-layered data projects. Benefits of working with us Working with exciting clients and worldwide enterprise companies alike. Multilingual and multicultural teamwork. Freedom to be authentic. Ownership and accountability for all your projects. Awesome colleagues & awesome clients. An international, fast-paced job with attractive professional development opportunities. Opportunity to grow in a startup environment. Incubeta is committed to protecting your personal data and handling it transparently throughout the recruitment process. Organizational excellence: you juggle multiple cities, cycles, and stakeholders while keeping every detail polished and every deadline met. Adaptability: a genuine 'GAS' attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving, non-vanilla environment. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Category Development Manager This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Category Development Manager eager to make a difference at Kraft Heinz! Reporting to the Commercial Category Lead, you will support category growth by translating market, category and financial data into clear business direction, execution priorities and actionable plans. Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Trade Marketing and customer-facing teams, you will turn insights into recommendations that connect category strategy with execution. If you’re ready to turn analysis into action and help drive category growth, come grow with us! In Brief, You Are Responsible For Bring analysis, synthesis and clarity to key business topics, supporting the strategic direction of the category. Drive sell-in and sell-out analyses to support volume forecasting and market share planning. Support the preparation of monthly internal business review meetings, turning data into clear insights and priorities. Lead the retail execution excellence process, ensuring clear targets and execution of the Perfect Store model by cluster. Translate insights into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for internal stakeholders. Qualifications Hard skills and capabilities: Category development skills, with the ability to translate insights into actionable growth plans. Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for data analysis and clear, impactful presentations. Ability to interpret and use IRI and NIQ Shopper data to identify category trends and opportunities. Strong sell-in and sell-out analytical capabilities to support forecasting and planning. Project management skills to coordinate category initiatives across multiple stakeholders. Professional Attributes Strategic Thinking – You connect market trends, category performance and financial insights to the bigger picture, translating them into clear growth priorities. Analytical Mindset – You go beyond the numbers to understand what drives performance and turn complex data into practical recommendations. Consumer and Customer Focus – You keep consumers and customers at the heart of your thinking, identifying opportunities that support category growth and strong execution. Communication and Storytelling – You bring clarity to complex topics and build compelling, insight-led narratives that help stakeholders understand priorities and take action. Team Player – You work closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Trade Marketing and customer-facing teams to turn shared priorities into coordinated action. Compensation For this position, the gross annual target base salary range is between: €43.272 - €48.700 This is based on a full-time contract and depending on your skills and experience. In addition, this position is eligible for a performance-based bonus up to 20% This bonus is subject to the terms and conditions of the bonus scheme. Additional benefits supporting your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing are available, which vary based on geographical location. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description Job Ref ID: JR0086773 Your Mission As a Sr Account Manager in the City Development team, you will take full strategic and operational ownership of a regional cluster of cities. You will be the single point of accountability for their growth: deciding where we expand, which partners we bring onto the platform, how we fix the fundamentals of the user experience— all the way to handing over a mature, profitable, market-leading city. Own Your Focus Cities End-to-end Coverage & Maps: drive expansion decisions and coordinate with Operations on decisions to improve the presence in your cities. Content: set partner acquisition priorities, own pipeline execution, manage & Grow your cities’ top partners. Fix the Basics: directly drive partner uptime improvement through targeted outreach, menu quality and CTDP optimization, and review AVR/shrinking thresholds to prevent content reductions triggered by ops tools. Affordability: own and execute the city-level promotional plan with city top partners. Reporting: own the city-level Weekly Business Review. What Success Looks Like Promotional presence in your cities— work with your top partners to execute appealing promotions. Focus on growing your priority cities. Qualifications What you will bring to the ride: Ownership & drive: a proven bias for action and a track record of hitting ambitious targets without supervision — you treat your territory like your own company. Analytical power: you translate complex data (share, funnel, unit economics) into a prioritized action plan, and you are fluent in marketplace metrics such as GMV, contribution margin, fail rate, uptime, and conversion. Strategic prioritization: you know how to concentrate scarce resources where they compound — choosing which cities, partners, and levers to attack first. Cross-functional influence: experience mobilizing Operations, Sales, Marketing, and account teams that do not report to you, and coaching more junior colleagues to execute your playbooks. Commercial and negotiation skills: proven success managing partners and negotiating commercial terms, ideally in a marketplace, retail, FMCG, or food-delivery environment. Organizational excellence: you juggle multiple cities, cycles, and stakeholders while keeping every detail polished and every deadline met. Adaptability: a genuine 'GAS' attitude and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, constantly evolving, non-vanilla environment. Languages & mobility: fluent Italian and professional English, with availability to travel regularly across your region for city and partner visits. Nice to have Proficiency in Looker (or similar BI tools) and SQL for data exploration and business analysis. Hands-on experience with Salesforce for pipeline and account management. Deep knowledge of the local market dynamics of Italian small and medium cities. Previous experience in city launch, territory expansion. Please note that the advertised salary is base only, in addition to this you would also have a Quarterly Variable Performance Bonus of 30% of the base salary (with possibility to reach up to 150% of the target and bonus) & also an Equity Plan. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Asterline Erika Golia Erika Golia Business Development & Commercial Manager Space Economy | Connettività satellitare Milano · Esperienza indicativa: 3–5 anni Asterline ricerca una persona con solide basi analitiche, attitudine commerciale e potenziale imprenditoriale per sviluppare il mercato della connettività satellitare wholesale e dei servizi B2B, incluse le applicazioni IoT. Il ruolo è rivolto a professionisti del settore spaziale e della connettività, oppure della consulenza strategica e dell’investment banking, con esperienza settoriale pertinente o risultati concreti nella costruzione di nuove opportunità di business. Non è una posizione di vendita generalista: richiede capacità di comprendere servizi complessi e trasformarli in offerte economicamente sostenibili. Il ruolo Il manager agirà a stretto contatto con la direzione e con il responsabile Upstream & Space Systems per collegare domanda, capacità satellitare e soluzioni disponibili. Avrai autonomia operativa su obiettivi condivisi e responsabilità crescenti nello sviluppo di clienti, partnership, offerte e ricavi, contribuendo alla costruzione del business in un contesto in rapida evoluzione. Responsabilità Identificare segmenti, clienti e partner prioritari: operatori di telecomunicazioni, distributori, system integrator, OEM e clienti industriali. Avviare e sviluppare relazioni B2B, comprendere le esigenze dei clienti e costruire proposte e piani di acquisto progressivi. Confrontare, insieme al responsabile upstream, capacità acquistata da operatori e opportunità legate ad asset spaziali, valutando tempi, prestazioni, investimenti e sostenibilità commerciale. Strutturare offerte wholesale e di connettività gestita; definire pricing e condizioni tenendo conto di valore per il  cliente, volumi, livelli di servizio, margini e rischio. Contribuire alla negoziazione di accordi di fornitura, partnership, distribuzione e vendita, seguendo le opportunità fino alla conclusione con il supporto della direzione. Costruire analisi economiche, pipeline e previsioni; verificare rapidamente le ipotesi di mercato e tradurre i riscontri in azioni e priorità. Formazione ed esperienza Laurea in Ingegneria, Economia, Finanza, Fisica e discipline scientifiche e quantitative coerenti. Laurea magistrale. Indicativamente 3–5 anni di esperienza rilevante in uno dei percorsi descritti di seguito, con contributi personali identificabili e risultati verificabili. Capacità di sviluppare business case e modelli economici anche con utilizzo esperto di IA e di valutare pricing, marginalità, investimenti e rischio contrattuale. Capacità di interagire con clienti e partner professionali e di comprendere prodotti, tecnologie e modelli di business complessi. Ottima conoscenza dell’italiano e dell’inglese; disponibilità a lavorare regolarmente presso l’ufficio di Milano e a effettuare trasferte. Percorsi professionali coerenti Space, satcom e connettività con orientamento su upstream satellitare: business development, partnership, vendite B2B o product e solution management con effettiva esposizione a clienti, offerte ed economics, presso operatori satellitari, service provider, integratori o aziende telecom e IoT. Consulenza strategica e manageriale: esperienza presso primarie società su ingresso in nuovi mercati, go-to-market, pricing, sviluppo commerciale o venture building, con coinvolgimento nell’attuazione e nella relazione con il cliente. Investment banking e mercati: ruoli front-office di sales, origination o soluzioni per clienti corporate e istituzionali, inclusi commodities e fixed income, con esperienza di relazione, strutturazione delle offerte e negoziazione. Per i percorsi in consulenza e investment banking è richiesta esperienza su spazio, telecomunicazioni, infrastrutture digitali o settori tecnologici e industriali pertinenti; per candidature provenienti da mercati è necessaria la dimostrazione di un contributo allo sviluppo di nuovi clienti, offerte o iniziative di business complesse. Attitudine al lavoro Cerchiamo autonomia di giudizio, curiosità tecnologica, capacità di apprendere e soddisfazione nel costruire. La reattività è essenziale: dare seguito tempestivo ai contatti, riconoscere le priorità, proporre soluzioni e far avanzare le attività senza attendere istruzioni continue. Contano rigore, qualità della relazione e capacità di passare dall’analisi all’esecuzione. Perimetro della ricerca Non sono coerenti esperienze esclusivamente di vendita retail o generalista, né percorsi limitati ad analisi o attività tecniche senza esposizione a clienti, offerte o sviluppo del business. Opportunità e candidatura Asterline offre confronto diretto con la direzione, collaborazione con competenze tecniche specialistiche e spazio per incidere sulla costruzione del business. Inquadramento e remunerazione Contratto applicato: CCNL Telecomunicazioni, con livello di inquadramento coerente con le mansioni e le responsabilità assegnate. Retribuzione annua lorda (RAL): 50.000–65.000 euro, definita in funzione dell’esperienza e delle competenze pertinenti al ruolo. Possibilità di premio variabile, aggiuntivo rispetto alla RAL indicata, legato al raggiungimento di obiettivi individuali e aziendali, con criteri e modalità definiti e condivisi all’ingresso. Invia il CV indicando formazione, esperienze pertinenti e, se possible, un breve esempio (senza riferimenti) di opportunità commerciale o progetto di sviluppo che hai contribuito a realizzare: il tuo ruolo personale, le azioni svolte e il risultato. Non è richiesta una presentazione. La selezione è aperta a tutte le persone in possesso dei requisiti, senza discriminazioni. Segnala offerta di lavoro Casa Brera - a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan is hiring through Hosco in Milan. Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan is currently recruiting a Multi-Property Director of Sales. Reporting to the Multi-Property General Manager, the Multi-Property Director of Sales is responsible for leading all sales and commercial activities for Casa Brera, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Milan and The Rome EDITION.This role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Groups & Events, and Reservations, driving revenue growth, market share, profitability, and customer loyalty. The position requires a highly commercial, results-driven leader who can develop and execute integrated sales strategies, build strong customer relationships, and inspire high-performing teams across two luxury properties.SCOPE OF WORK The Multi-Property Director of Sales is accountable for the overall commercial performance of both hotels by: Achieving revenue, market share, booking pace, and profitability objectives. Developing and executing integrated sales, distribution, and commercial strategies aligned with Marriott International and brand priorities. Identifying and capitalizing on new business opportunities to drive sustainable revenue growth. Building and maintaining strong relationships with key customers, ownership, business partners, and Marriott stakeholders. Maximizing hotel visibility and market positioning through strategic account management and business development initiatives. Driving customer satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term value through exceptional commercial leadership. Leading, developing, and inspiring Sales, Groups & Events, and Reservations teams across both properties. Ensuring commercial discipline, financial stewardship, and compliance with Marriott standards, policies, and procedures.Core Work ActivitiesCommercial Strategy & Sales Leadership Develops and executes short and long-term sales strategies to maximize revenue and market share across both properties. Leads proactive and reactive sales efforts, account management, prospecting, and business development activities. Evaluates market conditions, customer trends, and competitive intelligence to identify opportunities and mitigate risks. Partners closely with Revenue Management, Marketing, and Operations teams to optimize pricing, segmentation, distribution, and demand generation strategies. Participates in strategic sales planning, forecasting, budgeting, and performance reviews. Ensures effective deployment of Marriott sales channels, demand engines, and commercial resources.Customer & Stakeholder Relationships Establishes and maintains strong relationships with key accounts, corporate clients, luxury travel partners, and industry stakeholders. Represents both properties within the local and international business community, strengthening awareness and market presence. Collaborates with Marriott commercial teams and regional partners to identify and secure new business opportunities. Promotes a customer-centric culture focused on service excellence, loyalty, and long-term relationship development.Team Leadership & Talent Development Provides strategic direction and day-to-day leadership to Sales, Groups & Events, and Reservations teams. Creates a high-performance culture built on accountability, collaboration, engagement, and continuous improvement. Coaches, mentors, and develops team members to strengthen commercial capabilities and future leadership talent. Partners with Human Resources to support talent acquisition, succession planning, retention, and associate development initiatives. Establishes clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans that support both individual and business success.Financial & Commercial Performance Leads the commercial planning process, including annual budgets, forecasts, and business plans. Monitors and analyzes key business performance indicators including Revenue, ADR, RevPAR, market share, production, conversion, and profitability. Identifies opportunities to maximize return on investment and improve overall hotel performance. Ensures commercial resources and expenditures are managed effectively and aligned with business priorities. Supports ownership objectives through profitable revenue growth and strong financial performance. LEADERSHIP COMPETENCIES Strategic Leadership & Commercial Excellence Demonstrates the ability to develop and execute commercial strategies that drive revenue growth, market share, profitability, and long-term business success. Makes data-driven decisions, anticipates market trends, and effectively manages change in a dynamic business environment.People Leadership & Talent Development Inspires, coaches, and develops high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and career growth. Builds organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, and employee engagement initiatives.Relationship Management & Collaboration Builds strong relationships with customers, business partners, ownership, and internal stakeholders to achieve shared objectives. Promotes teamwork, inclusion, and cross-functional collaboration across multiple properties and markets.Execution & Results Orientation Translates strategy into actionable plans, effectively manages priorities and resources, and delivers measurable business results. Drives accountability and operational excellence while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction and commercial performance.Innovation, Problem Solving & Business Acumen Leverages market intelligence, financial acumen, and analytical thinking to identify opportunities and address complex business challenges. Demonstrates agility, innovation, and a commitment to continuous improvement to enhance business performance.Learning and Applying Professional Expertise Applied Learning - Seeks and makes the most of learning opportunities to improve performance of self and/or others.  Business Acumen - Understands and utilizes business information (e.g., data related to employee engagement, guest satisfaction, and property financial performance) to manage everyday operations and generate innovative solutions to approach business and administrative challenges. Technical Acumen - Understands and utilizes professional skills and knowledge in a specific functional area to conduct and manage everyday business operations and generate innovative solutions to approach function-specific work challenges. Devising Sales Strategies and Solutions - Trying different and novel ways to deal with sales challenges and opportunities; taking courses of action or developing sales strategies that appropriately consider available facts, constraints, competitive circumstances, and probable consequences. Sales Disposition - Energetic, proactive, takes calculated risks, and perseveres to attain goals. Sales Opportunity Analysis - Ability to understand and utilize economic, financial, industry, and organizational data; accurately diagnosing customer needs and issues that can inform sales strategies.  Revenue Management - Knowledge of total hotel revenue management concepts, processes and strategies (including sales cycles and trends, account management, pricing, and inventory management). Management of Financial Resources-Ability to analyze Profit and Loss (P&L) statements, develop operating budgets and revenue goals, forecasting, and capital expenditure planning; determining how money will be spent to get the work done, and accounting for these expenditures. Qualifications & Requirements:  Proven track record in senior Sales leadership roles within the luxury hospitality sector Strong understanding of luxury travel markets, customer expectations, and high-end commercial sales strategies. Demonstrated ability to drive revenue growth, market share, and profitability in a competitive environment. Fluent written and spoken English is required; additional languages will be considered an advantage.Explore our very big worldAs a world-class leader in the travel industry, there’s no better place than Marriott International to make your mark. Joining us, you’ll get to entertain and meet people from all over the world as you build your experience. You’ll find a place where your personality and ideas are appreciated just as much as the work you do. And you’ll grow through opportunities to explore the business, opening yourself to various career options. If you have the natural ability to communicate and enjoy working with others, we welcome you to join our global family. Our Commitment to pay transparency Marriott is committed to fair and equitable pay practices & we ensure that compensation decisions are based on objective, gender neutral criteria. Salary information relevant to this role will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process. We do not request or consider salary history when evaluating applicants. We are committed to an inclusive and transparent hiring experience for all candidates At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable lawThe Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts, with over 120 properties in more than 35 countries, offers the promise of authentic experiences that evoke lasting, treasured memories. Our more than 100 years of experience, beginning in 1906 under the Italian CIGA brand – a collection of Europe's most celebrated and iconic properties – serves as a solid foundation as we continuously evolve to exceed the desires of the luxury traveler.   From legendary palaces and remote retreats to timeless modern classics, each luxury hotel and resort is a unique and cherished expression of its locale – a portal to the destination’s cultural charms and treasures. If you are someone with an appreciation for evocative storytelling, a keen interest and passion for this destination's heritage, and a desire to deliver genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality, then we invite you on our journey. In joining The Luxury Collection, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you. Experience in the hospitality industry is preferred. La risorsa, ponendo focus sui servizi di allestimento e produzione Retail, dovrà svolgere le seguenti attività: Coordinare e supportare il team di Business Development e di Key Account orientandone l'azione verso il raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali; Definire e implementare la strategia di Business Development del settore con il CEO e con il Direttore della Divisione Retail Services; Identificare e sviluppare nuove opportunità di business nei mercati Retail, FMCG, Luxury e Consumer Electronics, costruendo una pipeline commerciale qualificata, così da garantire una costante generazione di nuove opportunità; Guidare l'intero ciclo di vendita, dalla prospezione alla negoziazione e chiusura di accordi commerciali complessi, sviluppando relazioni di lungo periodo con Clienti strategici e stakeholder chiave; Monitorare KPI, budget, forecast e performance commerciali, predisponendo analisi e reportistica a supporto delle decisioni di business; Collaborare con le funzioni operative e progettuali per assicurare una corretta transizione e lo sviluppo delle opportunità acquisite; Rappresentare l'azienda presso clienti, partner ed eventi di settore. Si propone assunzione con contratto a tempo indeterminato, con una retribuzione annua lorda compresa tra 80.000 e 90.000 euro. Sono inoltre previsti un piano incentivante legato al raggiungimento di obiettivi condivisi e l’assegnazione di un’auto a uso promiscuo. Livello retribuzione di base 84.200,00 €/yr - 101.600,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Yellow Tech - The AI ​​Transformation Company Sofia Ghisetti Sofia Ghisetti Head of Operations and People @Yellow Tech, the AI Transformation Company Chi siamo Yellow Tech è una società di consulenza strategica specializzata nella trasformazione AI: aiutiamo le aziende a comprendere e adottare l'intelligenza artificiale. Siamo una società AI-first , fatta di umani e agenti AI che lavorano insieme, nata con l'arrivo degli LLM e fully-bootstrapped: ci sosteniamo da soli e decidiamo noi cosa costruire. Il team Business Development trova le aziende e le qualifica; lo Strategist capisce il bisogno, chiude il progetto e lo coordina; i Trainer formano le persone (AI Academy), gli Engineer costruiscono agenti (AI Factory). 💰 Compensation Compensation totale annuale on target: €84.200-€101.600 RAL: €50.500-€57.000 in base alla seniority Buoni pasto e welfare: €2.500 l'anno Variabile annuale in base ai target del team €31.200-€42.100, uncapped, erogato trimestralmente Stock option disponibili 🔎 Le tue responsabilità Guidi un team di AI Strategist, da 4 a 6 persone, e rispondi dei risultati commerciali di tutto il gruppo. È un ruolo per chi ha già guidato un team e ha venduto e portato a termine progetti di trasformazione digitale o AI con il top management. Il ruolo comprende: Guidare e far crescere il team. Fai coaching, 1:1 e confronti periodici su obiettivi e risultati con ogni Strategist. Decidi chi entra nel team: i nuovi ingressi li intervisti e li approvi tu. Assegnare e chiudere i deal. Prendi le opportunità qualificate dal Business Development, ne apri di nuove con la tua rete e decidi quale Strategist segue ogni deal. Nei deal più complessi entri in prima persona, dalla discovery alla negoziazione. Tenere la relazione con i clienti del team. Per CEO e prime linee dei clienti del team sei il riferimento su prezzo, steering, rinnovi ed escalation. Trasformi il primo progetto in un rapporto che dura anni. Portare i progetti a risultato. Coordini il lavoro del team sui progetti di AI Academy e AI Factory insieme a Trainer ed Engineer, e intervieni quando tempi, scope o qualità escono dal piano. 📈 Il tuo percorso Nelle prime settimane conosci i clienti e i deal aperti del team e fai il primo 1:1 con ogni Strategist. Entro i primi 3 mesi guidi il team in autonomia. Hai fissato con ogni Strategist obiettivi e piano di crescita, e i nuovi deal li assegni tu. Dopo 12 mesi puoi accedere al livello successivo sulla base dei risultati del team e di criteri di performance quantitativi e trasparenti. 💛 Cosa offriamo Un posto in prima linea sull'AI. Lavori ogni giorno con gli strumenti più avanzati. La formazione che portiamo ai clienti è anche parte del tuo percorso: mentorship, peer learning e sessioni pratiche per rimanere sempre aggiornato sul mondo AI. Talent density. Lavorerai a fianco alle persone più forti sul tema più hot del momento, con un team giovane con zero ego, collaborazione, rispetto e feedback diretto. Crescita e impatto. Ogni ruolo ha un percorso di crescita scritto, da Junior a Head of, con criteri misurabili che conosci dal primo giorno: si cresce per risultati, non per anzianità. E si cresce in fretta, perché lavori in team piccoli con un impatto enorme e grande autonomia fin da subito. Retribuzione result-driven. La componente variabile è direttamente collegata ai risultati ed è senza tetto massimo : più valore generi, maggiore è il riconoscimento economico del tuo contributo. 🪜 Il processo di selezione Form online Intervista tecnica online Interview fit online Colloquio finale con CEO, in presenza a Milano 📍 Prima di candidarti Lavoriamo principalmente in presenza, nel nostro ufficio (Corvetto, Milano). Siamo una realtà early-stage con grandi ambizioni e crediamo che stare insieme, giorno dopo giorno, sia fondamentale per costruire energia, allineamento e risultati. Detto questo, operiamo con flessibilità e buon senso: il lavoro da remoto è possibile quando serve. Gli LLM sono arrivati tre anni fa e hanno creato un mercato nuovo. La finestra è grandissima ed è aperta adesso; per starci davanti bisogna lavorare meglio e più degli altri. Chi cerca ritmi prevedibili qui non sta bene. Serve l'italiano da madrelingua. I requisiti li scriviamo come orientamento, non come sbarramento: se il ruolo ti attira e pensi di poter crescere in fretta, candidati anche con un profilo non in linea. È già successo, ed è finita bene. Segnala offerta di lavoro Growing organization in the packaging sector Dynamic environment About Our Client Our client is a medium-sized manufacturing company and part of an international European industrial group. Based in the Milan Metropolitan Area, the business provides high-quality industrial solutions to customers operating across consumer-related value chains, with an established presence in European and international markets. Its offering is recognised for its technical content, quality and innovation within a specialised manufacturing environment. The company is entering a new phase of growth and organisational evolution, supported by recent production investments aimed at increasing capacity and enabling further international expansion. Within this context, the Head of Sales will play a central role in strengthening the commercial function, developing its people and introducing greater structure, coordination and performance focus across markets and sales channels. Job Description Reporting to the General Manager, the Head of Sales will combine strategic leadership with direct involvement in the development of the international commercial organisation. Key responsibilities will include: Define and implement the commercial strategy, aligning market priorities with the company's growth objectives and industrial capabilities. Take ownership of commercial results across Italy and international markets, balancing revenue growth, profitability and the development of sustainable customer relationships. Lead, motivate and develop the sales team, strengthening its capabilities, accountability and effectiveness while supporting individual and collective performance. Coordinate direct sales professionals and the international agent network, ensuring clear objectives, effective market coverage and consistent commercial execution. Introduce structured commercial processes, including objectives, KPIs, pipeline management, forecasting and regular performance reviews. Analyse revenue, margins, the customer portfolio and commercial performance by market, customer and channel, translating data into clear priorities and actions. Accelerate growth in existing markets while identifying new opportunities across selected international geographies and consumer-oriented industrial value chains. Develop and consolidate relationships with strategic industrial customers, building a strong understanding of their needs, decision-making processes and commercial priorities. Support the sales team in the most significant negotiations, combining commercial judgement, technical understanding and a focus on profitability. Work closely with General Management, Operations, Finance and other internal functions to align market opportunities with production capacity, financial targets and organisational priorities. Represent the company with key customers and commercial partners, and at relevant industry events, supporting its positioning and the development of long-term business relationships. The Successful Applicant A successful candidate should have: Significant experience as a Sales Director, Commercial Director, Head of Sales or in a comparable senior commercial leadership role. A proven track record within international manufacturing or industrial companies operating through a B2B commercial model. Experience in packaging, industrial components or B2B solutions serving the food, home care or fast-moving consumer goods sectors would be particularly relevant, although backgrounds in adjacent industrial sectors will also be considered. Demonstrated experience in leading, motivating, evaluating and developing sales teams, with a clear focus on capability building and performance improvement. Practical experience in managing direct sales professionals and indirect sales networks, including agents and international distributors. The ability to define and interpret commercial KPIs and analyse revenue, margins, pipeline, forecasts and performance across markets, customers and channels. Strong relationship management skills and experience in engaging with industrial customers, technical stakeholders and different decision-makers across the value chain. A pragmatic, authoritative and collaborative leadership style, combining analytical rigour and results orientation with the ability to engage and develop people. The ability to guide a commercial team through organisational change, introducing greater structure and consistency while building trust within an evolving entrepreneurial environment. Fluency in English and the ability to operate effectively across international markets and business cultures. Professional proficiency in French or Spanish, which would be a significant advantage. Availability for national and international travel. What's On Offer A performance-related bonus and a company car. An international commercial leadership role with the opportunity to shape sales priorities, processes and team development. The opportunity to contribute directly to the company's growth and the continued evolution of its commercial organisation. Unless you are applying for positions reserved for protected categories under Law 68/99 (in which case we only ask you to confirm that you belong to these categories, without any further information on your health or disability), your CV must not contain any information relating to your health status or to your belonging to a protected category, as this is not relevant to the assessment of your application. Livello retribuzione di base 48.700,00 €/yr - 53.700,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Yellow Tech - The AI ​​Transformation Company Sofia Ghisetti Sofia Ghisetti Head of Operations and People @Yellow Tech, the AI Transformation Company Chi siamo Yellow Tech è una società di consulenza strategica specializzata nella trasformazione AI: aiutiamo le aziende a comprendere e adottare l'intelligenza artificiale. Siamo una società AI-first , fatta di umani e agenti AI che lavorano insieme, nata con l'arrivo degli LLM e fully-bootstrapped: ci sosteniamo da soli e decidiamo noi cosa costruire. Il team Business Development trova le aziende e le qualifica; lo Strategist capisce il bisogno, chiude il progetto e lo coordina; i Trainer formano le persone (AI Academy), gli Engineer costruiscono agenti (AI Factory). 💰 Compensation Compensation totale annuale on target: €48.700-€53.700 RAL: €35.500-€40.500 in base alla seniority Buoni pasto e welfare: €2.500 l'anno Variabile annuale in base ai target €10.700, uncapped, erogato trimestralmente Stock option disponibili 🔎 Le tue responsabilità Guidi il team che apre a Yellow Tech le porte delle aziende: i BDR che chiamano CEO e prime linee, qualificano le opportunità e le passano agli Strategist. Rispondi dei lead qualificati che il team porta ogni trimestre, per numero e per qualità. Il ruolo comprende: Gestire l'operatività del team. Segui ogni giorno chiamate e incontri dei BDR e tieni alta la motivazione del team. Quando una chiamata o un incontro si complica, affianchi il BDR. Far crescere ogni BDR. Tieni gli 1:1, ascolti le call con i BDR e le usi per il coaching. Partecipi ai colloqui di chi entra, fai il suo onboarding e porti ogni persona al livello successivo. Portare il team al target. Hai un obiettivo trimestrale di lead qualificati per tutto il team. Ogni settimana leggi i numeri del funnel, trovi dove il team perde le conversazioni e cambi script e sequenze. Decidere dove chiamare. Assieme a CEO e GTM Engineer scegli settori e aziende da chiamare, fissi obiettivi e scadenze delle liste. 📈 Il tuo percorso Nelle prime settimane chiami e fai qualification call accanto ai BDR: impari il nostro mercato e come parliamo di GenAI ai decisori. Entro i primi 3 mesi prendi in mano il team e il suo target trimestrale di lead qualificati. Dopo 12 mesi puoi accedere al livello successivo sulla base di risultati e criteri di performance quantitativi e trasparenti. 💛 Cosa offriamo Un posto in prima linea sull'AI. Lavori ogni giorno con gli strumenti più avanzati. La formazione che portiamo ai clienti è anche parte del tuo percorso: mentorship, peer learning e sessioni pratiche per rimanere sempre aggiornato sul mondo AI. Talent density. Lavorerai a fianco alle persone più forti sul tema più hot del momento, con un team giovane con zero ego, collaborazione, rispetto e feedback diretto. Crescita e impatto. Ogni ruolo ha un percorso di crescita scritto, da Junior a Head of, con criteri misurabili che conosci dal primo giorno: si cresce per risultati, non per anzianità. E si cresce in fretta, perché lavori in team piccoli con un impatto enorme e grande autonomia fin da subito. Retribuzione result-driven. La componente variabile è direttamente collegata ai risultati ed è senza tetto massimo : più valore generi, maggiore è il riconoscimento economico del tuo contributo. 🪜 Il processo di selezione Form online Intervista tecnica online Interview fit online Colloquio finale con il CEO, in presenza a Milano 📍 Prima di candidarti Lavoriamo principalmente in presenza, nel nostro ufficio (Corvetto, Milano). Siamo una realtà early-stage con grandi ambizioni e crediamo che stare insieme, giorno dopo giorno, sia fondamentale per costruire energia, allineamento e risultati. La finestra è grandissima ed è aperta adesso; per starci davanti bisogna lavorare meglio e più degli altri. Chi cerca ritmi prevedibili qui non sta bene. Serve l'italiano da madrelingua. È già successo, ed è finita bene. Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years. Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol. Job Description About the team The Castrol Marine team is responsible for driving sustainable commercial growth, strengthening customer relationships and maximising sales opportunities across the marine lubricants business. Working closely with distributors, channel partners, direct B2B customers and internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Operations, Finance and Technical Services, the team supports the delivery of regional business strategies and long-term customer value. Key tasks Execute the annual and multi-year territory sales strategy, delivering volume, turnover, margin and profitability targets. Manage and develop distributor, intermediary and reseller relationships, ensuring strong commercial performance and sustainable business growth. Develop, agree and implement Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with distributor and channel partners, covering sales performance, customer development, pricing, capabilities and compliance. Identify and develop new business opportunities while strengthening existing customer relationships across the assigned territory. Drive commercial activities including pricing interventions, tender support, volume and margin analysis, upselling and customer offer development. Coach and support distributor sales teams through product training, joint customer visits and the implementation of commercial growth initiatives. Monitor market developments, competitor activity and customer insights to identify opportunities, address business risks and support future growth. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Customer Operations, Finance and Technical Services, to deliver a consistent and effective customer experience. Experience Required Proven experience in B2B sales management, with a strong track record of delivering commercial targets and driving business performance. Experience managing distributors, intermediaries, resellers or strategic channel partners. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic sales plans and Joint Business Plans. Strong commercial and financial acumen, including experience with sales performance, pricing, volume and margin management. Excellent relationship-building, influencing and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at different organisational levels. Ability to identify new business opportunities, develop customer relationships and translate market insights into commercial growth. Full professional proficiency in English, both written and verbal, to collaborate effectively with international teams and customers. Graduate or tertiary business qualification, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Additional information: This position is based in Italy or Warsaw, Poland. The role involves significant customer and distributor engagement, with at least 60% of time spent in front of customers and distributors. Privacy The Castrol entity recruiting for this role is the data controller for the personal information you provide. We use it to assess your application and to manage the recruitment and onboarding process. We may share it with service providers who support our recruitment, and it may be transferred to other Castrol entities internationally under appropriate safeguards. We keep it only for as long as necessary. For details of how we use your information and your data protection rights, contact privacy.response@castrol.com. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, socioeconomic status, neurodiversity/neurocognitive functioning, veteran status or disability status. Individuals with an accessibility need may request an adjustment/accommodation related to Castrol recruiting process (e.g., accessing the job application, completing required assessments, participating in telephone screenings or interviews, etc.). If you are selected for a position and depending upon your role, your employment may be contingent upon adherence to local policy. This may include pre-placement drug screening, medical review of physical fitness for the role, and background checks. Per il potenziamento della Business Unit Coating siamo alla ricerca di una figura di International Sales Manager di consolidata esperienza, che possa contribuire allo sviluppo commerciale internazionale della divisione e, progressivamente, assumere un ruolo sempre più strategico all’interno dell’organizzazione. La posizione prevede infatti un percorso di crescita strutturato: nell’arco di circa 12-24 mesi dall’ingresso, la persona sarà chiamata ad assumere la responsabilità della Direzione Commerciale della Business Unit Coating, con conseguente ampliamento del perimetro manageriale e strategico. In particolare, si occuperà di: Proporre piani commerciali, priorità geografiche, target e iniziative di crescita, monitorandone l’esecuzione. Gestire i principali clienti strategici e sostenere lo sviluppo dei clienti esistenti, con attenzione a pricing e marginalità. Tradurre le esigenze applicative del mercato in opportunità commerciali, trasmettendo le personalizzazioni richieste dai clienti ad R&D ed indirizzando lo sviluppo del portafoglio prodotti di competenza. Proporre e gestire il budget commerciale, monitorare risultati e scostamenti e attivare azioni correttive. Il ruolo manterrà una forte componente di business development e gestione diretta del cliente, affiancata da responsabilità crescenti di coordinamento della struttura commerciale. Indicativamente, il perimetro sarà inizialmente composto per circa il 60% da attività diretta sul mercato e per il 40% da coordinamento e gestione. DI COSA HAI BISOGNO PER AVERE SUCCESSO Esperienza significativa nelle vendite B2B di materie prime per Coating. Conoscenza del mercato, delle applicazioni e degli interlocutori commerciali. Provenienza preferibilmente da produttori di materie prime per Coating o, in seconda battuta, da distributori tecnici e specializzati. Indispensabile l’esperienza in attività export e/o di business development all’estero, sul perimetro europeo ed extra-Europa, con comprovati risultati nell’apertura e sviluppo di nuovi mercati e clienti internazionali e non limitati alla gestione di un portafoglio estero preesistente. Esperienza di coordinamento di risorse commerciali e gestione di reti di agenti/distributori coniugata alla capacità di operare personalmente sul mercato, con coinvolgimento diretto su Clienti/ Key Account. Leadership autorevole e collaborativa, spirito di iniziativa e orientamento al risultato. Competenze di negoziazione, pricing, lettura economica del business e gestione strutturata delle opportunità commerciali. Laurea tecnico-scientifica preferenziale ma non vincolante. Inglese fluente e disponibilità a trasferte internazionali. COSA AVRAI IN CAMBIO CCNL Chimico, livello Quadro A1. Segnala offerta di lavoro Your role Atlas Copco Italy is looking for an ambitious and entrepreneurial Business Development Manager to lead the growth of AIRnet, our complete piping system solution for compressed air and industrial gases. The successful candidate will be responsible for accelerating the profitable growth of the AIRnet business in Italy by expanding market presence, strengthening indirect sales channels, creating demand with industrial end users and developing strategic relationships with installers, engineering firms and contractors. Building on an already established and successful business foundation, the Business Development Manager will define and execute the growth strategy for AIRnet, coordinate the AIRNet Operational Support Engineer function and leverage Atlas Copco's global engineering resources and Centers of Excellence to continuously improve customer experience, responsiveness and business scalability. The position is part of the Compressor Services & Optimization Business Line and plays a key role in supporting Atlas Copco's ambition to become the preferred partner for industrial compressed air and gas distribution systems. Your day-to-day Business Development & Market Growth Define and execute the national AIRnet business development strategy, translating market trends, competitor activities and customer requirements into clear business actions. Drive sustainable and profitable revenue growth by identifying new market opportunities, industrial applications and customer segments. Develop demand with industrial end users, increasing market penetration and strengthening AIRnet’s positioning within target industries. Channel Development Develop and strengthen the AIRnet indirect sales network through distributors and resellers, supported by joint business development plans. Support channel partners in opportunity generation, customer development and project acquisition. Recruit and develop strategic installation partners while building long-term relationships with engineering companies, consultants and contractors. Commercial Leadership Own the commercial opportunity lifecycle from lead generation through quotation, negotiation and order closing. NUVOLE GARDEN HOTEL 5★ LUXURYRICERCA SALES MANAGER – LUXURY HOSPITALITY Sede di lavoro: Brunate (Como) – Lago di Como Nuvole Garden Hotel, esclusiva struttura 5 stelle lusso situata a Brunate, con una posizione panoramica privilegiata sul Lago di Como, ricerca un Sales Manager con comprovata esperienza commerciale nel settore dell'hôtellerie di lusso internazionale . Cerchiamo un professionista di alto livello, già operativo nel mercato luxury, capace di sviluppare concretamente il fatturato della struttura attraverso l'acquisizione di nuovi clienti, tour operator, agenzie di viaggio di lusso e partner internazionali. Non cerchiamo un profilo prevalentemente amministrativo, operativo o di marketing, ma un professionista della vendita alberghiera con risultati documentabili. RESPONSABILITÀ PRINCIPALI Sviluppare le vendite delle camere e suite di lusso, incrementando fatturato, ADR e redditività. Acquisire nuovi clienti e sviluppare accordi commerciali con luxury travel advisor, tour operator e agenzie internazionali. Consolidare e ampliare i mercati strategici, con particolare attenzione a USA, Canada, Regno Unito, Svizzera e Paesi DACH . Sviluppare relazioni commerciali con network e operatori specializzati nel luxury travel, tra cui Virtuoso, Serandipians, Traveller Made e altri circuiti internazionali di fascia alta. Effettuare attività commerciale diretta: contatti, appuntamenti, visite presso agenzie, sales call, site inspection e partecipazione a fiere internazionali. Promuovere le esperienze esclusive della struttura, la ristorazione, la SPA e gli eventi privati. Definire e raggiungere obiettivi commerciali misurabili, predisponendo report periodici su nuove acquisizioni, contratti, produzione e fatturato generato. Collaborare direttamente con la Proprietà per la definizione e l'attuazione della strategia commerciale. REQUISITI INDISPENSABILI Saranno considerate esclusivamente candidature in possesso dei seguenti requisiti: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza effettiva nelle vendite alberghiere , preferibilmente in strutture 5 stelle lusso, luxury resort o gruppi alberghieri internazionali di alto livello. Esperienza documentabile nell'acquisizione di nuovi clienti e nella negoziazione di contratti con agenzie e tour operator internazionali. Conoscenza concreta dei mercati luxury leisure e dei relativi canali distributivi. Portafoglio di relazioni professionali già sviluppato con agenzie, luxury travel advisor e partner commerciali qualificati. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese, scritta e parlata. La conoscenza di ulteriori lingue costituisce titolo preferenziale. Capacità di lavorare per obiettivi, con autonomia, iniziativa commerciale e orientamento ai risultati. Disponibilità a svolgere attività commerciale sul territorio, trasferte e incontri internazionali. Disponibilità a lavorare stabilmente presso la struttura sul Lago di Como. COSTITUIRANNO TITOLI PREFERENZIALI Esperienza commerciale presso hotel 5 stelle lusso sul Lago di Como o in altre destinazioni luxury internazionali. Rapporti professionali consolidati con il mercato americano. Conoscenza e utilizzo dei principali network internazionali di luxury travel advisor. Esperienza nella commercializzazione di suite di alta gamma, soggiorni esclusivi e servizi luxury. Risultati verificabili nell'incremento del fatturato e nell'apertura di nuovi mercati. COSA OFFRIAMO Inserimento in un progetto alberghiero di lusso con importanti obiettivi di sviluppo. Rapporto diretto con la Proprietà. Autonomia e responsabilità nella gestione commerciale. Trattamento economico commisurato all'esperienza e alle competenze effettive. Sistema incentivante legato al raggiungimento di obiettivi commerciali concreti e misurabili. MODALITÀ DI CANDIDATURA Per essere valutati, i candidati dovranno allegare al proprio curriculum una breve presentazione professionale indicando: Le strutture alberghiere presso cui hanno ricoperto ruoli commerciali. I mercati internazionali sui quali hanno effettivamente operato. Le tipologie di agenzie e tour operator con cui hanno sviluppato rapporti commerciali. Alcuni risultati concreti ottenuti in termini di acquisizione clienti e incremento del fatturato, nel rispetto della riservatezza aziendale. Le candidature prive dei requisiti di esperienza commerciale alberghiera richiesti non saranno prese in considerazione. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership. At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. Job Description Kidde is seeking a Brand Sales professional that will be supporting various distribution channel management activities. Responsible to support commercial leadership, product commercialization, and strategic market execution for Edwards and Kidde commercial fire and life safety solutions across multiple countries. Acts as the primary regional interface with global sales, product management, engineering, operations, and key customers, translating market requirements into compliant, commercially viable solutions that drive growth, customer satisfaction, and long-term market adoption. Partner with sales executives across region to develop and promote strong product and application knowledge and apply it to the Channel partners, A&E Firms, Integrators, and End User customers; with the intent to drive specifications and brand awareness. The brand sales professional will be reviewed by the overall growth and success of the region. Key Responsibilities Weekly Responsibilities: supporting regional sales team in customer service issues, demand planning and forecasting. Execute key global accounts into region facilitating contact, account pipeline and project status, call on Engineering firms to support sales team with key product presentations and pitch to end users. Facilitate training events with training teams, customer and sales. Represent region in key associations meeting. Travel as necessary for customer support, training, presentations and local trade shows. Monthly Responsibilities: Contribute to planning events, trade shows and calendar updates and travel schedule. Expense reports should be filed at least twice a month. Monitor progress on any special regional and company assigned projects. Maintain updates on current products and promotions. Visit integrators for market information and Channel Partner feedback. Quarterly Responsibilities: Support Quarterly forecast outlook/updates. Stay current on required online quarterly ethics training and certifications. Ability to travel up to 60% of the time Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree preferred + Years of Experience Selling in the Fire Alarm Industry, Security, or Technical Industry. Mandatory fluency to speak and write English and Spanish, additionally Portuguese preferred. Preferred Qualifications Excellent presentation skills, both written and verbal, communication skills. Basic computer skills. High energy level product and code knowledge and application usage. Strong interpersonal skills are essential. World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe. Segnala offerta di lavoro Our client is a leading international company operating in the beauty and cosmetics industry , with a portfolio of well-established brands distributed worldwide. Recognized for its entrepreneurial mindset, continuous innovation, and strong consumer focus, the company offers a dynamic international environment where commercial excellence and business growth are key priorities. To support its ambitious growth plans across the EMEA region, our client is looking for an experienced EMEA Key Account Manager – Beauty Distribution Reporting directly to the General Manager EMEA, the candidate will define and execute the regional commercial strategy, driving sustainable business growth across multiple markets. The role will oversee both existing business and new market development, leading strategic customer relationships while identifying new opportunities to expand the company's footprint throughout the region. Working closely with Marketing, Trade Marketing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Global Leadership, the Sales Director will play a pivotal role in shaping the commercial direction of the EMEA business. Key Responsibilities Define and execute the EMEA sales strategy in line with the company's growth objectives. Lead and develop commercial activities across the region, ensuring sustainable and profitable growth. Build and strengthen long-term relationships with distributors, wholesalers, and key retailers . Identify and develop new business opportunities across existing and emerging markets. Lead high-level commercial negotiations and establish regional framework agreements. Drive sales forecasting, budgeting, and performance monitoring across the region. Collaborate closely with Marketing and Trade Marketing teams to maximize brand visibility and commercial execution. Monitor market trends , competitive landscape, and consumer behavior to identify new growth opportunities. Requirements Extensive international sales leadership experience within the Beauty industry . Proven track record of managing multi-country commercial organizations across the EMEA region. Strong knowledge of the drugstore, perfumery, and retail distribution channels , together with experience working with distributors. Excellent strategic thinking combined with a hands-on commercial approach. Outstanding negotiation, influencing, and relationship-building skills. Strong analytical mindset with experience in sales planning, forecasting, and P&L management. Inspirational leadership style with the ability to develop and motivate high-performing teams. Fluent English is essential; additional European languages are considered an advantage. Location: remote working (Europe based). Total salary package ranging from € 80.000 to €120.000. About GoWit GoWit is a fast-growing AdTech company building the next generation Commerce and Retail Media technology. Our omnichannel solution helps retailers monetize their advertising inventory and enable advertisers and agencies to reach shoppers across on-site, off-site, and in-store channels. With GoWit Edge, our enterprise Retail Media platform, and GoWit One, our AI-powered commerce and retail media operating system, we’re helping shape the future of commerce advertising. We’re expanding our European presence and looking for an experienced Retail Media Sales Manager to drive our growth across the region. What You’ll Do Own and execute GoWit’s sales strategy across European markets, with a primary focus on acquiring new retail and e-commerce partners. Identify, engage, and close enterprise opportunities with retailers, marketplaces, and e-commerce platforms for GoWit Edge. Develop relationships with key decision-makers across retail media, e-commerce, digital advertising, and commercial teams. Build and manage a strong sales pipeline, from prospecting and discovery to negotiations and contract signing. Identify opportunities to introduce GoWit One to agencies, brands, and advertisers. Represent GoWit at relevant industry events and partner meetings across Europe. Work closely with our leadership, product, and customer success teams to turn commercial opportunities into long-term partnerships. What We’re Looking For 5+ years of B2B sales or business development experience in Retail Media, AdTech, digital advertising or closely related industries. Proven track record of selling enterprise advertising technology, retail media solutions, or digital advertising platforms. Strong understanding of the European Retail Media ecosystem, including retailers, marketplaces, agencies, and technology providers. An existing professional network within the retail, e-commerce, or advertising industry. Hands-on experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles and negotiating commercial agreements. Solid understanding of retail media monetization, sponsored products, display advertising, and programmatic advertising. A commercially driven, independent, and results-oriented mindset. Fluent English. Italian, Polish, or additional European languages are a plus. We’re looking for someone who already understands this industry, knows the relevant players, and can turn relationships into business opportunities. Why Join GoWit? Play a key role in GoWit’s expansion into Europe. Sell competitive, enterprise-grade Retail Media technology with an established customer base. Work directly with the company’s leadership and influence regional growth strategy. Join an ambitious international team operating at the intersection of commerce, advertising, and AI.
