Job Description Team Lead (CPM Fast Track) Milan Office At EF Language Abroad, we believe the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we’ve helped millions of students explore new cultures, gain global perspectives, and build the confidence to pursue their ambitions. We offer immersive language experiences around the world, empowering students with the skills they need to thrive internationally. Accelerate your path to leadership Are you ready to take on a high-impact commercial role with a clear path to leadership? As a Team Lead , you will act as the right hand to the Country Product Manager (CPM) — combining individual sales excellence with team leadership and operational responsibility. This is a fast-track role to CPM , designed for high-potential individuals who want to step into a country leadership position within approximately 6 months , based on performance and readiness. From day one, you will be exposed to key business decisions, leadership responsibilities, and strategic planning. Your role You Will Operate Across Three Core Areas Sales Ownership & Performance Take full ownership of your assigned leads, managing the entire sales cycle from first contact to closing Consistently achieve and exceed individual sales targets Act as a top performer and role model for the team Team Leadership & Development Lead, coach, and develop a team of 1–5 Language Coordinators Drive daily performance through coaching on calls, conversion, and customer experience Support hiring, onboarding, and performance management in partnership with the CPM Business Ownership & Operations Act as second-in-command to the Country Product Manager, supporting key decisions and ensuring business continuity Take ownership of selected managerial responsibilities such as forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking Contribute to sales strategy through market analysis, performance insights, and opportunity identification Build partnerships with schools, universities, and local networks to drive growth Your growth path to CPM This role is structured as a stepping stone to Country Product Manager . Within Your First Months, You Will Master individual sales performance and lead from the front Take full ownership of a team’s results and development Gradually assume responsibility for key business metrics and operations Partner closely with the CPM on strategic and commercial decisions Successful candidates typically transition into the CPM role within ~6 months , based on performance, leadership readiness, and business needs. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Business or related field, or equivalent experience 3+ years of sales experience with a strong track record of closing deals 1–2 years of experience leading, mentoring, or coaching junior team members Strong leadership potential and ambition to move into a general management role Commercial mindset with the ability to think beyond individual sales Excellent communication and interpersonal skills Full fluency in Italian and English International experience (study, work, or travel abroad) Full working rights in Italy Work environment This is a fully on-site role. Being together in person accelerates learning, strengthens team culture, and enables faster decision-making — all essential in a high-growth, performance-driven environment. What EF Offers Fast-track progression to Country Product Manager within ~6 months for top performers International career opportunities beyond CPM Staff and Friends & Family discounts on EF programs Free access to EF Hello language app Tuition reimbursement for continued education Discounts with global travel and hospitality partners And much more Your next step toward global leadership This is more than a Team Lead role — it’s a launchpad to country leadership . If you’re driven by performance, motivated by responsibility, and ready to take ownership of a business, this is your opportunity to grow faster than in a traditional career path. Ready to open the world through education? Apply now. About EF Language Abroad At EF Language Abroad, we believe that the world is better when people try to understand one another. Since 1965, we've helped millions of students discover new places, embrace diverse cultures, and gain fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to our mission of opening the world through education, harnessing the power of language learning to deepen the connection between people across the globe. We offer immersive short-term and long-term language courses and programs across different languages in the countries where they’re spoken. Through blending classroom-based lessons with interactive exercises and real-world practice, our courses bring you to the heart of the language. Together, our global staff help students from around the world develop the language skills they need to achieve their dreams. EF is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults. All positions are subject to a criminal background and/or reference checks, as applicable. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence! Overview The Unattended Payments Solutions Manager leads the expansion of TNS's unattended payments business in Italy, driving market development, strategic partnerships, and solution innovation to accelerate growth across the Parking, EV Charging, Mobility, Ticketing, and Self-Service sectors. Responsibilities The Unattended Payments Solutions & Business Development Manager is responsible for accelerating TNS's growth in the Italian unattended payments market, with a focus on Parking, EV Charging, Vending, Ticketing, Retail Self-Service, and Mobility. The role combines business development, payment solution expertise, and ecosystem management. Acting as the subject matter expert for unattended payment solutions, the successful candidate will support opportunity qualification, solution definition, partner development, and go-to-market execution in Italy. The role works closely with the Corporate Account Executive & Unattended Payments Business Lead, Sales, Marketing, Product, Engineering, Operations, and Delivery teams. Business Development Identify and develop new unattended payment opportunities across the Italian market. Build, qualify, and manage a dedicated sales pipeline. Support the revenue and growth objectives of the unattended payments sector. Develop relationships with key customers, operators, and market stakeholders. Represent TNS at relevant industry events, trade shows, and market associations. Solution Design and Pre-Sales Support Sales in the technical, functional, and commercial qualification of opportunities. Design and position the most appropriate solution for each customer requirement. Participate in workshops, presentations, discovery sessions, and technical discussions. Contribute to business cases, proposals, and commercial offerings. Support solution integration, onboarding, and certification activities. Partner Ecosystem Development Build and manage relationships with PSPs, acquirers, processors, gateway providers, and payment technology vendors. Develop partnerships with solution providers operating in parking, EV charging, vending, ticketing, mobility, and self-service sectors. Identify, qualify, and facilitate the onboarding of new partners. Coordinate commercial and technical activities between external partners and internal teams. Support joint go-to-market initiatives. Product, Market Intelligence, and Go-to-Market Capture market and customer requirements and translate them into actionable product roadmap recommendations. Monitor market trends, standards, competitors, and emerging payment technologies. Support the definition and positioning of the Italian Unattended Payments proposition. Evaluate new payment methods, terminal solutions, and unattended payment architectures. Partner with Marketing on campaigns, events, content creation, and demand generation activities. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Governance Collaborate with Sales during customer and partner engagements. Coordinate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Service Delivery, Compliance, and Finance teams. Monitor integrations, milestones, delivery status, risks, and escalations. Maintain Salesforce and internal project tracking tools. Provide regular reporting on pipeline performance, partnerships, deliverables, and risks. Qualifications Experience and Background Experience within the payments industry, ideally in business development, pre-sales, solution management, product management, partnerships, or a related field. Experience working with acquirers, PSPs, gateways, processors, or payment technology vendors. Knowledge of payment integration, onboarding, and certification processes. Experience managing technical, commercial, and operational stakeholder relationships. An established professional network within the Italian payments market would be advantageous. Technical and Market Knowledge Good understanding of payment ecosystems, transaction flows, and unattended payment architectures. Knowledge of EMV, ISO 8583, Android terminals, payment gateways, and terminal integration frameworks. Familiarity with one or more of the following sectors: Parking, Mobility, EV Charging, Ticketing, Vending, or Retail Self-Service. Understanding of European payment market dynamics, standards, and key compliance requirements. Skills and Competencies Strong business development and relationship-building skills. Consultative approach with the ability to connect market needs, solutions, and commercial value. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with technical, commercial, and senior stakeholders. Self-motivated, organised, and able to prioritise and manage multiple workstreams. Fluent Italian and professional-level English. Willingness to travel within Italy and, where required, across Europe. Key Success Measures Qualified pipeline generated within the Unattended Payments segment. Number and value of new business opportunities and customers acquired. Strategic partnerships established, activated, and converted into commercial opportunities. Speed and quality of technical and commercial opportunity qualification. Contribution to solution development and revenue growth objectives. If you are passionate about technology, love personal growth and opportunity, come see what TNS is all about! TNS is an equal opportunity employer. TNS evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic. Segnala offerta di lavoro Meet the Team The Sales Capabilities & Readiness team within Global Sales Operations is dedicated to crafting, operationalizing, and scaling the foundational capabilities that power Cisco's worldwide sales organization. Our mission is to transform the end-to-end Plan-to-Pay lifecycle, bridging executive Go-To-Market strategy with seamless field execution. Our charter spans customer operating models, strategic segmentation, territory design, account coverage, and incentive compensation, all supported by a collaborative culture where diverse perspectives drive operational excellence. Your Impact As a Strategy & Planning Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in our sales planning transformation initiatives. You will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and operational reality, partnering with senior sales leaders, IT, and Finance to design scalable frameworks. This role is perfect for a data-driven professional who thrives on solving complex business challenges and is passionate about empowering our global sales teams to achieve their highest potential through innovative platforms and processes. Responsibilities Partner with platform, strategy, and change leaders to drive the global adoption of new sales capabilities, policy adjustments, and tooling. Map end-to-end sales planning workflows to identify operational friction points and design optimized, scalable processes. Analyze sophisticated sales data, market coverage models, and customer segmentation patterns to support executive-level decision-making. Collaborate with regional sales leadership, Operations, Finance, and IT engineering to ensure operational initiatives align with corporate growth goals. Develop high-impact strategy whitepapers, executive presentations, and arguments for leadership steering committees. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Operations, or a related field. 5–8+ years of progressive experience in sales operations, strategy & planning, management consulting, or business transformation within the technology industry. Demonstrated ability to translate intricate Go-To-Market concepts and data models into clear, actionable executive strategies. Outstanding interpersonal and presentation skills with experience influencing cross-functional leaders in a global, matrixed organization. Proven expertise in the end-to-end Plan-to-Pay cycle, including territory design, quota setting, and seller compensation models. Preferred Qualifications Proficiency in process modeling and design (BPMN preferred). Experience with AI integration into professional workflows, including familiarity with IDE/AI coding tools. Advanced proficiency in Business Intelligence tools (Tableau, Power BI, Business Objects) and enterprise CRM platforms (Salesforce). Familiarity with agile operating models, design thinking, and digital collaboration platforms (Miro, Asana, Jira). Strong verbal and written communication skills with a proven ability to drive adoption through active listening and business alignment. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. Company Description At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Job Description Location: Milan, Italy Country/Cluster Scope: Italy Work Level: 5B Role Overview The Sales & Channel Performance Analytics Manager is the strategic analytical partner to the Italy Head of Sales and Italian commercial teams. The role leads the development of scalable commercial analytics, turning sales, pricing, margin and channel data into clear performance narratives, predictive insight and actionable recommendations. It strengthens the commercial operating cadence and embeds common data, tools and ways of working across Italy. Key Accountabilities Sales performance and commercial insight Define and maintain common KPIs, performance measures and dashboards covering sales, volume, margin, price, mix, discounts and customer performance against plan, forecast and prior year. Identify performance drivers, emerging risks and opportunities across Italy by crop, product portfolio, channel, sales team and customer segment. Lead the design and delivery of concise weekly, monthly and quarterly performance packs for the Italy Head of Sales and Italian sales reviews. Translate complex analysis into practical commercial actions, clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions, risks and recommended next steps. Commercial planning, forecasting and opportunity management Lead the analytical input to the annual commercial planning cycle, including target setting, sales phasing, scenario modelling and assumptions tracking. Coordinate forecast inputs across Italy, challenge data quality and consolidate a robust country performance view. Develop forecasting models, monitor forecast accuracy and highlight material variances early, with root-cause hypotheses and recommended interventions. Advanced customer, channel and portfolio analytics Develop customer profitability, lifetime value, retention/churn, win/loss, cross-sell and up-sell analyses to support account prioritisation, pipeline follow-up and growth plans. Partner with commercial, supply, demand and data/digital teams to develop propensity, churn-risk and opportunity models, and embed insights in customer-facing decisions. Own the end-to-end management of the market-share “black box” for the crop-protection market (GRIF) and, in the future, biostimulants. Represent the company in the forum of participating companies, coordinate the monthly data submission process and ensure the completeness, accuracy and timeliness of data provided. Analyse the market-share reports received, identify relevant trends, performance gaps and opportunities, and translate findings into actionable commercial recommendations. Support the National Key Account function and Key Account Managers (KAMs) in defining and monitoring Key Account Plans for their assigned customers, providing performance analysis, customer insight and progress tracking against agreed priorities. Key stakeholders Primary Internal Stakeholders Italy Head of Sales; Sales Area Managers, National Key Account function, KAMs & teams, finance, marketing activators, supply, demand planning, IT and data/digital colleagues; external market-share forum participants. Decision-making and scope Leads the design, development and prioritisation of commercial analytics, reporting and routine insight requests within agreed data and governance standards. Recommends actions and escalates material commercial risks, data-quality issues, forecast deviations or customer-performance concerns to the Italy Head of Sales. Does not own Italian sales targets or customer decisions; owns the quality, consistency and practical use of analytical insight that enables stronger decisions. Qualifications Experience and qualifications Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, mathematics, data analytics, finance, agricultural sciences or a related discipline; advanced degree is an advantage. Typically 5+ years’ experience in sales analytics, commercial excellence, business intelligence, customer analytics, finance or a comparable analytical role. Experience in a matrix organisation is preferred. Professional fluency in English; additional relevant language capability is an advantage. Capabilities And Technical Skills Strong analytical and commercial judgement: able to move from complex data to a clear commercial storyline, recommendation and action. Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; strong working knowledge of Power BI or comparable business-intelligence tools; SQL and Python or R are preferred. Comfortable working with SAP and IBP; able to reconcile, validate and govern multiple commercial, customer and financial data sources. Structured project and stakeholder management, with the confidence to challenge constructively, influence senior stakeholders and communicate simply. High attention to detail, ownership, discretion and a service mindset toward Italian sales teams. Success measures Timely, accurate and trusted Italian sales and customer-performance reporting, forecasting and insight delivery through standardised, automated tools. Improved visibility of Italian customer, portfolio, channel and sales-team performance drivers, profitability and growth opportunities. Demonstrable use of advanced insights and improved data governance in sales reviews, customer plans, commercial decisions and corrective actions. Westcon-Comstor ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Westcon-Comstor. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 54.000,00 €/yr - 75.000,00 €/anno The Vendor Success Manager (VSM) acts as the primary business owner and strategic interface for assigned vendor brands, driving revenue growth, market share, and program adoption across the country or cluster. This role ensures alignment between vendor global objectives and Westcon-Comstor local execution, translating vendor strategies into actionable plans and orchestrating cross-functional resources to deliver measurable outcomes. Acting as the face of the vendor internally and externally, the VSM builds trust-based relationships with vendor executives, partners, and internal teams while ensuring governance, compliance, and operational excellence. Success requires proactive engagement, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to influence both vendor and internal stakeholders. Vendor Relationship Management * Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for assigned vendors. * Build and maintain multi-level relationships across vendor sales, marketing, and operations. * Represent Westcon-Comstor at vendor headquarters, events, and strategic meetings. * Cascade vendor objectives internally to ensure alignment and execution. Business Planning & Execution * Develop and own the Vendor Market Plan with clear objectives, targets, and enablement actions. * Deliver revenue, margin, and profitability goals across the vendor portfolio. * Deploy campaigns, promotions, and investments at local level; adjust plans based on performance. * Provide structured progress updates to management and vendor counterparts. Resource Mobilization & Cross-Functional Alignment * Engage internal teams (PSMs, IAMs, IPSMs, Solution Architects) to drive vendor pipeline execution. * Ensure seamless coordination between field and inside sales for joint opportunities. * Act as escalation point for vendor-related issues impacting execution. Sales Enablement & Acceleration * Train sales teams on vendor products, tools, and programs to ensure commercial readiness. * Drive adoption of vendor programs by partners and internal teams. * Identify and remove growth blockers to accelerate deal velocity. Pipeline Stimulation & Demand Generation * Generate new opportunities through campaigns, account mapping, and joint planning. * Track active deals with IAMs and PSMs to ensure timely closure. * Support vendor-specific sales blitzes and digital initiatives (Power BI, 3DLab). Partner Engagement & Development * Identify and recruit new vendor-aligned partners; manage focus accounts jointly with PSMs. * Support partner enablement through certifications, rebates, and program participation. * Monitor partner performance and adjust plans to meet vendor objectives. Marketing & MDF Governance * Execute vendor campaigns and ensure brand consistency across all communications. * Maximize MDF impact through ROI-driven planning and transparent reporting. * Represent vendor and Westcon-Comstor at trade shows, events, and joint partner activities. Forecasting & Reporting * Provide accurate forecasts for vendor sales and margin projections. * Track performance versus targets and analyze trends to adapt strategies. * Maintain CRM discipline and timely reporting for governance compliance. Compliance & Program Governance * Ensure adherence to vendor requirements, processes, and ethical standards. * Manage MDF responsibly, ensuring transparency and audit readiness. Must-Have Skills & Experience * Proven experience in vendor management, channel sales, or business development roles. * Strong commercial acumen and ability to influence vendor and internal stakeholders. * Excellent relationship-building and negotiation skills. * Language: Italian & English (business fluency). Nice-to-Have Skills & Experience * Familiarity with multi-vendor IT distribution and channel ecosystems. * Experience in marketing campaign execution and MDF governance. * Additional languages and international exposure. Education & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or related field (or equivalent experience). Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) * Vendor revenue and margin attainment at country/cluster level. * Market share growth and pipeline coverage ratio (≥3× target). * Partner recruitment and activation metrics. * Campaign execution and MDF ROI. * Training and enablement impact (sales readiness and certification rates). * Forecast accuracy and CRM data quality. * Vendor satisfaction scores and governance compliance. Company Values & Culture Fit This role demands agility, accountability, and a passion for driving vendor success. Success means owning outcomes, enabling growth, and fostering a collaborative, tech-savvy sales culture. Salary Range: Compensation will be determined within the advertised range based solely on the candidate's experience, skills, and expertise, ensuring a fair and consistent approach for all applicants. Westcon-Comstor is a global technology distributor specializing in cybersecurity, networking, and hybrid cloud solutions. As Growth Architects of the channel, we empower IT partners, vendors, and end customers to seize opportunities, unlock potential, and achieve scalable success. Our core values - ambition, integrity, partnership, and accountability - guide how we work and inspire everything we do. We believe diversity drives creativity and innovation, which is why we're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard, every perspective matters, and every team member can thrive. Join us and be part of a team that's shaping the future of technology across the channel. What we offer * 🌍 An inclusive and supportive work environment where diversity is celebrated. * 📈 Opportunities for professional growth, learning, and career development. * 💻 Flexible working arrangements and other benefits to support your wellbeing. * 🤝 A culture of collaboration, innovation, and accountability. Commitment to diversity & inclusion We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Equity is at the heart of all our departments and roles. If you need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know. 📄 Please submit your CV in English to ensure consistency in our review process. To recruitment agencies: Only agencies engaged by Westcon-Comstor are authorised to support our recruitment. CVs or profiles sent with Notice out a prior agreement will be considered unsolicited, and no fees will be paid. Thank you for your understanding. La persona coordina e guida il team di export manager. Definisce obiettivi, priorità e aree di competenza, e ne monitora i risultati. Supervisiona le attività di vendita internazionale e garantisce un approccio commerciale coerente su tutti i mercati. Nel quotidiano si occupa di: Posizionamento dei prodotti : sviluppa e gestisce il posizionamento dei prodotti a marchio proprio e di quelli in licenza. Cura inoltre lo sviluppo dei progetti in private label, dalla proposta al cliente fino alla gestione dell’accordo. Canali di vendita : gestisce e sviluppa i rapporti con la Distribuzione Organizzata, sia Food che non Food, con i distributori e con i grossisti esteri, adattando la strategia commerciale a ciascun canale. Analisi e pianificazione : analizza i mercati di riferimento, definisce i piani di sviluppo e monitora le performance commerciali in termini di fatturato e marginalità. Negoziazione : conduce e supporta la negoziazione di accordi, contratti e listini con clienti e partner internazionali. Presenza sul mercato : partecipa a fiere internazionali e incontri commerciali. Coordinamento interno : collabora con marketing, prodotto, supply chain e customer service per garantire il corretto flusso operativo e l’allineamento alle strategie aziendali. Qualifiche Solide competenze in export e international trade, con esperienza nella gestione di reti commerciali estere. Esperienza di coordinamento e guida di un team commerciale, con capacità di motivare, sviluppare e responsabilizzare le persone. Esperienza consolidata con la Distribuzione Organizzata Food e non Food, i distributori e i grossisti. Conoscenza delle dinamiche dei prodotti a marchio, in licenza e in private label, preferibilmente nei settori stationery, casalinghi o beni di consumo. Capacità di elaborare business plan e di operare in ambito international business, con attenzione agli obiettivi di crescita e redditività. Ottime capacità di vendita e negoziazione, e di gestione delle relazioni con clienti e partner internazionali. Costituiscono requisito preferenziale: laurea in discipline economiche o affini; ottima conoscenza dell’inglese e di altre lingue straniere (francese, tedesco, spagnolo); dimestichezza con gli strumenti digitali; orientamento ai risultati, leadership e spiccate capacità comunicative e organizzative. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro LEGAMI è il brand italiano nato nel 2003 con l’obiettivo di far vivere emozioni positive attraverso oggetti che accompagnano la vita quotidiana delle persone. “We are Dreamers” è la nostra filosofia e cerchiamo sempre Dreamers talentuosi per collaborare e crescere insieme a noi. LEGAMI è un universo di mondi da esplorare costituito da prodotti colorati, originali, divertenti, capaci di emozionare chi li acquista e chi li riceve in regalo: dagli articoli stationery agli accessori per la casa, dai prodotti per il viaggio agli accessori per il beauty, gli accessori Hi-Tech, i giocattoli vintage e molto altro. Nel nostro quartier generale progettiamo tutti gli oltre 5.000 prodotti che distribuiamo in più di 70 Paesi, nella rete di Boutique LEGAMI in Italia, in più di 500 punti vendita nel mondo in collaborazione con le più prestigiose librerie e department store e sul nostro sito e-commerce. Per il nostro team di Procurement&Planning siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire come Replenishment Manager. La funzione Replenishment assicura la disponibilità dei prodotti nei negozi attraverso la gestione delle scorte e del riassortimento dai magazzini centrali, in linea con gli obiettivi di servizio e la strategia commerciale per canale e cluster. Il ruolo presidia coperture, parametri di riassortimento e pianificazione di breve termine, intervenendo su indisponibilità, eccedenze e prodotti a lenta rotazione. Contribuisce al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di Forecast Accuracy, livello di servizio e tasso di riempimento, in raccordo con Category, Demand Planning, Logistica e Retail. In accordo con L'Head of Planning, favorisce l'allineamento delle attività del team alle priorità condivise e lo sviluppo di processi e sistemi di supporto. Responsabilità e attività: Gestione inventory negozi e monitoraggio coperture Monitorare periodicamente coperture e disponibilità di prodotto per negozio e cluster individuando gap rispetto ai target. Definire strategie di stocking e destocking e azioni correttive per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di canale. Pianificare riallocazioni e riequilibri di stock in collaborazione con Logistica e Retail; attivare alert e azioni sugli slow moving, supportando Category nell’ottimizzazione assortimentale. Riassortimento e avvio nuovi negozi Pianificare il riassortimento dai magazzini centrali ai negozi, generando e gestendo le missioni di rifornimento per frequenza, quantità e priorità. Gestire direttamente urgenze, vincoli di capacità e anomalie di stock con Logistica e Retail, favorendo l’allineamento operativo del team sulle priorità condivise con l’Head of Planning. Definire con Category gli impianti iniziali e le missioni per nuove aperture o reset, in coerenza con cluster e strategia commerciale. Aggiornare i dati relativi ad aperture e modifiche di layout o cluster con Retail e Masterdata, contribuendo alla pianificazione anticipata delle attività del team per ottimizzare flussi, costi e risultati. Set-up e manutenzione parametri a sistema Simulare, impostare e ottimizzare i parametri di replenishment nei sistemi (es. SO99): coperture, soglie min/max, contenenze e regole di riordino e trasferimento, sulla base di vendite ed evidenze operative. 4 ) Reporting e collaborazione trasversale Gestione reportistica di replenishment: piano arrivi, coperture Real vs Target, Forecast Accuracy, service level, understock, overstock e slow moving. Collaborare con Analytics allo sviluppo di dashboard e all’automazione delle analisi ricorrenti. Tradurre disponibilità e vincoli comunicati da Demand Planning e priorità commerciali di Category in azioni di rifornimento e set-up, bilanciando servizio e sostenibilità logistica. Utilizzare strumenti e soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale per migliorare i processi di pianificazione (es. forecasting, analisi degli scostamenti, automazione della reportistica), partecipando o guidando progetti di innovazione e di efficientamento in collaborazione con le funzioni coinvolte. Allineamento operativo e miglioramento continuo Contribuire alla distribuzione delle attività e al bilanciamento dei carichi di lavoro del team, a supporto dell’Head of Planning, per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi e dei KPI condivisi. Individuare opportunità di efficientamento e portare avanti progetti di miglioramento dei processi e dei sistemi in accordo con l’Head of Planning. Chi cerchiamo: Laurea in Ingegneria Gestionale, Economia o discipline affini. Almeno 6 anni di esperienza in Replenishment o Allocation, preferibilmente nel retail multicanale. Conoscenza di sistemi di planning/replenishment (es. SO99) ed ERP e dei principali parametri di riassortimento: coperture, min/max e contenenze. Ottima padronanza di Excel; gradita conoscenza di strumenti di BI e reporting. Capacità analitiche e conoscenza dei KPI di pianificazione e stock: Forecast Accuracy, service level, coperture, OOS, overstock, slow moving e tasso di riempimento. Orientamento al risultato, problem solving, proattività. Capacità di favorire l’allineamento operativo del team sulle priorità concordate con l’Head of Planning e di collaborare con Category, Logistica, Retail e Analytics. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Perché unirti a noi: Contesto dinamico e in forte crescita, in cui il tuo contributo può fare la differenza. Cultura aziendale orientata alla sostenibilità ambientale e al benessere delle persone. Worklife balance: flessibilità oraria e possibilità di recuperare il venerdì pomeriggio le ore extra lavorate nella settimana. Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa. Wellness@Work: palestra aziendale con attrezzature professionali e corsi dedicati. Vuoi diventare un/una Dreamer? Candidati ora! Modalità di lavoro: in sede - Azzano San Paolo. Tipologia contratto : Tempo indeterminato. Iter di selezione: se il tuo CV sarà in linea verrai contattato/a dal team HR per approfondimenti; il processo di selezione prevede 2 o 3 step a seconda della seniority. I dati fornitici saranno trattati per la ricerca e selezione di personale ai sensi del Regolamento UE 679/2016 (GDPR). La selezione è rivolta a candidati ambosessi (D.lgs n. 198/2006). LEGAMI si impegna a garantire pari opportunità in tutte le fasi del processo di selezione, nel rispetto della Diversità, Equità e Inclusione. Tutte le candidature saranno valutate senza distinzione di genere, età, origine etnica, nazionalità, orientamento sessuale, religione, disabilità o qualsiasi altra caratteristica personale. Head of Operations Milano | Full time | In presenza | Riporto diretto al founding team Chi siamo Guidoio è la startup che sta ridisegnando il modo in cui le persone prendono la patente in Italia. Operativa dal luglio 2023, abbiamo costruito il primo modello integrato di scuola guida digitale in Italia, con l’obiettivo di stabilire un nuovo standard nella formazione automobilistica del Paese. Siamo attivi in numerose città italiane, con un piano di espansione ambizioso che combina l’acquisizione di autoscuole storiche e l’apertura di nuove sedi, e siamo sostenuti da investitori istituzionali di primo piano, tra cui 360 Capital Partners, Azimut, Growth Capital, Vesper Holding e l’incubatore dell’Università Bocconi. Guidoio è una tech company con un’anima operativa fortissima. I nostri istruttori di guida e i nostri insegnanti di teoria sono il cuore pulsante del servizio: la tecnologia non è qui per sostituirli, ma per valorizzarli e metterli nelle condizioni di lavorare al meglio. Come lavoriamo Da noi ogni giorno si lotta insieme, come una squadra, per raggiungere un risultato sfidante. Ci muoviamo veloci, ma senza perdere il contatto con le persone, che siano studenti o colleghi. Il cambiamento vero nasce da chi lavora sul campo ogni giorno. Siamo tech per mentalità e people oriented per vocazione, e le due cose si alimentano a vicenda. Cerchiamo persone con passione, intraprendenza e tanta ownership: chi sente l’azienda in cui lavora anche come sua. E' il momento giusto per entrare: Guidoio è in una fase in cui la società ha risorse e vuole crescere: chi arriva ora partecipa attivamente alla costruzione dell’azienda e ne diventa parte, anche da socio, grazie al piano ESOP (Employee Stock Option Plan). La posizione Cerchiamo una/un Head of Operations: la persona che guiderà le operations di Guidoio e darà struttura alla macchina organizzativa su cui si regge la nostra crescita. Non si parte da zero: il lavoro di struttura è già partito, ma va sviluppato e portato a un nuovo livello. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con il founding team per rendere l’operatività quotidiana delle autoscuole scalabile, misurabile e replicabile città dopo città.Il ruolo è in presenza: passerai la maggior parte del tempo in ufficio o nelle sedi. Potrà essere possibile un giorno di lavoro da remoto a settimana, ma non è garantito. Non è un ruolo di coordinamento a distanza né di lavoro da remoto: guiderai le persone sul campo, ne risponderai e ne farai crescere i risultati. Le tue responsabilità Persone e leadership • Guidare e responsabilizzare i team operativi • Fissare standard e obiettivi chiari, dare feedback diretto e fare rispettare le regole, gestendo con equilibrio eventuali conflitti e situazioni difficili. • Ascoltare sempre le persone, creare allineamento e portare al founding team decisioni e piani realistici. Conto economico (P&L) • Essere responsabile del conto economico delle autoscuole del nostro gruppo: ricavi, capacità e costi di ogni sede. • Costruire dashboard e KPI in tempo reale per decidere in modo rapido e fondato sui numeri. Struttura e coordinamento • Costruire e mantenere i ritmi del team Operations: check in, meeting settimanali, reportistica, gestione dei blockers. • Definire ruoli, responsabilità e flussi di lavoro tra le funzioni operative e monitorare gli obiettivi delleautoscuole. Processi e scalabilità • Mappare, standardizzare e digitalizzare i processi, in modo che siano replicabili su nuove città e nuove acquisizioni. Tecnologia e automazione • Usare strumenti di intelligenza artificiale per automatizzare le attività a basso valore aggiunto e collaborare con il team tech per definire le priorità di sviluppo dei sistemi interni. Il profilo che cerchiamo Non cerchiamo un curriculum specifico, cerchiamo mentalità. Per noi contano i comportamenti e l'ambizione, non il brand da cui vieni. • Ownership: vivi i problemi della tua area con responsabilità e porti soluzioni, non segnalazioni. • Leadership: hai autorevolezza, fissi standard, sai dire di no, responsabilizzi gli altri e decidi anche sottopressione, mantenendo al primo posto il rispetto delle persone. • Organizzazione e rigore: sei una persona precisa, dai priorità e porti ordine dove non c’è. • Intraprendenza e passione: ami le sfide ambiziose e il lavoro di squadra in un contesto in rapida crescita. • Orientamento al risultato: tieni insieme studenti, ricavi e qualità del servizio. Requisiti Essenziali • Almeno 10 anni di esperienza in operations, project o program management, gestione di reti o sedi, consulenzaoperativa o ambiti analoghi. • Avere gestito direttamente un team di almeno 5 persone per diversi anni. • Responsabilità su KPI, budget o conto economico di un’area o di più sedi. • Laurea in Ingengeria o in discipline STEM. • Ottima conoscenza dell’inglese, scritto e parlato. • Sede di lavoro Milano, in presenza, e disponibilità a viaggiare. • Uso autonomo di strumenti di intelligenza artificiale e di piattaforme vibe coding . • Familiarità con process mapping, automazione e dashboard operative. Molto apprezzati • Esperienza con personale di campo o in reti multisede, e in contesti di scale up o di rapida crescita. • Esperienza di integrazione di nuove sedi o di aziende acquisite. Cosa offriamo ﻿ • RAL: 60.000 e 75.000 euro, in base all’esperienza ﻿ • Variabile: 10-15% della RAL, legato a obiettivi concordati ﻿ • Equity: Partecipazione al piano ESOP di Guidoio • Un ruolo di reale impatto e piena responsabilità, a stretto contatto con il founding team, con la possibilità concreta di disegnare l’organizzazione operativa dell’azienda. • Un ambiente dinamico e ambizioso, dove si cresce in fretta lavorando a fianco di persone esperte e dove i risultati si toccano con mano. Processo di selezione Il processo è pensato per essere rapido, trasparente e rispettoso del tuo tempo. 1. Call conoscitiva di 30 minuti: capiamo se c’è un match di base. 2. Colloquio con i founder. 3. Business case live di 60 minuti: un esercizio pratico su uno scenario operativo reale, in videochiamata o insede. 4. Incontro finale con il team e offerta: in caso di riscontro positivo, ti diamo una risposta in pochi giorni. Se vuoi far parte di un progetto e renderlo anche tuo, questo è il momento di entrare in Guidoio. Lavoro Persone Learning Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Accedi Iscriviti ora General Manager | Soft Facility Ali Professional Milano Candidati General Manager | Soft Facility Ali Professional Milano 1 giorno fa Oltre 200 candidati Guarda chi è stato assunto da Ali Professional per questo ruolo Candidati Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Ali Professional è alla ricerca di un/una Direttore Generale con esperienza consolidata in aziende di servizi, preferibilmente caratterizzate da una significativa componente di capitale umano , per assumere la responsabilità del governo organizzativo, amministrativo ed economico della società. La persona inserita avrà un ruolo centrale nel garantire il corretto funzionamento dell'organizzazione, assicurando il presidio dei principali processi amministrativi, contabili e gestionali e lavorando a stretto contatto con il CEO nella definizione degli obiettivi aziendali, dei budget e dei principali KPI. La responsabilità Il/La Direttore Generale avrà la responsabilità di presidiare e coordinare il funzionamento complessivo della struttura aziendale, favorendo l'integrazione tra le diverse funzioni e assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi economici, organizzativi e gestionali. In particolare, si occuperà di: Presidiare la gestione e l'organizzazione degli uffici , assicurando efficacia, coordinamento e corretta gestione dei processi. Affiancare il CEO nella definizione del budget aziendale , contribuendo alla pianificazione economica e finanziaria e al monitoraggio degli scostamenti. Coordinare il responsabile amministrativo nella predisposizione del bilancio , interfacciandosi con consulenti e professionisti esterni. Autajon è un gruppo industriale a conduzione familiare, costituito da "imprenditori connessi". Riconosciuto nei mercati dei beni di lusso, dei profumi, dei cosmetici, dei prodotti farmaceutici, dei vini, degli alcolici, dei dolciumi e delle specialità, il Gruppo si sta espandendo a livello internazionale, acquisendo siti localmente influenti che condividono il nostro stesso DNA. Insieme, ci impegniamo a sostenere i nostri clienti fornendo loro servizi sostenibili e alte prestazioni nel mondo degli astucci, delle etichette, delle scatole e degli espositori per punti vendita. Con un know-how di oltre 50 anni, creiamo soluzioni personalizzate e innovative, sempre attente alla sostenibilità ed alle problematiche sociali. Diamo lavoro a più di 4.000 persone in 41 siti a misura d'uomo, generando un fatturato di 800 milioni di euro. Siamo autentici, condividiamo gli stessi valori e reclutiamo persone alla ricerca di un'avventura personale e collettiva. Site Director Vediamo spesso bellissime confezioni ed etichette dettagliate e non ci facciamo caso. Come vengono fabbricate? Da dove provengono le confezioni e le etichette? Da Autajon ovviamente! Siamo tra i leader europei nel mercato del packaging: il Gruppo Autajon è presente nei mercati del Luxury&Cosmetics, Wines&Spirits, Farmaceutico e della Grande Distribuzione. Con una rete di stabilimenti in Europa, Stati Uniti e Cina, il nostro Gruppo di stampo famigliare, raggiunge oltre 600 milioni di fatturato l'anno e conta circa 4000 dipendenti. Siamo alla ricerca di nuovi talenti per continuare a sviluppare il nostro Gruppo! E se fossi tu il prossimo? I nostri impiegati lavorano in team e sono entusiasti di operare in un'azienda in forte espansione: nuove idee, nuovi progetti, piani di miglioramento sono all'ordine del giorno! E in produzione? Macchinari all'avanguardia e di ultima generazione rappresentano l'orgoglio dei nostri operai che si impegnano a fornire un prodotto di qualità che superi le aspettative dei nostri clienti! Milano, IT - 100% | Full time About The Role Role type: Permanent | Location: Milano, Italy | Model: Hybrid | Level of travels: 10% Our Company Alpiq is one of Switzerland’s leading electricity producers and a key energy services provider across Europe. Headquartered in Lausanne and powered by a strong portfolio of hydropower, nuclear, and renewable energy sources, we’re all about impact, for the climate, for people, and for the security of supply. More than 1,300 colleagues from nearly 60 nationalities bring their energy to a shared purpose: Together for a better climate and an improved security of supply. We work in a values-driven culture shaped by trust, curiosity, and respect. Our 4 company values have been co-created with our employees and are embedded in everything we do as a company: “We are ALP1Q “- reflects our team spirit “We learn and grow together” - we have courage “We share the steering wheel” - we take ownership “We focus on the outcome” - your impact matters At Alpiq, your energy matters! Mission: contribute to achieving the business objectives outlined in the company's strategy, by managing gas generation assets in Italy and implementing new initiatives As we progress on our flexibility strategy, we have grouped all thermal asset and related activities under a single business unit. Reporting into Head of Thermal Generation, you will manage generation assets and O&M activities of thermal plants. You effectively and economically manage plant operation and maintenance activities in accordance with the best practice standards, in compliance with regulatory requirements, occupational health and safety, and environmental protection with the target to achieve Budget and to maximize Value Chains results. Your Main Responsibilities Your key responsibilities will include: Overseeing O&M activities of all plants under management, including defining, monitoring, and complying with O&M contracts and related budgets Overseeing the purchasing process of goods and services in order to ensure that the best technical and economic compromise is achieved within the assigned budget and company standards Coordinating with Asset Trading to maximize Value Chain results Maximizing availability and technical and commercial reliability of the plants over time Contributing to the achievement of the economic results defined in the budget related to the electrical production assets, in compliance with the Italian regulations and Group directives Assessing and proposing, in cooperation with Engineering and Development, investments necessary to guarantee and improve the required performance, including replacement capex and new projects Managing administrative, governance and contractual aspects of asset companies Overseeing procurement process for goods and services to ensure that the best technical and economic result in accordance with the allocated budget and company standards Ensuring regulatory compliance in Health, Safety, Environment by overseeing the organization and ensuring high standards for employee health and safety Taking over tasks and responsibilities consistent with the delegated powers in the field of Safety and Environment Participating in managing relations with external and internal unions where present, together with the Head of Human Resources Ensuring the preparation of business plans to support the evaluation of new investments and participate in decision-making processes regarding the analysis and evaluation of new initiatives. Your impact As Head of Generation Italy Thermal, you will: Maximize the value of assets by ensuring their availability, reliability and competitiveness through efficient and cost-effective maintenance strategies interact with Leadership team, Asset Trading, Engineering and all support functions to optimize the operation of the assets. Lead and act as example in the field of HSE. Your profile Master’s Degree in Engineering. Post-Graduate Business Education ad a plus. At least 15 years of experience in Operation and Maintenance of generation assets or in similar tasks in an Energy company on business and/or strategic roles, preferably in a multinational environment. Good knowledge of the Italian market in both regulatory and competition landscapes. Good understanding of European energy trends. Experience in leading highly complex projects and leading multidisciplinary teams. Level and field of studies. Fluent in Italian and English. Are you an experienced After Sales or Service Operations professional who knows how to turn complex field-service challenges into better customer experiences? We are looking for a Service Operations Manager to lead and coordinate our regional service operations, drive continuous improvement, and ensure consistently high service standards across Italy. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys being close to the operation, working with customers, technical teams and service partners, and making a visible impact on service quality, efficiency and cost performance. The position is based in Northern Italy, with Milan as the preferred location, and offers a flexible working arrangement. What will you be responsible for? You will coordinate the Service Regional Managers team and play a key role in shaping how our service organization operates. Your responsibilities will include: - Leading and coordinating regional service operations - Setting guidelines to ensure consistent service levels across regions - Driving solutions for key customers, particularly around technical issues, service effectiveness and operational costs - Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and create synergies across field operations - Monitoring service performance, KPIs, SLAs and customer reporting - Continuously improving After Sales and Service processes - Coordinating service activities with local Epta organizations and sharing best practices - Managing preventive and actual service cost analysis, including materials, labour and subcontractors - Identifying and onboarding new external service providers, including scouting, rate - negotiation and agreement management - Supporting recall campaigns together with Quality and Service organizations - Ensuring compliance with relevant Health & Safety, F-Gas and internal requirements What are we looking for? You could be a great match if you have: - Around 5+ years of relevant experience in Service Operations, After Sales, Field Service or a comparable technical service environment - Experience managing people and coordinating service activities, ideally within an international or multinational organization - Strong understanding of field-service operations and customer service - Experience managing external suppliers, contractors or service partners - Confidence working with KPIs, SLAs, reporting and cost analysis - Strong project and process management capabilities - A technical background, such as a professional technical qualification or Engineering degree - Fluent English, which is a mandatory requirement for this position - Residence in, or willingness to be based in, Northern Italy, ideally in the Milan area - The experience and technical knowledge required to take ownership of the role and work with a high level of autonomy from the outset What will make you successful? We are looking for someone who combines strong technical and operational understanding with effective leadership. You are proactive, customer-focused and comfortable taking ownership. You know how to bring different teams together, challenge existing processes when needed and turn improvement opportunities into concrete results. You can balance customer satisfaction, service quality, operational efficiency and cost performance while keeping people, collaboration and long-term service excellence at the centre of your approach. What we offer At Epta, we offer a transparent and competitive compensation package aligned with the applicable National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL – Metalworking). CCNL level: A1 Annual gross salary: €80,000 – €92,000, depending on experience and competencies. The final offer will be determined using objective, gender-neutral criteria applied consistently across all candidates, including verified professional experience, relevant technical competencies, and the confirmed scope and responsibilities of the role. Company car €500 one-off allowance for home office furniture Flexible working arrangement, with up to 50% monthly smart working Why this role? This isn't just about keeping service operations running. It's an opportunity to shape how service is delivered, develop the regional organization, strengthen relationships with customers and service partners, and introduce smarter and more efficient ways of working. You will have the opportunity to influence how our service organization evolves while working within an international environment where technical expertise, customer focus and operational excellence come together. If you enjoy connecting people, technology, customers and operations, we'd love to hear from you. Novastone Capital Advisors (NCA) is a global firm that solves succession challenges faced by Small to Medium-Sized Enterprises (SMEs). Through our Operator-Led Buyout (OLBO) Program, we provide a structured and scalable solution for business succession, ensuring lasting success for all stakeholders. NCA is looking for motivated, talented, aspirational mid-career professionals with the ambition to partner with NCA to search, acquire and lead a small or medium-sized enterprise as Chief Executive Officer. As an NCA Searcher, you will spearhead an up to 24-month professional search to acquire one small to mid-sized company. Within the scope of our Operator-Led Buyout (OLBO) Program, you will have access to comprehensive support from NCA during the search, as well as an attractive incentive package in the form of base compensation and vested shares in the acquired company that will further enhance and secure your entrepreneurial journey. If you are interested in reviewing other Operator-led Buyout Programs we offer, visit our website here: www.novastone-ca.com. Please note that we do not invest in start-up or scale-up companies. Successful candidates will search, acquire and manage a company in Italy . We strongly recommend attending one of our Q&A sessions to learn more about the opportunity. Registration is mandatory: https://webinar.novastone-ca.com/ OPERATOR RESPONSIBILITIES Establish together with us a search process aiming to generate sufficient deal flow with the ultimate goal of finding a business to acquire in accordance with pre-defined criteria Manage the acquisition process with the support of our experienced Investment Management team Step into the CEO role of the newly acquired business Proactively generate and evaluate strategic growth options and business opportunities, develop long-term business strategy and 100-day plans Grow the business top line via impactful marketing and sales initiatives Review product/service offerings, portfolio strategies, existing brands positioning and identify gaps and implement improvements Manage geographical expansions, when required, preparing and successfully implementing market entrance strategies Manage efficiency and ensure profitable growth MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS 15+ years of professional experience (including at least 5 years in leadership roles with full P&L responsibility) Academic achievement (Executive MBA or MBA degree preferred) Min. 10+ years of proven track record of running and growing businesses or business units in Italy Strong motivation towards entrepreneurship Fluent in English and Italian Deep expertise and/or strategic vision in one or more of the following sectors/industries: Business Services Healthcare Services Niche Manufacturing Software / Tech-Enabled Businesses Distribution & Logistics NICE-TO-HAVE REQUIREMENTS M&A experience Consulting experience from a top consulting firm Experience managing and operating an SME Owner, Founder or co-Founder of a Start-up Experience in global business development, international expansion Recent successful business transformation experience Open mind towards learning, people and even failure SELECTION PROCESS Every application we receive is read and evaluated personally by our team, with no automated or AI-based screening. Selected candidates will have several in-depth interviews, take online assessments, meet different stakeholders while reviewing their investment thesis, and complete and present a business case assignment over several weeks. The selection process also includes informative, non-evaluating steps such as webinars created for candidates to gather more information about the program and meet the NCA team. Final Assessment Center with the jury selection happens in December 2026 . We are an Equal Opportunity program, and all submitted CVs pass through the same application process, regardless of gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, race, political affiliation, marital status, disability, age, parental status, or any other non-merit factor. For more information on the program, our application and selection process please refer to our website www.novastone-ca.com. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Be An Essential Part Of Everyday Life DHL Supply Chain has an exciting opportunity for you. We are looking for a Customer Service & Key Account Management Manager – Planned Transport. In this role, you will lead the Customer Service and Key Account Management functions within the Planned Transport Business Unit, ensuring service excellence, strong customer relationships, operational efficiency and sustainable business growth. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of strategic customers and overseeing, through two Account Managers, a customer portfolio worth approximately €70 million. Your key objectives will include customer retention, contract renewals, financial performance, customer satisfaction and the continuous improvement of service delivery. Acting as a key interface between customers, Operations and internal stakeholders, you will drive customer governance, performance management, contract compliance and business development initiatives, working closely with Regional and Global Account Teams in an international environment. Your Key Responsibilities Customer Service Leadership Lead and develop the Customer Service organisation, ensuring effective Front Office and Back Office operations. Oversee customer requests, complaints, claims, damages and escalations, ensuring timely and effective resolution. Define operational priorities, workload distribution and resource allocation, maintaining high service standards and compliance with contractual SLAs. Foster a strong customer-oriented culture, accountability and continuous improvement. Customer Relationship & Key Account Management Manage relationships with approximately 40 customers across FMCG, Consumer Electronics, EMEC and Retail sectors. Act as the primary point of contact for customers without a dedicated Key Account Manager. Directly manage assigned strategic accounts and coordinate two Account Managers, ensuring consistent governance across the overall portfolio. Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders, translating business priorities into aligned action plans with Operations and support functions. Collaborate with Regional and Global Account Teams to ensure alignment and consistency for multinational customers. Contract Renewals & Customer Retention Lead the renewal strategy for existing customers, working in close collaboration with the Business Unit Director, Operations, Finance, Procurement and Legal. Coordinate renewal proposals, assessing volumes, scope, SLAs, costs, risks and profitability. Lead customer negotiations within the assigned delegation of authority. Monitor contractual deadlines and proactively identify opportunities to strengthen customer retention, expand existing business and introduce additional services. Contribute to tender and retender processes for existing customers, ensuring commercially and operationally sustainable solutions. Financial Performance & P&L Management Monitor the financial performance of assigned customers following contract renewal, with particular focus on revenue, costs, profitability and deviations from the agreed business case. Ensure alignment between negotiated commercial conditions and operational implementation. Identify profitability improvement opportunities and coordinate corrective actions with Operations, Finance and Controlling. Contribute to budget, forecast and financial performance reviews, providing regular visibility and recommendations to the Business Unit Director. Contract & Business Governance Ensure effective monitoring of contractual obligations throughout the customer lifecycle, covering both DHL commitments and customer responsibilities. Manage contractual deviations, scope changes, change requests and commercial adjustments, preventing scope creep and non-remunerated activities. Independently plan, prepare and lead Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), presenting operational and financial KPIs, risks, opportunities and improvement plans. Ensure effective follow-up of agreed actions, responsibilities and deadlines. Participate in monthly Business Unit Meetings and Business Review Meetings, providing management insights, performance analyses and recommendations. Performance Management & Risk Mitigation Monitor customer KPIs, SLAs and service performance, identifying trends, root causes and improvement opportunities. Lead Root Cause Analysis and corrective action plans in collaboration with Operations and relevant stakeholders. Identify and proactively manage operational, organisational, commercial and service-related risks. Ensure appropriate escalation management and timely communication with customers and senior management. Promote a data-driven approach to performance monitoring and decision-making. People Leadership & Development Lead and develop the Customer Service and Key Account Management teams, managing resources, FTE allocation, priorities and operational coverage. Set individual and team objectives, monitor performance and conduct regular performance reviews. Manage recruitment, onboarding, training and talent development activities. Build a collaborative, accountable and performance-oriented team environment. Continuous Improvement & Digital Transformation Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Customer Service processes, focusing on efficiency, service quality and standardisation. Collaborate with Regional and Global teams on automation, digitalisation and process transformation initiatives. Support the implementation of RPA, digital tools, Track & Trace, Ticketing systems and customer-specific technology solutions. Monitor the effectiveness and sustainability of implemented initiatives. Business Development & Customer Experience Support new customer onboarding and implementation, ensuring alignment between operational solutions and commercial commitments. Identify cross-selling opportunities, business expansion potential and additional service opportunities within the existing customer portfolio. Contribute to strategic Account Plans and customer development initiatives. Ensure that customer needs and expectations are consistently translated into sustainable operational and commercial solutions. YOUR PROFILE Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Logistics, Management or a related field. Significant experience in Customer Service, Key Account Management, Contract Management or Business Management, preferably within the logistics, transport or supply chain industry. Proven experience managing complex customer portfolios, contract negotiations and customer retention activities. Strong understanding of P&L management, financial performance, budgeting and profitability analysis. Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to develop teams and manage multiple stakeholders. Excellent analytical skills, with a strong data-driven approach to problem-solving and decision-making. Strong communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to manage complex customer relationships and senior-level escalations. Experience with continuous improvement, process optimisation and digital transformation initiatives. Fluency in English and Italian. WHY JOIN DHL SUPPLY CHAIN? At DHL Supply Chain, you will have the opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment, leading strategic customer relationships and contributing directly to business performance and growth. You will play a key role in shaping customer experience, driving operational excellence and developing innovative solutions within one of the world's leading logistics organisations. Si rivolge a realtà multinazionali e aziende imprenditoriali in trasformazione. Lavora libera da schemi predefiniti, è guidata dalla reali esigenze delle organizzazioni valutandone la specifica fase evolutiva. Job Title: General Manager Location: Nord Ovest Italia Industry: Hospitality CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Direzione Generale & P&L Management: piena responsabilità della gestione operativa, economica e finanziaria della struttura alberghiera, definendo e monitorando budget, forecast e KPI di performance (RevPAR, ADR, GOP, occupazione). Posizionamento & Revenue Strategy: definizione e implementazione delle strategie commerciali, di pricing e revenue management in sinergia con i canali distributivi, con l'obiettivo di massimizzare la redditività e consolidare il posizionamento sul mercato. Guest Experience & Standard Qualitativi: supervisione dell'eccellenza del servizio in tutti i reparti (Front Office, F&B, Housekeeping, Maintenance), garantendo elevati standard di ospitalità e monitorando costantemente la soddisfazione degli ospiti. Leadership & Sviluppo del Team: guida, coordinamento e valorizzazione dei responsabili di reparto e dello staff, promuovendo una cultura orientata all'eccellenza, all'accoglienza e al raggiungimento dei risultati. WHAT YOU CAN BRING TO THE COMPANY Comprovata esperienza (almeno 7-10 anni) nel ruolo di General Manager o Hotel Manager all'interno di strutture alberghiere strutturate. Solide competenze di gestione economica, controllo dei costi (food cost, labor cost) e analisi dei principali indicatori di performance alberghiera. Forte orientamento al cliente, spiccata sensibilità per i dettagli e capacità di gestire con autorevolezza ed empatia team multidisciplinari. Ottime doti commerciali, conoscenza delle dinamiche di revenue management e dei principali PMS/gestionali alberghieri. Fluente conoscenza della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata); la conoscenza di una seconda lingua straniera costituirà titolo preferenziale. YOU ARE ENERGIZED BY Guidare il posizionamento e la crescita di una struttura alberghiera, impattando direttamente sulla qualità dell'esperienza offerta e sui risultati economici. Costruire, motivare e far crescere squadre affiatate e orientate all'eccellenza nel servizio. Coniugare visione strategica e presenza operativa sul campo, rappresentando il punto di riferimento per ospiti, collaboratori e proprietà. Ottimizzare i processi operativi e innovare l'offerta di ospitalità anticipando le evoluzioni del mercato. WHAT THE COMPANY OFFERS Retribuzione: RAL €70.000 - €80.000 in base alla seniority e al profilo professionale. Livello retribuzione di base 40.000,00 €/yr - 50.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Melt Group Borja Fos Gracia Borja Fos Gracia Responsabile Commerciale – Settore Turistico e PA Melt Group ricerca, per conto di un importante gruppo tecnologico internazionale , un/a Responsabile Commerciale per la sede situata nell'area di Milano . La società italiana è una realtà in fase di startup , nata con l'obiettivo di avviare e sviluppare il mercato italiano. Fa parte di un importante gruppo internazionale , presente in quasi 20 paesi e attivo nel settore dell' innovazione e dello sviluppo tecnologico . L'azienda sviluppa e commercializza soluzioni innovative nei settori della realtà virtuale e aumentata, della simulazione, della robotica e della formazione immersiva, rivolgendosi a imprese e organizzazioni di diversi settori. La figura selezionata avrà un ruolo centrale nello sviluppo della presenza commerciale in Italia , contribuendo all'acquisizione di nuovi clienti, all'apertura di nuove opportunità di business e alla crescita della società sul mercato nazionale, con particolare attenzione alla Lombardia . Principali responsabilità: Sviluppo commerciale e acquisizione di nuovi clienti nei settori della Pubblica Amministrazione, dei Beni Culturali, dell'audiovisivo e del turismo. Sviluppo di relazioni commerciali con Regioni, Comuni, musei, soprintendenze, fondazioni, parchi, università e altri enti e istituzioni. Acquisizione di clienti nel settore audiovisivo e turistico, tra cui case di produzione, broadcaster, agenzie di eventi, destinazioni turistiche, parchi tematici e operatori dell'hospitality. Promozione e vendita di esperienze immersive, installazioni multimediali e contenuti XR (Extended Reality) come strumenti di attrazione, valorizzazione e generazione di ricavi. Sviluppo di opportunità commerciali attraverso gare pubbliche, affidamenti diretti e collaborazioni con enti e istituzioni. Individuazione e monitoraggio di bandi e opportunità di finanziamento pubblico, accompagnando i clienti nella definizione dei progetti e delle relative esigenze. Coordinamento con l'ufficio gare e i team tecnici per la preparazione e la presentazione delle offerte commerciali. Gestione dell'intero ciclo di vendita, dalla prospezione alla negoziazione e chiusura dei contratti. Monitoraggio della pipeline commerciale, del fatturato, dei margini e delle previsioni di vendita. Gestione delle attività nel CRM e reporting periodico alla Direzione. Requisiti: Esperienza di almeno 3 anni nella vendita, preferibilmente di soluzioni tecnologiche, servizi o progetti complessi. Esperienza commerciale nel settore audiovisivo e multimediale preferibilmente presso aziende che sviluppano e vendono esperienze, installazioni o soluzioni innovative per il turismo e la cultura. Capacità dimostrabile di acquisire nuovi clienti, gestire trattative complesse e raggiungere obiettivi commerciali. Esperienza nella gestione di cicli di vendita articolati, con interlocutori diversi e tempi di negoziazione medio-lunghi. La conoscenza del mercato della Pubblica Amministrazione, dei Beni Culturali e delle procedure di gara costituisce un importante plus. Buona conoscenza del tessuto economico e istituzionale del Nord Italia. Italiano madrelingua e conoscenza professionale dell' inglese ; la conoscenza dello spagnolo costituisce un plus. Patente B e disponibilità a trasferte frequenti sul territorio nazionale. Residenza nell'area di Milano o disponibilità a raggiungere quotidianamente la sede. Ottime capacità relazionali, negoziali e organizzative, autonomia operativa, orientamento ai risultati e attitudine allo sviluppo commerciale. Si offre: Contratto a tempo indeterminato. RAL 40.000–50.000 € lordi annui , in base all'esperienza. Incentivi commerciali senza tetto massimo , legati ai risultati di fatturato e marginalità, con liquidazione mensile. La retribuzione complessiva potrà crescere in funzione dei risultati raggiunti. Auto aziendale, PC e smartphone. Job Description Key Account Manager & Technical Lead - (Animal Health - Ruminants) Nella nostra società lavoriamo ogni giorno per migliorare la salute e il benessere degli animali attraverso soluzioni innovative, supporto scientifico e partnership di valore con i nostri clienti. Per rafforzare la nostra Business Unit Ruminants siamo alla ricerca di un/a National Key Account Manager & Technical Lea d che guiderà lo sviluppo commerciale e tecnico del business sul territorio nazionale, contribuendo alla definizione delle strategie di crescita e supportando lo sviluppo delle competenze della field force. Il Ruolo La risorsa sarà responsabile dello sviluppo e della gestione dei principali Key Account nazionali, collaborando con stakeholder interni ed esterni per massimizzare il valore generato per clienti e partner. Ricoprirà inoltre un ruolo di leadership tecnica e coaching nei confronti della rete commerciale. Responsabilità principali Sviluppare e gestire i Key Account strategici, costruendo partnership di lungo termine con clienti e stakeholder di riferimento. Definire e implementare piani commerciali e account strategy in linea con gli obiettivi della Business Unit. Analizzare mercato, trend competitivi e performance di vendita per identificare opportunità di crescita. Guidare negoziazioni commerciali complesse e iniziative di sviluppo business. Collaborare con funzioni cross-funzionali per garantire il corretto posizionamento del portafoglio prodotti. Fornire supporto tecnico-scientifico e contribuire a progetti clinici, attività formative ed eventi di settore. Sviluppare relazioni con opinion leader, università, distributori e associazioni professionali. Supportare e sviluppare la Field Force attraverso coaching, formazione e affiancamento sul territorio. Competenze ed esperienza Laurea in Medicina Veterinaria o Farmacia. Esperienza consolidata nel settore Animal Health, Healthcare o in contesti affini. Solida esperienza nella gestione di Key Account e nelle negoziazioni commerciali. Capacità di leadership, coaching e sviluppo delle persone. Spiccato orientamento al cliente e alla creazione di valore per gli stakeholder. Ottime capacità di comunicazione, networking e collaborazione cross-funzionale. Approccio analitico, orientamento ai risultati e capacità di gestione di progetti complessi. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese e disponibilità a frequenti trasferte sul territorio nazionale. Cosa offriamo Un ruolo strategico con elevata visibilità all'interno dell'organizzazione. Opportunità di contribuire alla crescita del business in un settore innovativo e in continua evoluzione. Ambiente collaborativo, orientato allo sviluppo professionale e alla valorizzazione delle competenze. Percorsi di formazione e crescita continua a livello nazionale e internazionale.
