La retribuzione annua base prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 50.000 e EUR 63.000. CCNL applicato: Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in funzione dell'esperienza e delle competenze del/la candidato/a in relazione ai requisiti del ruolo. Eventuali componenti retributive aggiuntive o variabili saranno illustrate nel corso del processo di selezione. Riassunto della posizione Per accelerare il nostro percorso di crescita in Italia, siamo alla ricerca di una persona con una solida esperienza commerciale nel settore implantare, una profonda conoscenza del mercato e un network consolidato di relazioni con i principali stakeholder. Questo ruolo è dedicato a chi ha una naturale attitudine allo sviluppo del business, sa individuare nuove opportunità prima degli altri e trasforma relazioni strategiche in risultati concreti. La persona entrerà a far parte di un team altamente performante, contribuendo direttamente all'espansione del business e all'adozione dell'intero ecosistema Straumann Group. Le principali responsabilità Sviluppare nuove opportunità di business Identificare, acquisire e sviluppare account strategici ad alto potenziale di crescita, con particolare attenzione a gruppi odontoiatrici, catene, istituzioni e opinion leader del settore. Valorizzare il proprio network professionale per creare nuove opportunità commerciali e accelerare la crescita del business. Individuare opportunità di sviluppo all'interno del territorio, anticipando i trend di mercato e i bisogni dei clienti. Costruire relazioni di lungo periodo con i decision maker, diventando un partner strategico per la crescita dei loro progetti. Guidare la crescita degli account strategici Definire piani di sviluppo personalizzati per gli account prioritari, coordinandone l'esecuzione insieme ai Territory Manager e ai Regional Sales Manager. Favorire la collaborazione tra territori e funzioni aziendali per garantire un'esperienza cliente coerente ed efficace. Supportare iniziative Enterprise Solutions contribuendo sia alla definizione della strategia sia al coordinamento dell'implementazione operativa. Promuovere l'adozione dell'intero portafoglio Straumann Group, incluse le soluzioni digitali, creando valore per clienti e pazienti. Essere protagonista della crescita di Straumann Group Condividere insight di mercato, opportunità emergenti e best practice commerciali. Collaborare con Marketing, Clinical Education, Customer Care e le altre funzioni aziendali per massimizzare l'impatto delle iniziative commerciali. Operare nel rispetto dei più elevati standard di etica, compliance e sicurezza. Il profilo che stiamo cercando Cerchiamo una persona che abbia dimostrato di saper creare crescita, sviluppare relazioni strategiche e raggiungere risultati in mercati competitivi. In Particolare possiede una consolidata esperienza commerciale nel settore implantare; conosce in modo approfondito il mercato odontoiatrico italiano e i suoi principali attori; ha sviluppato un network di relazioni di valore con clinici, gruppi odontoiatrici e stakeholder del settore; ha una forte attitudine allo sviluppo del business, all'acquisizione di nuovi clienti e alla generazione di opportunità; è orientata ai risultati, agisce con spirito imprenditoriale e assume piena responsabilità dei propri obiettivi; sa influenzare interlocutori senior attraverso credibilità, competenza e capacità negoziale; lavora efficacemente in organizzazioni matriciali, costruendo collaborazione tra team e funzioni diverse. Requisiti Almeno 10 anni di esperienza di successo nella vendita di impianti dentali o soluzioni ad alto valore aggiunto nel settore odontoiatrico. Track record documentato nello sviluppo del business e nella crescita di account strategici. Esperienza nella gestione di gruppi odontoiatrici o clienti complessi rappresenta un forte vantaggio. Buona conoscenza dei flussi digitali in odontoiatria. Familiarità con Microsoft Office e con i principali strumenti CRM. In Straumann crediamo nel valore unico di ogni persona e promuoviamo un ambiente inclusivo, aperto e rispettoso. Valorizziamo la diversità in tutte le sue forme e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte e tutti i/le professionisti qualificati/e. Operiamo nel pieno rispetto delle normative vigenti e dei principi della UNI PDR 125:2022, la prassi italiana che supporta le aziende nel promuovere e misurare la parità di genere. The Key Account Manager is responsible for managing and nurturing relationship with key accounts in dedicated area, understanding the specific needs and requirement of each account, developing strategic plans to maximize sales and profitability, work closely with internal Key Account department and local fleet manager to develop local fleet business and gather market data. Key Responsibilities: Building and maintaining relationships with clients. Identifying new business opportunities. Managing existing accounts. Meeting sales targets for region & local teams, monitoring & reporting sales targets and action plan per country. Training and managing local Key clients in designated region. Collaborating with cross-functional teams Requirements: Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field, preferably with a commercial focus. Professional Experience: extensive experience in commercial roles, preferably as a Key Account Manager within the automotive industry, leasing companies, OEMs, or related sectors, with a proven track record in business development and account management. Industry Knowledge: solid understanding of the automotive market, commercial dynamics, and strategic account management processes. Negotiation & Relationship Management: excellent negotiation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong, long-term business partnerships. Analytical & Business Skills: strong analytical mindset, results-driven approach, and ability to interpret commercial data, KPIs, and sales performance metrics. Digital Skills: excellent proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Language Skills: excellent command of English, both written and spoken, to effectively communicate with international teams and stakeholders. Ownership & Proactivity: ability to work independently, manage priorities, and take initiative, with a proactive and goal-oriented mindset. Protected Categories: applicants must belong to the protected categories under Italian Law 68/99 (Legge 68/99). What We Offer Stability & Recognition: permanent employment contract under the Italian Metalworking Industry Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria), with a competitive compensation package (Salary Range: €65,000–€75,000 + benefits). Global Mindset: opportunity to join a rapidly expanding multinational company, working in an international environment with direct interaction with European and Asian headquarters and teams. Grow with Us: opportunities for professional growth, skills development, and the chance to actively contribute to the evolution of the business. Innovation & Future Mobility: opportunity to play an active role in the transformation of the automotive industry and the future of sustainable mobility. Make an Impact: a dynamic environment where ideas, personal initiative, and an entrepreneurial mindset can make a real difference. People & Collaboration: a multicultural and collaborative workplace that encourages knowledge sharing, teamwork, and the achievement of common goals. Ownership & Empowerment: autonomy, responsibility, and the freedom to bring forward innovative ideas and solutions, making a tangible contribution to the company's performance and growth. About BYD Group: Founded in February 1995, BYD Group is a leading high-tech, multi-sector company focused on innovation and development in the automotive, rail, energy, and electronics industries. Committed to creating a better life through technological innovations, BYD Group leverages a powerful network of over 40 subsidiaries and 700,000 employees across more than 400 cities in 79 countries, actively driving the implementation of complete zero-emission and emission-reduction solutions. In 2023, BYD Auto sold 3.02 million NEVs (BEV+PHEV) globally, maintaining its position as the world leader in NEV sales. In January 2024, BYD became the official partner of UEFA EURO 2024, providing eco-friendly mobility services for the championship. BYD embraces the responsibilities and duties of this era, firmly embracing the tides of electrification and automotive intelligence, and is asserting itself as a global leader in new energy vehicles in China and around the world, paving the way for ecological innovation and development. Our goal is to build a zero-emission future that reconnects humanity with nature and a world of clean air. We are looking for talent to join this mission and make a positive impact in a diverse and dynamic world🌏. Livello retribuzione di base 65.000,00 €/yr - 75.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Hays Marco Amigoni Marco Amigoni Recruiting experts in Energy La tua nuova azienda Gruppo leader nella distribuzione di soluzioni per l’energia, con una rete capillare di punti vendita in Italia. La realtà è specializzata nella fornitura di prodotti e servizi per impianti elettrici e fotovoltaici, rivolgendosi a clienti che spaziano dal piccolo artigiano alla grande impresa. L’azienda si distingue per l’approccio consulenziale, la forte attenzione alla sostenibilità e l’orientamento all’innovazione. Il tuo nuovo ruolo Inserito/a all’interno della divisione dedicata ai sistemi di accumulo energetico, il/la Business Development Manager – Energy Storage avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare e consolidare il business ESS sul mercato italiano. La figura seguirà direttamente clienti e opportunità commerciali sul territorio nazionale, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team tecnici e service per individuare le soluzioni più adatte alle esigenze dei clienti e contribuire alla crescita della presenza aziendale sul mercato italiano. Responsabilità principali Sviluppare e gestire clienti e progetti Energy Storage System (ESS) su tutto il territorio italiano. Raccogliere e analizzare le esigenze dei clienti, collaborando con i team tecnici e service per la definizione delle soluzioni più adeguate. Gestire lo sviluppo commerciale delle opportunità, contribuendo al raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita annuali e alla crescita della quota di mercato. Analizzare le soluzioni dei competitor, le politiche di pricing e le principali strategie di mercato. Elaborare periodicamente forecast commerciali, reportistica e analisi di mercato a supporto della strategia aziendale. Rappresentare l’azienda in occasione di fiere, eventi e congressi nazionali e internazionali. Requisiti Laurea in Ingegneria Elettrica, Economia, Business Administration o formazione equivalente, preferibilmente con conoscenze in ambito elettrico ed energetico. Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ruoli di Technical Sales, Business Development, Project Development o Project Management, preferibilmente nei settori fotovoltaico, renewable energy o energy storage. Buona conoscenza del settore fotovoltaico e di componenti quali inverter e sistemi Balance of System (BOS) . Solido orientamento commerciale e capacità di sviluppare e gestire relazioni con clienti e stakeholder. Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese (C1) ; la conoscenza del cinese costituisce un plus. Buona conoscenza del pacchetto MS Office e di strumenti CRM. Disponibilità a trasferte frequenti sul territorio nazionale e internazionale. Your role Join Atlas Copco’s Journey to Market Leadership in High Pressure and Gas Applications At the beginning of 2025, Atlas Copco established dedicated sales teams to accelerate growth and strengthen its leadership in High Pressure and Gas applications. If you have a strong background in high value-added industrial sales and are eager to join a global company with a proven track record of success, this is your opportunity. This role adopts a multichannel sales approach, working in close collaboration with Atlas Copco partners across the territory. Your mission will be to drive business growth by focusing on specific applications and gas technologies. You will be a key contributor in developing High Pressure (PET) and Gas applications, including Biogas, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, and more. Your day-to-day Key Responsibilities Product Sales: Prospect, acquire, and maintain high-quality customers within the assigned area. Achieve or exceed sales targets by following a structured sales process and identifying key prospects, markets, and opportunities. Customer Engagement: Manage and develop customer relationships through regular contact, follow-ups on leads and referrals, and prompt responses to inquiries. Introduce new products and upgrades based on customer needs. Sales Execution: Prepare and present quotes, proposals, pricing, and credit terms. Ensure customer satisfaction through quality checks and proactive follow-up. Brand Representation: Maintain a professional image and actively promote Atlas Copco’s core values—Commitment, Interaction, and Innovation—to enhance the company’s reputation. Strategic Collaboration: Work closely with EPCs and OEMs. Monitor market trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities and threats. Training & Development You are expected to continuously enhance your product knowledge and sales skills through training, professional reading, networking, and participation in industry events. Reporting Prepare regular reports on sales activities, lost orders, closures, and performance against targets. Provide insights and recommendations based on field activity, including feedback on products, services, pricing, and competitive developments. Your Skills And Experience Strong entrepreneurial mindset and dynamic personality Proven leadership and negotiation skills Results-driven with a high-performance focus Solid business acumen and strategic thinking Determination and a strong growth orientation Engineering degree Minimum 5 years of direct sales experience in High Pressure or Gas applications Experience in B2B sales is a plus Willingness to take on broader responsibilities Fluency in English is mandatory We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role. Your Compensation And Benefits At Atlas Copco Group, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation. Compensation is determined based on the position and its responsibilities, without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, physical ability, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. Our compensation offering is designed to be locally relevant, competitive, and aligned with the expectations of current and future talent. Permanent contract Job classification and collective labor agreement (CCNL): White collar, from Level 3 under the Tertiary, Distribution and Services Collective Bargaining Agreement Starting salary within the relevant salary range: from EUR 31.000 gross per year Individual variable compensation Collective profit-sharing bonus Company car Flexible Benefits Platform The overall compensation package offered will be determined based on various factors, including, but not limited to, internal pay equity, level of responsibility, and the experience and skills of the selected candidate. Beyond compensation, we believe that a rewarding career is about having opportunities to learn, grow, contribute, and develop in an environment built on trust, collaboration, and continuous improvement. At Atlas Copco Group, we support our people in building long-term careers while making a meaningful impact through their work. Why it is great to work with us Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you. Application process About Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us: Talent Acquisition: Silvia Baraldo Uniting curious minds Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them. Segnala offerta di lavoro What if your next playground was to build a global, iconic Brand, with a creative machine that never sleeps, and compounds? Then you’ll love this. We’re not looking for a "Social Media Manager" to follow a calendar. We’re looking for an AI-native Creative Strategist (Brand & Content). Someone who understands that to win today, you don’t just need "content", you need a Movement. This isn’t another content job. Most content teams use AI to write captions faster. That’s the 99%. We want to be in the 0.1%: a media where AI runs the creative loop, from the signal to the hook, the cut, the post and the lesson. Every day, on every platform, in French and in English. You bring the taste. The machine you build brings the scale. Here’s the bet: a company that learns by itself grows in a way a company of people alone can’t. We aim for $10M in revenue with 10 people, each of them running a dozen agents. What Ai-native Content Means At Paradox 🤖 Paradoxically, the more AI runs our content, the more human it has to feel. AI doesn’t make more of what everyone makes. It makes more of what only we can make. Our creative machine has to be able to: Read the signals. Comments, DMs, retention graphs, saves, shares, search trends, objections from sales calls, and what the best creators and advertisers in the world are publishing right now. Hold the full context of Paradox. Our DNA, years of interviews, lives and courses, member stories, and every past post with what it taught us, in one shared company brain. Generate in our voice. Hooks, scripts, shorts, carousels, cuts, thumbnails and captions, in French and in English. Ship. Format, schedule, publish and answer, on every platform. Measure with real KPIs. Retention, shares, saves, follower growth, and the followers who become leads and members. Not likes. Learn and loop on its own. Double down on what works, kill what doesn’t, write the lesson back into the brain, and start the next cycle without waiting for a meeting. This is already real. An ads library of thousands of creatives feeds our creative research. Agents cut ads from long-form content and wire Instagram comment-to-DM automations. And our product is AI-native too: Athena, our AI coach, works with members every day. OUR MISSION At Paradox, we are convinced that greatness is trainable, and we believe self-help is broken. Most learning platforms are used the same way: consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change. People deserve more: a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them. That’s why we want to empower people at scale, by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics. We do that by merging: Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors) Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals) Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys) To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS. Short history Paradox was founded by David Laroche, a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson and Gad Elmaleh. We started in French. We’re building for the world. YOUR MISSION 🚀 You lead the Content Factory not by management, but with creativity. Your goal is to produce content that is so good, unique, and aligned with our values that people would cry if they had to unsubscribe. In a classic content team, people do the work and AI helps. Here it’s the other way round: agents do the volume, you design the machine, set the bar and make the calls. Humans do what no machine can: taste. 🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS Architect the "Dual-Brand" Strategy Build a symbiotic strategy where David Laroche’s personal brand and Paradox’s company brand reinforce each other without cannibalization. Implement radical new formats (documentaries, conceptual shorts) that shatter the boring codes of the "Self-Help" industry. Define distinct, sharp editorial lines for each platform: Depth & Search for YouTube, Aesthetic & Vibe for Instagram, and Authority & Authenticity for LinkedIn. ❌ The old way: a strategy deck written once a year, and a calendar filled by habit. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents watch every platform, every competitor and every comment continuously. They tell you which angle is rising, which format is tiring and which story our audience asks for. The strategy updates every week, on evidence. Radical Concepting & End-to-End Delivery Take responsibility for the entire production chain from hooks to storyboarding the narrative, and ensuring the final cut matches the vision. Own the packaging: titles, thumbnails and the first 3 seconds. You test variants every week and know your click-through and retention numbers by heart. Deliver what you pitch. ❌ The old way: one shoot becomes one video and a handful of posts. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: one shoot, one live or one interview becomes dozens of hooks, shorts, carousels and ad cuts by the next morning, in both languages. Concepts are tested with AI-generated drafts before we spend a day shooting them. Build the Content Factory: humans and agents Your taste becomes the eval. You write down what makes a great hook, a great cut, a great carousel and a great story, in rules and examples the agents check themselves against. Each time you reject something, the reason goes back into the rules. Act as the final quality check: nothing gets published if it doesn’t meet the "Paradox Standard" of aesthetics and storytelling, whether a person or an agent made it. ❌ The old way: a creative team briefs an editor, waits three days and gets two versions. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents draft, cut, caption, translate and schedule. You keep the best, and next week their first drafts are already closer to your bar. Fuel the Growth Engine Analyze retention graphs, CTR, and CPL to iterate based on feedback, killing what fails and aggressively scaling what works. ❌ The old way: someone pulls the stats at the end of the month and nobody changes anything. 🏴‍☠️ At Paradox: agents read the numbers of every post every day, explain why it worked or didn’t, and propose the next test. You measure the machine itself: posts per week, time from idea to live, hit rate, and the share of the work done without a human. Go global, and keep the soul We started in French. You build the machine that takes Paradox to English-speaking audiences: channels, formats and voice that feel native, not translated. And always: real stories told with consent, no fake claims, no fake scarcity. The machine can scale, but it doesn’t decide what’s right. You do. How you’ll know you’re AI-native: you spend your time on concepts, taste and calls, not on resizing, captioning and exporting. The output grows every month while the team doesn’t. THE IDEAL AI NATIVE CANDIDATE 😍 Experience : Proven Content Builder: You have successfully grown a media brand, a YouTube channel, or a personal brand to significant scale (100k+ followers or millions of views). You understand the mechanics of virality and retention. You’ve created at least one format that broke out, and you can show its click-through and retention numbers. Elite Scripting Skills: You can show us scripts you wrote that performed. You know how to structure a narrative, write a hook that stops the scroll, and keep an audience engaged for 20+ minutes. Performance Fluency: You have worked in environments where content had to drive business results (ads, launches, conversion), not just vanity metrics. AI-native Creative: you’ve built content pipelines with AI yourself: Claude Code, automations, generative video, image and voice tools, evals. Show us something you built, not a certificate. Traits : Intolerant to Mediocrity: You have "Taste." You are physically pained by a bad font, a clumsy cut, or a weak headline. You fight for the details that others ignore, including in what AI produces. Psychology Obsessed: You don’t just "make content"; you study human nature. You constantly ask why people click, why they share, and what emotion drives them. A "Doer" with Authority: You command respect not by title, but by competence. You can jump into a project, write the script, direct the shoot, and fix the edit if needed. Loop thinker: you see every platform as a loop that can learn, and you can’t stop yourself from closing it. No Ego, Just Impact: You don’t fall in love with your ideas. You accept that even the best concepts can flop. When it happens, you don’t take it personally; you analyze the data, pivot immediately, and ship the next concept with renewed energy. Language French: Native / Bilingual English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues. Our chosen language for written communication is English. IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU ❌ If you need clarity before chaos: wrong place. ❌ If you prefer balance over intensity: wrong season. ❌ If you don’t genuinely care about the topics we cover: wrong place. ❌ If you want to strategize without getting your hands dirty in scripting, directing, or the editing suite: wrong role. ❌ If you think AI content means generic content: wrong role. We use AI to multiply what only we can make. ❌ If you want to manage a large team: we’d rather build the machine than grow the headcount. WHY JOIN US ❤️ Help us market a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow. Build one of the first truly AI-native media, and write the playbook others will copy. Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact. You’ll compete with San Francisco companies. Growth & Ambition > 🏅 Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform Competitive Salary But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want… Impact & Meaning > Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people > Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something! We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives. But that’s not all, we believe that driven people deserve… Freedom & Well Being 🗽 > 😎 A company culture based on autonomy & accountability > 🗽 Flexible working hours (but very hard working) > 🌎 A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want > 🧍‍♀️ Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices > 💻 Work on Mac, for us it counts :) > 🏀 350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself (for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great) > 📚 150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that > 🔥 Access to Athena - our Paradox AI Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life How To Apply 📃 ⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️ If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀 HIRING PROCESS 📃 That job description resonated with you? Here is your tailor made hiring process 📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey, with links to content you made and something you built with AI 💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions 💻 A 1h video call, to discuss how you’d fit into Paradox’s content team 💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset 💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss the creative vision and the next milestones to build 💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding 🫵🚀 Welcome aboard! About Our Hiring Process Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in. We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you. If you’re not joining to post content. If you’re here to build a media that changes how millions of people grow. Welcome to Paradox. Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness. You will combine product ownership, stakeholder management, and delivery leadership to drive successful implementation and long-term value, while defining the roadmap and ongoing evolution of the CaaS capability. Your Key Responsibilities Lead the adoption and enablement of Adobe across Global Talent, ensuring alignment with business priorities and user needs. Partner with Global Talent, Enterprise Technology, Adobe, and project teams to deliver a scalable end-to-end content ecosystem. Own and maintain the product roadmap and prioritised backlog, balancing business priorities, user needs, technical requirements, and strategic objectives. Translate business requirements into practical solutions that improve efficiency, governance, and employee experience. Oversee solution development, configuration, testing, implementation, and transition into business-as-usual operations. Assess business impacts of platform changes, ensuring risks, dependencies, and downstream effects are understood and managed. Drive governance across content lifecycle processes, including creation, review, publication, maintenance, and retirement. Lead the evolution of content models, taxonomy, metadata standards, and information architecture to improve search, personalisation, governance, and content discoverability. Evaluate and prioritise enhancement opportunities to maximise value, adoption, and operational effectiveness. Identify and shape future platform capabilities, including AI-enabled content experiences, enterprise search, personalisation, and integration with broader Talent technology platforms. Support release readiness and deployment decisions, ensuring appropriate controls, training, documentation, and support models are in place. Skills And Attributes For Success Strong product mindset with the ability to connect technology capabilities to business outcomes. Experience managing product roadmaps, backlogs, and prioritisation decisions within an Agile delivery environment. Strong understanding of content governance, information architecture, taxonomy, metadata, and content lifecycle management. Ability to balance competing stakeholder priorities and make value-based product decisions. Excellent stakeholder management skills with the confidence to influence across functions, teams, and geographies. Ability to navigate ambiguity and make informed decisions in complex and fast-moving environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, balancing strategic thinking with practical delivery. Proven ability to translate technical concepts into clear business recommendations. Highly collaborative approach with a passion for improving employee and customer experiences. Ideally, you'll also Bring experience delivering Adobe Digital Experience Platform components within a large global organisation. Have expertise in content management strategy, governance, and best practices. Experience with enterprise content management, digital asset management, or knowledge management platforms. Understanding of AI-enabled content experiences, enterprise search, and personalisation capabilities. Understand enterprise-scale technology implementations involving multiple vendors and stakeholder groups. What We Look For We're looking for someone who combines strong product ownership with a passion for transformation and continuous improvement. Descrizione dell'azienda Publicis Groupe Fondata nel 1926 da Marcel Bleustein-Blanchet, Publicis Groupe è oggi il primo gruppo di comunicazione nel mondo. Presente in Italia con 3 sedi (Milano, Torino e Roma) e oltre 1500 professionisti, il gruppo agisce come partner strategico per la crescita dei suoi clienti offrendo un’ampia gamma di competenze e soluzioni integrate nelle diverse aree della creatività, media, produzione e business transformation. Zenith , parte di Publicis Groupe, è The ROI Agency – una posizione che rivendichiamo con orgoglio dal 2005. Nel tempo, abbiamo evoluto il significato stesso di ROI, adattandolo alla crescente complessità del panorama della comunicazione. Oggi, ROI non è solo Return on Investment, ma anche Return on Imagination : esperienze integrate e innovative che ispirano la crescita. Crescita per il business dei nostri clienti, crescita per le nostre persone, crescita per la nostra cultura. Publicis Groupe è l’unico player del settore capace di accompagnare i brand nel loro percorso di trasformazione digitale, ovunque nel mondo. Panoramica La persona, inserita nel ruolo di International Digital Media Specialist , sarà responsabile della gestione delle attività programmatic per uno dei clienti chiave dell'agenzia. All’interno di un consolidato team di media planning e digital activation multi-country, la figura si occuperà della gestione delle attività digital media (media planning, programmatic & social activation) per uno dei clienti globali più importanti dell’agenzia . La persona ideale, debitamente seguito dal proprio manager di riferimento e dalla figura lead della Unit, ha la capacità di supportare il cliente con un approccio consulenziale, identificando opportunità di innovazione e contribuendo allo sviluppo delle strategie media. È una persona curiosa e dinamica , che si sente a suo agio in un ambiente internazionale ed ama interfacciarsi con diversi team sia interni che esterni all’agenzia, per seguire attività media in lingua inglese su diversi mercati in Europa e Nord America . La persona scelta sarà responsabile della pianificazione, dell'ottimizzazione e del monitoraggio quotidiano delle campagne, nonché dell'analisi delle performance e dell'elaborazione di insight a supporto del raggiungimento degli obiettivi di business. Responsabilità Sviluppo di media plan digitali in linea con il brief del Cliente, avendo cura di portare risultati e innovazione nell’approccio alla pianificazione; Impostazione delle campagne sulle piattaforme digitali programmatic e social (DV360, Meta Business Manager, TikTok…) Monitoring continuo delle performance giornaliere, al fine di ottimizzare la delivery e identificare potenziali opportunità di miglioramento dei KPI Sviluppo di report accurati e di dettaglio, che possano evidenziare i risultati delle campagne e fornire raccomandazioni per le pianificazioni future Aggiornamento continuo sulle evoluzioni del digital advertising sulle principali piattaforme, per identificare nuove opportunità per il Cliente global e proporre A/B test, nuovi formati ecc. Collaborazione con i principali stakeholder interni ed esterni, inclusi team interni di altre country. Qualifiche Da 1 a 4 anni di esperienza nella gestione di campagne media programmatic e/o social, preferibilmente in contesto internazionale; Conoscenza delle principali piattaforme digitali (es. DV360, Meta Business Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Business Center) con un forte approccio hands-on; Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con attitudine a interagire efficacemente con stakeholder interni ed esterni; Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e con cura, gestendo le attività assegnate nel rispetto di tempistiche, procedure, linee guida e best practice condivise; Attitudine positiva e curiosa, propensione all’apprendimento di nuove skills e voglia di andare a fondo a tematiche di diversa natura, per venire incontro a nuove esigenze di business del Cliente o per risolvere eventuali problematiche tecniche; Precisione e attenzione al dettaglio, proattività e predisposizione al lavoro di squadra; Capacità di lavorare con team interni, colleghi provenienti da paesi stranieri e partner/fornitori esterni; Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese sia scritta che parlata, per gestire in autonomia conversazioni con colleghi internazionali, clienti e fornitori; Competenza nell’analisi dei KPI media digital Buona conoscenza di Excel e Power Point. Nice-to-have Esperienza nella gestione di campagne media legate al mondo lusso, retail, CPL e drive-to-store; Buona conoscenza dei sistemi di tracciamento (ad server) e dei tool di ad verification (es. IAS, DoubleVerify) Informazioni aggiuntive Ci impegniamo a creare un contesto in cui le persone possano sviluppare il proprio potenziale e costruire un percorso di crescita nel tempo. Cosa Offriamo Sviluppo continuo: percorsi di formazione e sviluppo personalizzati, accessibili in ogni fase della carriera Cultura della crescita: progetti stimolanti e contesto collaborativo, orientato all’innovazione People care: promuoviamo iniziative dedicate al benessere fisico e mentale e a una cultura di collaborazione e rispetto reciproco Retribuzione Fascia retributiva (RAL lorda annua): €28.000 – €38.000 Il range retributivo è definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutrali, tra cui responsabilità del ruolo, competenze richieste, livello organizzativo, benchmark di mercato e coerenza interna. La fascia salariale è quella prevista alla data di pubblicazione dell’annuncio; l’azienda si riserva la possibilità di aggiornarla. Inclusione e Pari Opportunità Il presente annuncio è rivolto a candidati di qualsiasi genere, età e nazionalità, nel rispetto delle normative vigenti in materia di pari opportunità e non discriminazione. Il motto di Publicis Groupe è “ Viva La Différence ”. Promuoviamo processi di selezione inclusivi e non discriminatori: job title, criteri di valutazione e linguaggio sono formulati in modo neutro e coerente con il principio di pari opportunità. Soudal è il più grande produttore indipendente europeo di sigillanti, adesivi e schiume poliuretaniche per il settore delle costruzioni, dell'industria e del fai-da-te. In un contesto di continua crescita e sviluppo del brand, siamo alla ricerca di una figura giovane, dinamica e creativa da inserire all'interno dell'ufficio Marketing di Soudal Italia. Il ruolo Cerchiamo un/una Junior Graphic & Digital Marketing Specialist che sappia coniugare competenze grafiche e digitali. La risorsa collaborerà attivamente con il team Marketing nella realizzazione dei materiali di comunicazione aziendale, sia cartacei sia digitali, contribuendo allo sviluppo dell'immagine del brand e della presenza sui canali social. Si tratta di una figura versatile, con forte predisposizione all'apprendimento e alla crescita professionale, destinata a diventare parte integrante del team marketing. Principali responsabilità Attività grafiche Impaginazione e aggiornamento di cataloghi, brochure e listini. Realizzazione di materiale promozionale e pubblicitario per stampa e digitale. Creazione di locandine, flyer, banner, schede prodotto e presentazioni aziendali. Supporto nello sviluppo grafico di campagne marketing e attività promozionali. Preparazione di materiali per eventi, fiere e iniziative commerciali. Attività digital e social media Collaborazione con il Marketing nella definizione e gestione del piano editoriale. Creazione di contenuti visivi per i canali social aziendali. Produzione e montaggio di video brevi per social media, campagne e attività promozionali. Gestione operativa delle piattaforme Meta (Facebook e Instagram) e degli altri canali digitali aziendali. Monitoraggio delle performance dei contenuti e supporto alle attività di social media marketing. Supporto all'aggiornamento dei contenuti digitali aziendali. Requisiti Hard Skills Ottima conoscenza della Adobe Creative Suite , in particolare: Photoshop Illustrator InDesign Buona conoscenza delle principali piattaforme social e degli strumenti di gestione Meta. Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Microsoft Office , con particolare riferimento a: PowerPoint Word Excel Conoscenza delle logiche di comunicazione digitale e social media marketing. Capacità di realizzare contenuti foto e video destinati al web e ai social network. Soft Skills Creatività e attenzione ai dettagli. Capacità organizzative e gestione delle priorità. Attitudine al lavoro in team. Proattività e spirito di iniziativa. Interesse per i temi legati alla comunicazione, al marketing e al digital. Voglia di crescere professionalmente all'interno di un contesto internazionale. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale Esperienza, anche breve o di stage, in ambito grafico, comunicazione o marketing digitale. Conoscenza di software per video editing come Premiere Pro o software equivalenti Esperienza nella gestione di pagine social aziendali. Conoscenza di strumenti di analisi delle performance social e digital. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in un'azienda multinazionale in forte crescita. Affiancamento continuo da parte dell'ufficio Marketing. Percorso di formazione e sviluppo professionale. Possibilità di lavorare su progetti che spaziano dal marketing tradizionale al digital. Ambiente giovane, dinamico e orientato all'innovazione. Segnala offerta di lavoro At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Data-driven campaign management. Own acquisition campaigns for a product end to end—from hypothesis to launch, to iteration—running structured data-driven retrospectives to extract learnings and translating them into new creative solutions. Content creation. Leverage AI tools to produce high-performing, cross-channel visual content, directing hand-picked creators and writing tailored briefs to deliver the right message to each audience. Channels and partnerships. Coordinate the execution of campaigns across in-house production, external contributors, and client-facing advertising partnerships, working closely with creative, marketing, and business teams. Trend monitoring. Track social media trends, competitor activity, and emerging creative practices to stay ahead of the curve. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £47,660 to £68,579 in London and from €46,027 to €66,065 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £151,436 in London or €145,430 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time. Location Milan (Italy), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland). The selection process In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process. Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject. All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here. We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times. We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form. Before you apply If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again. Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment. To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage. If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you. Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Humanitas Melania Mignano Melania Mignano 📍 Sede di lavoro: Assago - Centro Direzionale 📄 Tipologia contrattuale: Tempo indeterminato - full time Perché Humanitas Scegliere Humanitas significa entrare in un contesto in cui la qualità della cura si costruisce ogni giorno attraverso competenza clinica, innovazione e lavoro di squadra dove ciascuno contribuisce al percorso di cura dei pazienti. Chi siamo Il Gruppo Humanitas, riferimento di eccellenza per la salute, la prevenzione e la diagnosi, è presente in Italia con 12 ospedali ad alta specializzazione, 25 Medical Care – la nostra rete di centri medici e punti prelievo, un Centro di Ricerca e Humanitas University, ateneo internazionale dedicato alle life sciences. Ogni anno, oltre 1.300.000 pazienti scelgono di affidarsi agli specialisti delle nostre strutture presenti in Lombardia, Piemonte e Sicilia. Il contesto All'interno della Direzione Digital, stiamo sviluppando un programma di trasformazione digitale con l'obiettivo di migliorare l'esperienza dei pazienti, ottimizzare i processi aziendali e introdurre nuove soluzioni basate sull'intelligenza artificiale e sull'automazione. Siamo alla ricerca di una persona che contribuisca all'analisi dei dati digitali e allo sviluppo di soluzioni di automazione, trasformando dati e processi in opportunità concrete di miglioramento, nello specifico occupandosi di: Digital Analytics & Reporting: raccogliere e analizzare dati provenienti dai canali digitali, sviluppando dashboard e report per monitorare KPI e performance. Patient Behaviour Analysis: analizzare i comportamenti dei pazienti sui canali digitali, individuando punti di abbandono e opportunità per migliorare esperienza, engagement e conversione. Data Analysis & Development: sviluppare query, script e flussi di elaborazione per integrare i dati, automatizzare le analisi e rendere disponibili informazioni affidabili. Process Automation: supportare lo sviluppo e la manutenzione di soluzioni di robotic process automation (RPA), contribuendo a migliorare l'efficienza dei processi aziendali. Business Analysis: collaborare con gli stakeholder per comprendere esigenze, analizzare processi e individuare opportunità di analisi e automazione. La persona che cerchiamo ha un connubio di: Requisiti e competenze tecniche: Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria, Informatica, Matematica o discipline affini; 2–4 anni di esperienza in ambito Data Analytics, Digital Analytics, Data Engineering o sviluppo di soluzioni di automazione. Buona conoscenza di SQL e capacità di estrarre, trasformare e analizzare dati provenienti da fonti diverse. Conoscenza di Python o di un linguaggio equivalente per lo sviluppo di script e l'automazione delle attività. Esperienza con strumenti di Business Intelligence e data visualization, preferibilmente Microsoft Power BI. Familiarità con strumenti di Robotic Process Automation (RPA). Attitudini e competenze comportamentali: Capacità di tradurre requisiti di business in specifiche funzionali e tecniche; attitudine al problem solving e alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e di business: capacità di analizzare dati e processi e di tradurre i risultati in proposte di miglioramento; buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Costituiscono titolo preferenziale l'esperienza in digital analytics, web tracking ed event tracking, la conoscenza di servizi cloud per l'elaborazione dei dati e l'esperienza in progetti di automazione. Cosa offriamo: retribuzione fissa compresa in un range tra €32.000 - €40.000 lordi annui; compenso variabile compreso in un range tra €3.000 - €6.000; un programma di wellbeing che include anche iniziative dedicate alla salute fisica e psicologica; strumenti concreti per la conciliazione vita-lavoro, tra cui misure a sostegno della genitorialità e sostenibilità finanziaria; percorsi di formazione per valorizzare talenti e competenze in un contesto dinamico e innovativo. L'offerta è rivolta a candidati nel rispetto del Dlgs 198/2006 e dei Dlgs 215/2003 e 216/2003. 3 e 216/2003. About The Company EXTE is a leading AdTech platform, specializing in video, content, and performance. Our mission is to design comprehensive advertising solutions based on creativity and technology to ensure brand value within the advertising ecosystem and relevance for agencies, media, and users; offering advertisers the right audience in a safe and brand privacy-respecting environment. We want to be the trusted partner of brands, amplifying their stories across media through enriching advertising experiences that challenge convention and raise industry standards. THE ROLE Based in EXTE Italy, the Operations Content specialist will manage the operational lifecycle of campaigns once a sale has been agreed. This role is the post-sale owner of branded content campaigns, responsible for turning signed opportunities into smoothly delivered, measurable campaigns. This is a hands-on, client- and account-focused farmer role: building strong working relationships, protecting and growing existing business through excellent service, and ensuring every campaign is briefed, planned, activated, monitored, reported and closed with care. The Responsibilities End-to-end campaign and account management Own the post-sale process for branded content campaigns, from receipt and validation of the client brief through planning, setup, activation, optimisation, reporting and campaign wrap-up. Act as a reliable day-to-day contact for existing clients and internal sales teams, maintaining clear communication, setting expectations and proactively sharing progress updates. Translate campaign objectives and briefs into clear operational requirements, coordinating timelines, assets, formats, targeting, tracking and delivery specifications. Campaign execution, delivery and performance Coordinate campaign setup and activation across the relevant platforms, teams and partners, ensuring all campaign elements are ready to launch on time. Monitor pacing, delivery and agreed KPIs; identify risks or under-delivery early and ensuring that changes, optimisations and client requests are properly assessed, communicated and implemented. Prepare and deliver campaign reports, translating performance data into clear insights, learnings and actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders. Revenue support and account development Help protect and grow revenue from existing accounts by ensuring a strong post-sale experience, identifying follow-on needs and flagging opportunities to the sales team. Maintain regular account follow-ups and activity reporting, ensuring that open actions, campaign milestones and potential issues are visible and addressed. The Requirements 2/4 years of experience in digital media, campaign management, ad operations, media agency operations, branded content or a similar client-facing operational role. A good understanding of the digital advertising ecosystem and the basic mechanics of campaign planning, buying and delivery; familiarity with DSPs and programmatic advertising is important. Knowledge of branded content and how content-led advertising campaigns are planned, executed and measured in digital environments. A practical understanding of the campaign lifecycle, from brief and booking through setup, trafficking, delivery monitoring, reporting and billing. Comfortable working with campaign data, delivery metrics and KPIs, with the ability to interpret results and turn them into meaningful insights. Confident user of Excel and/or Google Sheets; experience with dashboards, reporting tools and advertising platforms (e.g. Google Ads, Meta, DV360 or similar) is an advantage. Strong organization and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills, with a proactive, service-minded and detail-oriented approach. Fluent Italian and English are essential, both written and spoken. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro In Mavriq , parte di Moltiply Group, aiutiamo le persone a fare la scelta giusta, che si tratti di un mutuo, un'assicurazione, una fornitura di energia, un piano telefonico o dell'acquisto di un nuovo prodotto. Con i nostri comparatori italiani (tra cui MutuiOnline.it, Segugio.it, SOStariffe.it, Trovaprezzi.it e Switcho ) e internazionali (come LeLynx.fr, Rastreator.com, Pricewise.nl e Verivox.de ), offriamo chiarezza in mercati spesso complessi e poco trasparenti. Crediamo nel potere dei dati, nella trasparenza e nell'innovazione. Perché cambiare le regole, quando non funzionano al meglio, è nel nostro DNA! Posizione: Per il nostro team SEO siamo alla ricerca di una persona neolaureata, o alle prime esperienze professionali, che voglia costruire il proprio percorso professionale all'incrocio tra SEO/GEO, dati e Intelligenza Artificiale . Entrerai a far parte di un team SEO tecnico, dove avrai l'opportunità di imparare sul campo e acquisire progressivamente autonomia nella gestione di progetti strategici per il business. Lavorerai sull'ottimizzazione della visibilità delle nostre property digitali sia sui motori di ricerca tradizionali , come Google e Bing, sia all'interno dei nuovi ecosistemi di ricerca e risposta basati su AI generativa e Large Language Models , come ChatGPT, Gemini, o Copilot. Non cerchiamo necessariamente una persona che sappia già fare tutto. Cerchiamo soprattutto curiosità, solide capacità analitiche, interesse per il digital e voglia di sperimentare con le nuove tecnologie . Cosa offriamo Crediamo che la crescita nasca dall’incontro tra curiosità e autonomia. Offriamo un ambiente ibrido e flessibile, formazione continua e spazio per sperimentare, imparare e migliorare. Lavorerai in un team con cui condividerai successi, affronterai sfide e raggiungerai risultati. A completare il quadro, una RAL compresa tra i 25.000-30.000K, e un pacchetto di benefit solido: variabile, assicurazione sanitaria (CCNL Commercio), buoni pasto, welfare, e accesso a piattaforme di e-learning. Dove lavorerai La nostra sede è in Via Desenzano 2, Milano (MM1 Gambara). Lavoriamo in modalità ibrida: almeno due giorni a settimana in ufficio e fino a tre in smart working. I momenti in presenza sono fondamentali per confrontarci, scambiare idee e alimentare la cultura di squadra che ci distingue. Responsabilità Insieme al team lavorerai su attività di: SEO e contenuti: analisi, scrittura, revisione e ottimizzazione di contenuti e pagine web per migliorarne rilevanza e visibilità organica; Technical SEO: analisi e ottimizzazione delle property aziendali, lavorando su aspetti come crawling, indexing, internal linking, dati strutturati e altri elementi tecnici che influenzano la capacità dei motori di ricerca di comprendere e valorizzare un sito; GEO & Generative AI: studio e sperimentazione di tecniche per migliorare la presenza dei nostri brand e contenuti anche all'interno delle risposte generate da LLM e AI searchengine, analizzando come contenuti e fonti vengono interpretati, citati e utilizzati dai nuovi sistemi di ricerca; Analisi e monitoraggio: monitoraggio delle performance attraverso strumenti interni ed esterni, individuando trend, opportunità e aree di miglioramento; Reporting e KPI: manutenzione ed evoluzione della reportistica SEO e sviluppo di nuovi KPI utili a misurare anche la visibilità all'interno dei nuovi ecosistemi di ricerca AI; AI automation: progettazione di workflow basati su AI e LLM per automatizzare o velocizzare attività SEO, dall'analisi dei dati alla produzione e revisione dei contenuti, fino al monitoraggio e alla reportistica; Sperimentazione: test di nuovi strumenti, modelli e approcci legati alla Generative AI, contribuendo a capire come integrarli concretamente nei processi del team. Requisiti: Laurea, preferibilmente in discipline scientifiche, quantitative, economiche o digitali , e hai voglia di iniziare o consolidare il tuo percorso professionale nell'ambito SEO; Esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti universitari o personali, con prompting, LLM o workflow AI; Interesse per il funzionamento dei motori di ricerca e per i principi di crawling, indexing e ranking e perl'evoluzione della ricerca verso AI search, Generative AI e Large Language Models ; Capacità di analizzare dati e trasformarli in insight e azioni concrete; Sensibilità verso la scrittura e l'ottimizzazione di contenuti digitali; Interesse per la costruzione di automazioni, agenti o workflow in grado di integrare modelli AI nelle attività quotidiane; Precisione, capacità organizzative e attitudine al problem solving; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Utile avere già familiarità con alcuni degli strumenti utilizzati in ambito SEO e digitalanalytics, come Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Data Studio, Semrush, Sistrix, Similarweb, ScreamingFrog oBotify , così come con strumenti di Generative AI quali ChatGPT, Gemini e Microsoft Copilot . Costituiscono un plus Conoscenza di altre lingue europee come spagnolo / francese / tedesco / olandese Conoscenza di base di HTML e CSS;Familiarità con Schema.org e JSON-LD. Altre informazioni: In Mavriq non diamo nulla per scontato: pensiamo, testiamo, impariamo. Ogni giorno è un giorno uno, e ogni sfida è un’occasione per migliorare. Se ti rivedi in questo approccio, non vediamo l’ora di conoscerti. (La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle Leggi n. 903/77 e n. 125/91.) Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. That is the whole job. Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business. So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face. At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero. You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end. Here is what "end to end" actually means. You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result. You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme. You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number. You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output. If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast. If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading. Requirements What the job looks like Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt You are a fit if You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too You are not a fit if "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed You want to be told what to do this week You need a ticketing system to know what matters You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question Benefits Why this role is exciting This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency. You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale. You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident. You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Who We Are At BCG Platinion, we close the gap between strategy and technology. We design and build AI tech strategies, AI solutions, and next-generation platform architectures that turn ambition into execution, turning buzzwords into a true business engine and real competitive advantage. Working at the intersection of boardroom strategy and hands-on tech delivery, we help leading organizations tackle their toughest challenges, with access to C-suite leaders and the unmatched resources of BCG. What You'll Do Independently contribute to building and deepening close client relationships, and as their trusted advisor, be the first to whom they turn Acquire new projects and challenges for our company on his/her own Be in charge of planning, leadership, and quality assurance for strategic IT projects and work with passion for our clients' long-term success Use a comprehensive knowledge of technology and the industry to provide both internal and external stakeholders with the orientation they need in critical project phases and situations Think across projects and connecting factors, and plan resources with a clear view to their effectiveness Take responsibility for presenting key project results at the highest level of client management Work with entrepreneurial passion to advance BCG Platinion with personal contributions to people development, recruiting, and practice areas What You'll Bring Degree in computer science, (business) informatics, or a related discipline with higher-than-average grades At least twelve years of relevant experience in IT consulting and the lead design and management of IT implementation and strategy projects Relevant experience in Media & Telecommunication Project-related management experience of teams with more than five people Knowledge of how to plan IT initiatives and build solid business cases Even in complex organizational structures, effectively steer decisions toward the goal and master escalating situations with an eye to solutions To have successfully acquired consulting projects Good at understanding and communicating complex topics in both Italian and English Who You'll Work With We make sure you never stop growing. You'll tackle exciting, high-impact challenges every day, supported by a passionate team of talented colleagues who share your drive for excellence and keep connect long after your case wraps up. Our collaborative, open culture gives you the freedom to explore and perfect your strengths, backed by individual learning opportunities and recognized certifications. Additional info At BCG Platinion, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an essential role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development. That's why we generally operate on a hybrid model, with office presence shaped by business needs, team norms, and local policies and practices. We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork. Compensation Information Total compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, and a market-leading benefits package described below. Our Reward Philosophy is to take a holistic approach to offer a comprehensive package which includes market-competitive base salary, discretionary performance bonus and strong benefits that are locally relevant and support both physical and mental health. Our philosophy drives our actions and aims at being competitive, fair and easy for employees to understand. We are committed to ensuring that BCG Platinion is the best place for you to thrive and grow. The base salary range for this role is EUR 114.000,00 - EUR 122.000,00 . This is an estimated range. Any final offer would be based on objective, role-related criteria such as your relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated skills. Employees may also be eligible for an annual discretionary performance bonus. BCG Platinion offers a best-in-class benefits package designed to provide comprehensive care and meaningful support to you and your family. Segnala offerta di lavoro Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid) We Are RTB House is a next-generation performance demand-side platform (DSP) that uses proprietary Deep Learning AI algorithms to help brands grow. The company is the market leader in driving performance using Deep Learning across the entire purchase funnel. Founded in 2012 and now operating in 90+ markets, RTB House has always been private-by-design. It embraces first-party advertising and a relentless approach to innovation. RTB House offers end-to-end Deep Learning-powered AdTech products and solutions to maximize conversion, drive new customer acquisition, create engagement, and fuel long-term demand for a global base of clients. In 2026, RTB House launched rtb.com, a self-service platform specifically designed to allow small and medium-sized businesses and agencies to deploy auto-built creatives and maximize performance on any budget. Our Italian team consists of 23 people and is an integral part of our company’s EMEA presence. We combine local expertise with our broader company vision, ensuring innovative solutions that align with diverse market needs. The Account Management Team is at the heart of our success. We work hand in hand with clients to maximize campaign performance and expand partnerships, playing a crucial role in both revenue growth ( upselling & cross-selling ) and building long-term relationships. Why RTB House? If you’re looking for a place where you can combine your analytical mindset, commercial drive, and ability to build strong client relationships - becoming a trusted advisor and valued partner - RTB House could be the right fit for you! You Will Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic client accounts, ensuring long-term success and satisfaction; Strengthen client relationships through regular presentations, performance reviews, and in-person meetings; Identify growth opportunities and maximize revenue via upsell and cross-sell initiatives; Conduct in-depth campaign analysis, translating data into actionable insights and recommendations; Build tailored strategies aligned with client goals; Collaborate closely with Sales and Technical Account Management teams to ensure smooth onboarding and ongoing support; Monitor key KPIs and campaign margins, proactively suggesting optimizations; Obtain, review and process campaign orders; ensure timely payments for our services. Desired Experience 8+ years of experience in digital advertising; Preferably experience working in AdTech within DSPs, agencies, or advertisers (performance and/or awareness campaigns); Strong analytical and reporting skills, with Excel and PowerPoint proficiency; Proven ability to manage clients directly and drive commercial opportunities; Excellent communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders; A consultative mindset: understanding client needs and translating them into actionable solutions; Results-driven, proactive, and problem-solving approach; High level of motivation, willingness to learn and a positive, can-do attitude; Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; Fluency in Italian and English (C1 level); Based in Milan. We Offer A unique chance to join one of the most dynamic players in digital advertising (1000+ specialists in 30+ markets, 3,000+ live campaigns worldwide); Competitive package: base salary + bonus, meal vouchers, personal development budget; Hybrid working model promoting real work-life balance; An amazing onboarding process to make sure you are equipped with all the necessary knowledge and tools to excel; Unique learning opportunities from commercial and HQ business support teams; Numerous opportunities to build your own path of self-development; Team building events and trips away! Work in a truly international environment with dynamic people in one of the fastest-growing segments of online advertising! The base salary range for this position is €58,000 - €75,000 gross per year + variable, determined on the basis of objective and gender-neutral criteria. This position is governed by the National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL) for the Commerce Sector - Confcommercio (CNEL H011) and is classified at quadro . Apply now! You don't need to tick every box to apply. If you are passionate about digital marketing, send us your CV, and we'll review it. Il/La candidato/a avrà i seguenti requisiti: Laurea in Marketing, Comunicazione, Economia, Management o discipline affini; Esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ruoli di marketing e comunicazione, preferibilmente in contesti aziendali strutturati; Buone capacità di scrittura e comunicazione, con esperienza nella realizzazione di contenuti e materiali promozionali; Conoscenza degli strumenti di digital marketing, dei principali social network e delle piattaforme CMS, preferibilmente WordPress; Familiarità con strumenti di grafica e video editing, quali Canva e CapCut; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, almeno a livello B2; Buone capacità organizzative e di gestione autonoma delle attività e dei progetti, nel rispetto delle priorità e delle scadenze; Disponibilità a effettuare trasferte sul territorio nazionale e, occasionalmente, internazionale.
