Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Senior Manager - Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration Technology Stiamo cercando una figura di Senior Manager da inserire nel team Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration Technology di Deloitte nella sede di Milano, che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid. Il team si occupa di supportare i clienti Corporate e Private Equity, italiani e internazionali, offrendo servizi su misura in contesti nazionali e internazionali per Operazioni di finanza straordinaria (M&A), in in cui diamo supporto per le tematiche ICT su tutto il ciclo di vita del deal, dalla M&A Strategy alle IT/Tech/Operational Due Diligence, fino all'esecuzione di progetti di integrazione e/o separazione del target. Your Role Il ruolo di Senior Manager in Deloitte ricopre un ruolo strategico: oltre a guidare un team, condividendo il suo know-how e approccio, sarà responsabile della gestione delle relazioni con il cliente e potrà mettere in campo le sue competenze per favorire lo sviluppo del business. La risorsa si occuperà di supportare i clienti nazionali e internazionali riguardo operazioni di finanza straordinaria sia per gli ambiti di analisi legati alla tecnologia (IT Due diligence) sia per le operazioni specifiche del settore Technology (Tech M&A) fornendo supporto end to end su tutto il ciclo di vita del deal. Nello Specifico Identificazione delle aree di valore guidate dalla tecnologia all’interno della strategia di M&A; Valutazione di potenziali deal, tramite l’analisi dell’ambiente tecnologico e del supporto dato dall’IT alle performance aziendali e al business plan; Design delle componenti IT per l’esecuzione di piani di separazione e integrazione aziendale; Analisi delle macro-componenti architetturali, infrastrutturali, di codice e strategiche di business per piattaforme e soluzioni/prodotti tecnologici; Business Transformation: Design delle iniziative di trasformazione IT e strategiche a supporto della crescita, con relativa quantificazione dei benefici sul P&L e Cash Flow. What We Offer La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra EUR 85,000 e EUR 90,000 lordi annui per il grade Senior Manager. L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL per i Dirigenti di aziende commerciali, distribuzione e Servizi. La definizione del compenso specifico, inclusi eventuali elementi variabili (come MBO) o benefit accessori, dipenderà dalla valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. Winning Requirements Laurea Magistrale in materie discipline STEM o economico - finanziarie; Esperienza di 10+ anni in attività progettuali quali: IT Due diligence/ IT transformation nella valutazione del supporto fornito dall’IT al business nell’ambito dei processi di M&A; ICT Strategy per lo sviluppo della strategia tecnologica a supporto del modello operativo aziendale e del business plan; IT Integration con lo scopo di fornire metodologie e strumenti operativi nelle attività di post merger integration; Ottima conoscenza della Lingua Inglese. Make An Impact That Matters Deloitte è un network leader nei servizi professionali alle imprese, presente in oltre 150 Paesi con 457 mila professionisti. Offriamo soluzioni innovative e sostenibili in Audit & Assurance, Strategy, Risk & Transaction Advisory, Tax & Legal e Technology & Transformation. Il nostro obiettivo è supportare le aziende nello sviluppo e nell'implementazione di strategie al passo con il mercato. In Deloitte la sostenibilità è un tema centrale. Per questo, attraverso le strategie e le progettualità legate alle tematiche Environmental, Social e Governance (ESG), ci impegniamo a promuovere una crescita responsabile, sostenibile e inclusiva per il Pianeta, le nostre persone e la società. Scopri di più sulle nostre strategie di Corporate Sustainability, tra cui Well-being, la strategia volta a migliorare il benessere fisico, mentale e sociale delle nostre persone, affinché siano felici e piene di energia in tutti gli ambiti della loro vita e WorldClimate, la strategia globale di Deloitte per diventare un’organizzazione Net Zero e per guidare scelte responsabili all’interno e all’esterno dell’organizzazione. Sei pront* a #MakeAnImpactThatMatter insieme? Candidati ora! La ricerca rispetta il d.lgs. 198/2006, il D.lgs. 215/03 e il D.lgs. 216/03 ed è aperta a candidat* di qualsiasi orientamento o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso. Il presente annuncio è stato ideato nel rispetto della diversity e dell’inclusività. Adecco Italia spa, divisione Ricerca & Selezione Profili specializzati, seleziona un/una Marketing & Communication Specialist. Il nostro cliente è una strutturata realtà della zona di Cesano Maderno (MB) operante nel settore manufacturing tessile. Cerchiamo una figura dinamica, creativa e orientata ai risultati, capace di gestire progetti di marketing a 360°, integrando strategie digitali e attività tradizionali. La risorsa sarà il punto di riferimento interno per il coordinamento delle attività marketing affidate a partner e agenzie esterne, garantendo l'allineamento tra gli obiettivi aziendali, i diversi stakeholder interni e i fornitori coinvolti nei progetti di comunicazione e marketing. Immaginiamo una persona curiosa, intraprendente e con un forte spirito critico, dotata di sensibilità estetica, visione strategica e mentalità aperta e flessibile. Una figura che non si limiti a seguire i trend di mercato, ma che sappia anticiparli, interpretarli e tradurli in iniziative concrete a supporto della crescita del brand e del business. E’ gradita la provenienza da aziende operanti nel settore dei beni durevoli con una distribuzione retail strutturata. Di cosa ti occuperai: Pianificare e coordinare campagne e progetti di marketing multicanale in collaborazione con agenzie e partner esterni specializzati. Gestire i rapporti operativi con i fornitori marketing esterni, monitorando il corretto avanzamento delle attività e il rispetto delle tempistiche concordate. Collaborare con i diversi reparti aziendali per raccogliere esigenze, definire priorità e tradurle in attività da sviluppare con i partner marketing. Monitorare KPI, report e performance delle campagne, verificando l'efficacia delle azioni intraprese e identificando opportunità di miglioramento. Gestire il budget marketing e supervisionare gli investimenti dedicati alle attività di comunicazione, branding e lead generation. Coordinare progetti digitali e attività tecniche, interfacciandosi con sviluppatori, web agency e altri partner esterni. Contribuire alla pianificazione dei contenuti digitali, del sito web e delle attività di comunicazione online, garantendone coerenza con gli obiettivi aziendali. Predisporre reportistica e presentazioni periodiche sull'andamento delle iniziative marketing, condividendo risultati e proposte con il management. In this role, you will lead end-to-end product marketing strategies and content generation across key product categories, including TVs, Refrigerators, Washing Machines, Monitors, and Soundbars . You will be responsible for creating compelling category marketing materials, conducting continuous competitive benchmark analyses, driving online retail advertising initiatives, and optimizing content across official digital channels and point-of-sale (POS) environments. Key Responsibilities Product Marketing & Competitive Intelligence Category Support Materials: Develop comprehensive product marketing collaterals, product sheets, sell-in/sell-out presentation decks, and technical documentation to support category growth. Click & Mortar Digital Campaigns: Plan, execute, and monitor online advertising campaigns tailored for omni-channel retail partners (Click & Mortar), tracking ROI and analyzing sales and consumer trends. Content Creation & Trade Marketing Localized Content Production: Create engaging, tailored local content for target consumer segments, bridging online digital touchpoints and offline Point-of-Sale (POS) visual merchandising. Omnichannel Brand Consistency: Ensure messaging and product stories effectively communicate key USPs across both retail store displays and online shopper journeys. Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Management HQ Coordination: Act as the main point of contact for Global/Regional Headquarters, aligning local trade and product marketing initiatives with global brand guidelines. Agency & Partner Oversight: Manage relationships with external digital, creative, and PR agencies to deliver marketing projects on time and within scope. Budget Management: Oversee and track assigned marketing budgets for co-marketing actions, digital campaigns, and trade marketing investments. Qualifications & Requirements Experience: Minimum of 3 years of product/content marketing experience within the Consumer Electronics (CE) or Home Appliances sector. Category Knowledge: Strong familiarity with brown goods (TVs, Monitors, Audio) and/or white goods (Refrigerators, Washing Machines). Digital & E-Commerce Savvy: Proven track record in managing web page content, e-commerce assets, and retail digital advertising performance. Analytical Mindset: Proficiency in compiling comparative analyses, reading market trend reports, and managing marketing budgets. Languages: Fluent in English and Italian (both written and spoken) for daily interaction with Headquarters and local retail partners. Skills: Strong project management, agency coordination, and cross-functional communication abilities. Company Description At Docplanner Group, we’re on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. As the world’s largest healthcare platform, each month, we connect 24 million patients with 280k doctors across 13 countries (through brands like ZnanyLekarz, Doctoralia, MioDottore, DoktorTakvimi, and jameda). Our marketplaces, SaaS and AI tools simplify daily tasks and help doctors, clinics and hospitals work more efficiently, so they can focus on what really matters: caring for their patients. Learn more about our products here: pro.doctoralia.es Why join us? 📊 Real impact – We help doctors help patients. Your work truly makes a difference. 📈 At scale, yet agile – 3,000+ employees, but still fast, flexible, and hands-on. ✨ Shape the future, sustain growth – Make a difference now and build for long-term success. Job Description You'll run Docplanner's paid search activities for patients across multiple markets, including Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Chile, Italy, Spain and Poland. You'll manage a large-scale Google Ads setup with 100+ accounts, tens of thousands of campaigns and millions of keywords, working with our in-house ads engine and AI agents. Your Responsibilities Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for doctor and clinic profiles across all markets, including campaign structure, bids, budgets, keywords, negatives, ads and ad scheduling. Execute large-scale changes using Google Ads Editor, bulk uploads and scripts. Work with AI agents and automation scripts: review AI-driven changes, handle edge cases and improve automated scripts. Handle requests from country teams, including new activations, budget changes, campaign pauses and custom ads. Monitor daily pacing, cost per booking and campaign health, and act on alerts when needed. Ensure conversion tracking is accurate in collaboration with data and web teams. Manage healthcare advertising policies, certifications and ad disapprovals. Report on performance using SQL queries and dashboards. Qualifications 6+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience, including managing large, multi-account setups across several markets. Expert knowledge of Google Ads Editor and bulk campaign management. Strong experience building Google Ads scripts and/or working with the Google Ads API, including reading data, modifying scripts and debugging automation. SQL skills, with the ability to independently query a data warehouse (Redshift or similar). Experience with healthcare advertising policies and certifications. Comfortable working with automation and AI tools on a daily basis. Fluent English. Nice To Have Knowledge of Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Turkish or German. Experience building and scaling large Google Ads accounts. Experience with YouTube, Performance Max or Demand Gen. Background in a marketplace, health tech or subscription-based business. What To Expect From Our Hiring Process We like to keep things transparent and efficient! Here’s what the process usually looks like (though it might vary slightly depending on the role): 1️⃣ Intro Chat – A first call with our Talent Partner to explore mutual fit around relevant skills, value alignment, and motivation. 2️⃣ Practical assessment 3️⃣Hiring Manager Interview – A deeper conversation about your background, aspirations, and experience. Take this chance to ask anything on your mind-it’s just as much about making sure we’re the right fit for you, too. 4️⃣ Additional/ Final Interview - A final conversation with another senior leader from our Global Team. Why You’ll Love It Here 💙 Global Benefits – No matter where you are, you’ll have access to: Healthcare insurance – so you can focus on what matters. Wellness that works for you – from gym memberships to mental health support, we’ve got you covered. Time off that counts – whether it’s a vacation, your birthday, or just a day to recharge, we believe in balance. 📍 Local Perks – Depending on your location, you will be entitled to local benefits like meal vouchers (ticket restaurant), transport allowances, or extended parental leave. 🚀 Career Growth – We’re growing, and so can you! You’ll find lots of chances to learn, develop, and explore new paths—whether within your team or through cross-functional projects. 🌎 A Truly Global Team – Work with talented people from all over the world in a diverse and inclusive environment. ⏳ Flexibility That Works for You – Remote work and flexible hours aren’t just buzzwords here. While the extent of flexibility depends on your role and team, we value results over rigid schedules. Prefer an office setting? You're welcome at any of our hubs in Barcelona, Warsaw, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro, Mexico City, Bogotá, Munich, Rome or Bologna. Please note: At this time, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position. To apply, you must already have the legal right to work in your country of residence or the location of the role. What We Believe In At Docplanner, our values guide everything we do: 📊 Focus on results – we're here to make an impact. 🧠 Think like an owner – take responsibility, drive outcomes. ✂️ Keep it simple, keep it lean – smart solutions over complexity. 🔊 Be respectful and radically honest – openness builds trust. 📚 Learn and be curious – growth is part of the job. In this role, you will contribute to the end-to-end management of CRM campaigns, supporting the development of customer engagement, retention, and loyalty strategies. You will collaborate closely with the Marketing, Digital, Analytics, and Business teams to plan, implement, monitor, and optimize B2C customer communication activities. What Will You Do As a CRM B2C Specialist Manage omnichannel CRM campaigns (email, SMS, push notifications, direct messaging) from design to execution. Define market segments and target audiences based on business objectives and the customer lifecycle. Configure, schedule, and monitor campaigns and customer journeys using CRM and marketing automation platforms. Coordinate stakeholders involved in the campaign process (Marketing, Creative, Analytics, Data Team, Legal). Conduct quality checks and pre-launch tests to ensure that activities are carried out correctly. Track performance KPIs (open rate, click-through rate, conversion rate, retention, engagement) and identify opportunities for optimization. Analyze campaign results and generate periodic reports with insights and recommendations. Support A/B testing and experimentation aimed at improving performance. Contribute to the evolution of CRM processes and the automation of customer journeys. Requirements Two/three years of experience in CRM, campaign management, or marketing automation roles. Knowledge of the leading CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Braze, HubSpot, Emarsys, or equivalents). Ability to manage complex campaigns and end-to-end processes. Good knowledge of segmentation strategies, the customer lifecycle, and customer engagement. Fluency in English. The company applies the CCNL Alimentare Industria. Segnala offerta di lavoro At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: GPG Sales Manager __ In this global role, you will drive the strategy, governance, and continuous improvement of Installed Base data across our worldwide service organization. Knowing perfectly Installed Base, our products and our customers, is the starting point for any activity of Connected Care. Working at the intersection of business, analytics, and marketing, you will transform data into actionable insights that help identify growth opportunities, strengthen customer engagement, and accelerate service revenue. The location of the role is global. Working model is hybrid Your responsibilities: Own and continuously improve the global Installed Base management framework, ensuring high data quality, governance, and business accountability. Partner with local service organizations, factories, and business stakeholders. Define, monitor, and evolve key Installed Base KPIs, providing transparency into data quality, market coverage, and business performance. Lead Installed Base and customer analyses to identify service opportunities, portfolio gaps, and growth potential across markets and customer segments. Collaborate with Global Marketing and Commercial teams to support lead generation, customer targeting, and data-driven growth initiatives. Act as the global subject matter expert for Installed Base management, representing the business in cross-functional projects and driving continuous process improvements. Your background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Management, or a related field. Minimum 7 years of experience in a service business, ideally within a global industrial company, including responsibility for business-critical data, analytics, or process ownership. Experience defining KPIs, driving data quality initiatives, and translating complex datasets into business insights and recommendations. Knowledge of Salesforce (SFDC), CRM systems, Installed Base, asset management, or customer master data processes is highly desirable. Strong analytical capabilities with advanced knowledge of Excel, Power BI, and related data visualization and reporting tools; familiarity with AI-enabled analytics is a plus. Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across global, cross-functional organizations and multiple stakeholder groups. This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage. Segnala offerta di lavoro OUR STORY: 🇪🇺 Join Scaleway and shape the sovereign cloud of tomorrow ! Since 1999, we have been designing secure, sustainable infrastructures aimed at supporting the most ambitious companies. Historically known for our dedicated servers (Dedibox), we made a strategic shift to cloud computing in 2015. Staying true to our principles of simplicity, flexibility, and technical excellence, we have become one of the leading players in Europe in the sector. With the rise of artificial intelligence, we have strengthened our commitment, supported by the Iliad Group, which is investing €3 billion to develop a serious, sovereign AI alternative to American and Asian giants. Every day, thanks to our fast-growing portfolio of cloud and AI products (bare metal, containerization, serverless, AI, etc.), Scaleway proudly serves thousands of customer across the private and public sector, from corporations like France Télévisions or Hachette Livre, to fast-growing startups like Photoroom and Biolevate, to institutions like the City of Copenhagen. 📍 Our offices are located in Paris, Lille, Toulouse, Rennes, Rouen, Bordeaux and Lyon. WHY WE NEED YOU? Our growth is driving us to strengthen our Customer Success Management team to support the development of our customer portfolio in Italy and drive revenue growth across our existing accounts. Your mission will be to build strong, long-term customer relationships, maximize customer satisfaction and retention, and identify growth opportunities in order to help our customers achieve their business objectives while developing their usage and adoption of Scaleway solutions. YOUR FUTURE TEAM We work in a collaborative and international environment where the diversity of Scalers, combined with a spirit of sharing, helps bring new projects to life every day, advancing our ambitions together. You will be part of a team of 15 people, each managing their own portfolio of customers. The Customer Success organization covers different customer segments, including startup & low touch, mid-market, enterprise, and international accounts. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Solution Architects, Support and Product teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and execute customer-specific success plans. YOUR DAILY ROUTINE Build, nurture, and leverage strong relationships with customer users and decision-makers Understand your customers’ businesses, objectives, and data to identify opportunities to increase satisfaction and revenue Define and proactively follow customer-specific success plans to maximize satisfaction and minimize churn Drive customer awareness and adoption of Scaleway services, features, and functionalities Identify, negotiate, and close upsell, cross-sell, commitment, and renewal opportunities Act as an escalation point and coordinate Sales, Solution Architects, Support, and Product teams around customer needs Represent the voice of the customer internally, sharing feedback and contributing insights to Scaleway's product roadmap Measure customer satisfaction and maintain accurate customer information and reporting in the relevant systems Build and deliver customer engagement initiatives through training sessions, webinars, user forums, events, and Scaleway communities Contribute to improving Customer Success processes and ways of working as the team continues to scale HARDSKILLS: You have 5 to 10 years of professional experience, ideally in Customer Success, account management, or another customer-facing role within a technology environment You have a solid understanding of the cloud industry and ecosystem, including its competitive landscape and emerging trends in Cloud and AI You are comfortable engaging in technical conversations and have the curiosity and ability to deepen your knowledge of cloud solutions. An engineering background combined with commercial skills, or commercial experience within a cloud provider, hyperscaler, or partner, would be particularly relevant You have demonstrated business acumen and experience identifying and managing revenue opportunities across a portfolio of customer accounts You are data-driven and comfortable with reporting and customer management tools. The team notably works with Salesforce, Metabase, and Slack SOFTSKILLS: Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with customers Strong listening skills and empathy, allowing you to understand customer needs before proposing solutions A proactive and autonomous mindset, with the ability to navigate uncertainty and improve existing processes Strong organizational and project management skills, with attention to detail and transparent reporting A “learn-it-all” mentality, combining curiosity for business and technology with the ability to mobilize internal teams around shared objectives WHAT YOU WILL FIND AT SCALEWAY ++++ Hybrid work: We offer up to 3 days of remote work per week. International environment: With dozens of nationalities, Scaleway offers a stimulating environment where English is as widely spoken as French. Career & Mobility: Our managers value internal mobility, and opportunities to transition to other entities within the Iliad Group are accessible to all Scalers. 🚀Why join the Scaleway adventure? ✔ A rich and diverse product offering: Scaleway offers over 100 public cloud products in IaaS, PaaS, and AI. ✔ A cutting-edge technical environment: Scaleway provides modern infrastructures, including high-performance bare metal servers, to tackle exciting technical challenges. ✔ Commitment to responsible cloud: Scaleway is dedicated to a more responsible cloud, with data centers powered solely by renewable energy since 2017, minimizing our ecological footprint and holding top-level certification. Livello retribuzione di base 60.000,00 €/yr - 70.000,00 €/anno LHH ricerca, per conto di un'importante realtà multinazionale caratterizzata da una forte presenza internazionale e da un articolato percorso di trasformazione HR, un/una HRIS Manager ( Work day) La figura entrerà nella funzione HR e avrà la responsabilità di guidare l'evoluzione dei sistemi HR a livello europeo, garantendo l'armonizzazione dei processi, la qualità del dato e il pieno utilizzo delle potenzialità offerte dalla piattaforma Workday. La risorsa agirà come punto di riferimento per Workday ( necessaria esperienza pregressa) , supportando la standardizzazione dei processi HR, la definizione di nuovi flussi organizzativi e l'implementazione di soluzioni innovative orientate a migliorare l'esperienza dei dipendenti e la qualità delle decisioni basate sui dati. Responsibilities Il ruolo richiede una forte combinazione di competenze progettuali, di processo, analitiche e di stakeholder management: Gestire e sviluppare la piattaforma Workday a livello europeo, garantendone il corretto funzionamento e la continua evoluzione. Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti provenienti dalle diverse funzioni HR e tradurli in soluzioni funzionali e organizzative. Governare gli aggiornamenti periodici di Workday, valutandone gli impatti sui processi aziendali. Collaborare con team IT interni e partner esterni per sviluppi evolutivi, integrazioni e attività di manutenzione Guidare iniziative di standardizzazione e armonizzazione dei processi HR nei diversi Paesi europei. Disegnare e ottimizzare processi end-to-end relativi a Talent Management, Performance Management, Compensation & Benefits, Organizational Management e Workforce Planning. Definire e sviluppare una strategia integrata di HR Data Management. Creare e governare dataset HR globali a supporto delle decisioni strategiche. Sviluppare dashboard, KPI e reportistica avanzata destinata al management e alle funzioni HR. Analizzare trend relativi a turnover, performance, compensation, retention e talent management. Guidare attività di formazione, comunicazione e change management connesse all'introduzione di nuovi processi e funzionalità. Affiancare stakeholder locali e regionali durante le fasi di implementazione e adozione dei sistemi. Your Profile Verranno prese in considerazione figure in possesso dei seguenti requisiti: Laurea in Economia, Ingegneria Gestionale, Matematica o discipline affini. Esperienza di almeno 5-8 anni in ruoli HRIS, HR Reward, HR Transformation o HR Operations Excellence. Solida conoscenza della piattaforma Workday; eventuali certificazioni costituiranno titolo preferenziale. Esperienza nella gestione di progetti internazionali e stakeholder multicountry. Conoscenza approfondita dei processi HR end-to-end. Forte esperienza nella strutturazione, revisione e ottimizzazione dei processi HR. Consolidata esperienza nell'HR Reporting e nell'analisi dei dati. Ottima conoscenza dei principali strumenti di Business Intelligence e Analytics. Inglese fluente; la quotidianità del ruolo si svolge in un contesto internazionale. Ilaria Rossi Ilaria Rossi Duplomatic Group opera in un contesto industriale multinazionale con più entità e sistemi ERP eterogenei, in parte legacy. Il Gruppo ha avviato un percorso strutturato di razionalizzazione degli ERP e di creazione di una Corporate Data Platform in cloud come fondazione per reporting, analisi e decision-making a livello di Gruppo. Consapevole che il successo dei progetti di trasformazione risiede nella centralità della governance interna su dati e processi, il Gruppo punta a rafforzare la propria autonomia strategica e il perfetto allineamento con le esigenze di business. Per guidare questa evoluzione, ci hanno incaricati di selezionare un/a Data & ERP Integration Manager La persona selezionata, riportando al Global CIO, governerà i progetti di integrazione e consolidamento ERP del Gruppo attraverso una profonda comprensione dei processi aziendali e del ciclo di vita del dato. Lavorerà direttamente su analisi, progettazione e implementazione, con un approccio fortemente hands-on orientato alla realizzazione concreta di una piattaforma lakehouse corporate a supporto del reporting e delle decisioni strategiche. Si occuperà di mappare i flussi aziendali cross-stabilimento con approccio greenfield, superando la frammentazione della reportistica storica e innalzando gli standard di Data Quality e l’affidabilità del numero. Implementerà un Data Abstraction Layer sovrapposto ai gestionali legacy, volto a raccordare e armonizzare i processi del Gruppo. Realizzerà e gestirà la nuova Corporate Data Platform in cloud basata su Microsoft Fabric, unificando la raccolta e l'elaborazione delle informazioni in un unico data lake logico. Questa architettura consentirà la misurazione delle metriche rilevanti in tempo reale tramite Power BI e/o Power Apps, abilitando un reporting direzionale moderno a supporto delle decisioni strategiche di Gruppo. Attività: Analisi del Data Lineage e modellazione dei flussi informativi cross-funzionali per tracciare l'origine delle informazioni, garantendo l'applicazione di standard univoci di Data Quality interfacciandosi direttamente con i Process Owner di stabilimento; Integrazione end-to-end dei processi core aziendali (OTC, P2P, P2M, R2R) tramite la progettazione dei flussi informativi per la gestione integrata di ordini, approvvigionamenti, avanzamento produzione, magazzino e chiusure contabili; Standardizzazione e armonizzazione cross-processo mediante la definizione delle regole di data mapping e trasformazione per garantire la quadratura dei dati economico-finanziari e operativi tra i vari stabilimenti e i gestionali di origine; Formalizzazione dei modelli concettuali e logici dell'architettura informativa, mappando i cicli di vita delle entità e le regole di trasformazione all'interno della struttura applicativa aziendale; Definizione del Data Abstraction Layer (Data Foundation / Repository Cloud) per l'estrazione e il disaccoppiamento dei dati dai gestionali legacy; Creazione di pipeline ETL/ELT tramite Data Factory per connettere i vari database sorgente ed estrarre i dati nell'architettura unificata OneLake; Ingegnerizzazione di grandi volumi di dati in ambiente Microsoft Fabric, implementando logiche di trasformazione ed elaborazione in formato aperto Parquet per migliorare l’interoperabilità e facilitare il raggiungimento delle performance; Sviluppo di modelli semantici e dashboard in Power BI e/o Power Apps in modalità Direct Lake, consentendo l'analisi immediata e in tempo reale dei dati senza duplicazione; Evoluzione della reportistica aziendale verso un modello unico di Business Intelligence a supporto del Top Management e delle funzioni aziendali di Gruppo; Governance del progetto e affiancamento ai vendor esterni per accelerare e velocizzare i tempi di rilascio; Redazione della documentazione tecnica, promuovendo la cultura dell'affidabilità del dato in azienda. Requisiti: Diploma o laurea in materie scientifiche / ingegneria con solida conoscenza dei processi industriali; Provenienza dal mondo della consulenza o da contesti aziendali interni di realtà produttive/manifatturiere complesse; Specializzazione in Data Architecture con approccio hands-on, dall'architettura strategica del dato all’implementazione e testing delle soluzioni su ecosistema Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Delta Parquet, Direct Lake); Solido orientamento alla realizzazione di query SQL, pipeline ETL/ELT e modellazione di database relazionali e data warehouse/lakehouse; Padronanza di Power BI per l'analisi avanzata e la strutturazione del reporting direzionale: la conoscenza di Power Apps e della Microsoft Power Platform costituisce un importante elemento preferenziale; Spiccata attenzione ai temi di Data Quality, accuratezza dell'informazione e capacità relazionali per interfacciarsi con interlocutori internazionali, responsabili di stabilimento, manager locali e vendor esterni. Acting as the key connection between site leadership, local and global Digital teams, Engineering, Automation, Quality and external service providers, you will ensure that digital solutions support business priorities while meeting Opella’s quality, cybersecurity and EHS requirements. You will translate site needs into a clear digital roadmap, secure the resources required for implementation and oversee projects that strengthen operational performance, business continuity and compliance. You will also contribute to budget and strategic planning discussions, ensuring that the site’s digital priorities are appropriately represented, funded and aligned with Opella’s global standards. Main Responsibilities Define and deliver the Digital Site Master Plan, aligning site priorities, timelines, budgets and resources with business needs and global digital strategies. Lead digital, data and technology projects for the site, applying consistent project management and delivery methodologies. Manage the site’s digital budget and contribute to strategic planning discussions with the Site Leadership Team. Act as the main point of contact for digital services, building effective relationships with site users, global Digital teams and external service providers. Oversee the site’s cybersecurity, digital risk management and business continuity activities, including disaster recovery planning, KPI monitoring and remediation actions. Maintain oversight of the site’s computerized systems inventory and architecture, identifying systems affected by global standardization and developing transition or retirement plans. Partner with Engineering, Automation and Quality to assess digital risks, support audits and inspections, and ensure that computerized systems comply with applicable quality and security requirements. Ensure that infrastructure standards and new technology releases are effectively communicated, implemented and adopted across the site. Promote the effective use of existing applications and configure global solutions for local needs when appropriate, including business intelligence and KPI reporting tools. Identify the capabilities, skills and critical positions required to support the site’s evolving digital needs. About You You have relevant experience in digital transformation, information systems, operational excellence, process improvement or technology-enabled business transformation within pharmaceutical manufacturing, consumer healthcare, consumer goods or a consulting environment. You understand manufacturing operations and key processes across areas such as supply chain, production, engineering, automation and quality. You have successfully led complex digital, data or technology transformation projects in a cross-functional environment. You are comfortable working hands-on and exploring technical issues, including learning new technologies when required. You combine strong analytical and business acumen with a structured, results-oriented approach and the ability to manage multiple priorities. You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders and build productive relationships across functions and organizational levels. You hold a degree in Computer Engineering or another relevant technical discipline, an IT qualification, or equivalent professional experience in information systems. You are fluent in Italian and English. Knowledge of French would be an advantage. This is more than the next step in your career, it’s a chance to lead change and help reinvent self-care for the world. If you’re ready to challenge, inspire and deliver impact that matters, we’re ready for you. We are challengers. We are Opella. Location: Origgio Production Plant Hybrid working policy: 1 day remote working per week About Us Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the global Over-the-Counter and Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements market. Our mission is to bring health into people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. Our portfolio includes 100 loved brands, supported by an 11,000-strong global team, 13 manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the company behind brands including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are committed to contributing to healthier people and a healthier planet. Learn more at Opella.com. Opella values diversity in all its forms and is committed to fostering a workplace where everyone can belong and excel. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. Per il team di Knowledge Management & Legal Tech , operante all'intersezione tra diritto, tecnologia e intelligenza artificiale , cerchiamo una/un Legal Tech & AI Lead . Il Legal Tech & AI Lead è un membro chiave e strategico del team in quanto guiderà lo sviluppo di soluzioni AI per i professionisti e per le funzioni di supporto dello Studio. Coordinerà un team di specialisti e partner esterni, trasformando la strategia AI dello Studio in progetti concreti, sicuri e utilizzati. Principali responsabilità Guida dei progetti Definire priorità e pianificazione dei progetti di sviluppo. Garantire la consegna nei tempi e con la qualità attesa. Misurare utilizzo e impatto delle soluzioni e riportarne i risultati. Team e fornitori Guidare e far crescere un team di specialisti. Coordinare i partner esterni e gestire le relazioni con i fornitori di tecnologia. Collaborare con la funzione IT e con i team di adoption per l'introduzione delle nuove soluzioni. Innovazione Monitorare il mercato legal tech e AI e proporre azioni strategiche. Identificare nuove opportunità per migliorare i processi dello Studio. Valutare se sviluppare internamente o acquistare soluzioni di mercato. Governance e sicurezza dell'AI Gestire il profilo di rischio delle soluzioni AI, in collaborazione con IT e Data Protection. Garantire il rispetto della normativa e delle policy interne. Supportare lo Studio nelle richieste dei clienti su sicurezza e compliance AI. Requisiti Laurea magistrale in Giurisprudenza, Ingegneria, Informatica o Economia. 8-10 anni di esperienza, di cui almeno 4 nella guida di progetti tecnologici in studi professionali di primario standing, società di consulenza o vendor legal tech. Esperienza diretta e recente con l'AI generativa, con progetti portati in produzione. Esperienza nella guida di team e nella gestione di fornitori di tecnologia. Solida cultura tecnica, anche senza essere sviluppatore. Conoscenza delle soluzioni di AI per il settore legale e dei temi di governance, protezione dei dati e sicurezza. Metodo di project management strutturato. Ottime capacità di comunicazione e relazione, anche con i Soci. Ottima padronanza dell'inglese, sia scritto che parlato. Segnala offerta di lavoro About Us Satispay began by rethinking the simple act of a payment to remove the friction from our daily routines. But we didn’t stop there. Today, we are building a complete financial platform designed to empower people and concretely improve their lives. By giving our 6 million users a clear, open path to pay, save, and invest, we are evolving into the definitive destination for every financial need. What You'll Be Doing As our Product Lead – Business Domain , you’ll drive the evolution of our Business ecosystem and the products supporting the financial needs of companies. In this role, you will lead a team of business domain PMs while remaining directly hands-on with execution. This position requires a rare blend of product delivery, strategic leadership, and a powerful growth mindset to thrive in complexity, raise quality benchmarks, and continuously build product experiences that drive commercial success. Here's What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like Product Leadership & Execution – Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, taking products from initial idea to launch. Grow Your Team – Coach and mentor Product Managers, set the quality bar, and help each person level up. Set the Direction – Define the roadmap, design frictionless experiences, and ship high-impact features that make a difference. Bring Everyone Along – Align product, tech, business, and regulatory teams around one shared vision. Business & Customer Understanding – Develop a deep understanding of businesses' financial needs, market dynamics, and competitive landscape, translating customer and market insights into product opportunities. User-Centricity – Put merchants first by obsessing over user feedback, conducting continuous shadowing, and transforming pain points into seamless opportunities. Data-Driven Decision Making – Define, track, and analyze key product metrics to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and relentlessly optimize funnel performance. What We Are Looking For We need a problem-solver who loves teamwork and gets things done. If you're curious and ready for real ownership, you'll fit in! Does this sound like you? People Management – You have managed Product Managers and helped them grow. Regulated Environments – You have built products in banking, payments, fintech, or other regulated financial services or high-growth tech environments. Complexity at Scale – You have led complex projects with many stakeholders across organizational and technical boundaries. Commercial Acumen / Growth Mindset – A strong business sense with an understanding of how to leverage product experiences to drive monetization, acquisition, and merchant engagement. Obsession with Detail – High standards with a sharp eye for UX/UI details, copy, and operational excellence to constantly raise the bar. Analytical Power – A deeply data-driven mindset with experience using advanced data platforms to track metrics, optimize funnels, and turn raw data into actionable strategic growth insights. AI-Empowered Product Management – Strong AI fluency with the ability to integrate AI tools into daily workflows to accelerate product operations, research synthesis, and roadmap structuring. CareAbout: how we support your impact About We move fast, and evolution never stops. It's a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we're committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That's why we created CareAbout: ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops) 💰 Financial resources (Stock Option Plan, Meal vouchers, Relocation support if you're moving countries) ⚙️ Growth and development (Professional development programs, Internal mobility, Language courses with Preply) 🌱 Flexibility (Unlimited PTO, Hybrid working policy*, Flexible working hours) 👨‍👩‍👧 Family (Enhanced parental leave, Additional leave for child sickness) We embrace two days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday), with the option to request extra remote time. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value. Segnala offerta di lavoro Stema ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Stema. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 75.000,00 €/yr - 90.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Stema Mirko Saitta Mirko Saitta Azienda: Stema Il nostro cliente è una boutique di consulenza in crescita con sede a Milano. Progetta e costruisce prodotti digitali, piattaforme e nuove venture per organizzazioni che vogliono trasformarsi. Lavora su sistemi complessi in contesti industriali, energy e navale, unendo rigore ingegneristico e velocità di esecuzione. Per rafforzare il team cerca un Manager che guidi i progetti come project leader. Il ruolo Guiderai come project leader progetti di consulenza operativa che intervengono sul core di aziende industriali, gestendone l'esecuzione end-to-end e restando la figura di riferimento sul contenuto dei singoli progetti. Cosa farai Gestirai 2-3 progetti in parallelo come owner, presidiando in prima persona il contenuto tecnico di ciascuno. Interverrai sui processi, sulle operations e sulla trasformazione digitale del cliente industriale, occupandoti direttamente dell'analisi e dei contenuti concreti del progetto. Coordinerai team snelli composti da figure junior, facendo da riferimento tecnico e mandando avanti il progetto senza delegarne il cuore. Presidierai la relazione con il cliente durante l'esecuzione, sviluppando prospecting e business development sui progetti in corso. Affronterai commesse eterogenee — strategiche, di trasformazione digitale, di project management — adattando l'approccio al singolo contesto. Contesto tecnico Dominio: consulenza operativa su processi, operations e trasformazione digitale in contesti industriali e manifatturieri. Modello di lavoro: squadre snelle (senior project leader + junior), con persone multi-cliente e nessun assetto resident. Ambiente organizzativo: cultura non gerarchica, leadership per autorevolezza e professionisti autogestiti. Scala: progetti ad alto contenuto tecnico per medie e grandi imprese. Chi cerchiamo Requisiti essenziali Almeno tre anni di esperienza in società di consulenza, su progetti operativi che toccano il core dell'azienda cliente (processi, trasformazione, operations) e non prevalentemente regolatori o di compliance. Esperienza su progetti per aziende in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, con familiarità con ambienti di produzione e logistica. Track record nella gestione di progetti come owner end-to-end, in team piccoli, restando hands-on sul contenuto senza delegare la parte analitica. Laurea in ingegneria (preferibilmente gestionale) con voto minimo 105, oppure in economia con voto 110. Conoscenza dell'italiano e dell'inglese a livello professionale per l'uso in ambito lavorativo. Requisiti preferenziali Esperienza su progetti di trasformazione digitale su processi, operations e knowledge management. Esperienza nell'affiancare figure junior come riferimento tecnico, con un approccio alla leadership basato sull'autorevolezza e non sull'imposizione gerarchica. Esposizione a progetti di tipologie diverse (strategia, trasformazione, project management), senza specializzazione su un unico filone. Cosa offriamo Sede: Milano. Modalità di lavoro: prevalentemente in sede quando non si è dal cliente, con smart working possibile e forte autogestione (indicativamente 2-3 giorni in ufficio nelle settimane più cariche). Trasferte: spostamenti in giornata circa un paio di volte a settimana; notti fuori rarissime. Percorso di crescita strutturato verso ruoli di Director, con inquadramento da quadro e prospettiva di passaggio a dirigente. Pacchetto retributivo: total comp tra 75 e 90k€ (RAL fissa + variabile + rimborso spese di trasferta. We are seeking a Director of Product Development, Southern Europe to lead the AI evolution of our Human Capital Management (HCM) and Payroll solutions across Italy, Spain, and Portugal. This senior leadership role combines technology leadership, product development excellence, and organizational leadership to deliver innovative solutions that address the unique needs of our clients. A key focus of this role is driving the next generation of AI-powered experiences, transforming how HR professionals, payroll administrators, managers, and employees interact with our products. The successful candidate will lead the teams responsible for turning AI opportunities into scalable, secure, and impactful product capabilities. Key Responsibilities Lead Product Development Team Build, coach, and develop high-performing AI Enablement team. Partner closely with Product Management, UX, Data Science, AI CoE and regional business leaders to ensure successful delivery and adoption. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, technical excellence, and customer obsession. Establish modern engineering practices that maximize quality, velocity, reliability, and security. Drive AI-First Product Experiences Define and execute the regional vision for AI-enabled experiences across Payroll, HR, Workforce Management, Talent, and Employee Engagement solutions. Lead the delivery of intelligent assistants, copilots, workflow automation, predictive insights, and agentic AI capabilities. Identify opportunities where AI can eliminate friction, reduce manual effort, improve decision-making, and create differentiated customer value. Establish measurable outcomes and success metrics for all AI investments. Influence Global Strategy Represent Southern European AI priorities within global product and technology forums. Advocate for regional needs while leveraging global platform investments and capabilities. Share innovation, best practices, and successful AI patterns across the broader organization. Serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives on AI strategy, technology innovation, and product development. Qualifications 10+ years of experience in Product Development, Software Engineering, Product Management, or Technology Leadership roles. Experience within Payroll, HCM, HR Technology, ERP, FinTech, or other highly regulated industries is a strong advantage. Demonstrated success delivering customer-facing AI capabilities and AI-enabled products at scale. Strong understanding of modern software architectures, cloud platforms, APIs, data platforms, and AI technologies. Experience operating in complex, global, and matrixed organizations. Strong commercial acumen and the ability to connect technology investments to measurable business outcomes. Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills. Fluent in English; Italian and/or Spanish is a strong advantage. What Success Looks Like Within The First 12 Months, This Leader Will Build and establish a focused AI Enablement team with clear ownership, strong engineering practices, and measurable business outcomes. Deliver a continuous stream of AI-powered capabilities across Southern European Payroll and HCM solutions. Launch AI experiences that measurably improve user productivity, compliance, and user satisfaction. Accelerate the adoption of AI-assisted development practices, improving both engineering efficiency and delivery speed. Position Southern Europe as a strategic innovation hub for AI-powered HR and Payroll solutions. In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. Gli esperti di Nolan Norton , società di IT Strategy del Network KPMG, aiutano le organizzazioni ad affrontare le sfide di trasformazione digitale e ad implementare architetture IT. In particolare, entrerai a far parte del Team CIO Advisory di Milano, esperto di architetture e soluzioni di data management che supporta i CIO nell'evoluzione digitale del loro percorso, nel loro journey verso il cloud, dalla strategia all'esecuzione e dalla visione al valore reale. Entrerai a far parte di un ambiente dinamico e stimolante, per clienti di alto livello altamente visibili nei mercati dei servizi finanziari, dell'energia, del settore pubblico e dei consumatori e industriali. Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche Sei il candidato ideale se hai interesse a lavorare sulla sede di MILANOe hai maturato 6-10 anni di esperienza in società di consulenza o in contesti aziendali fortemente orientati all'innovazione tecnologica. Per essere il candidato ideale devi aver avuto esperiente significative in almeno uno dei seguenti ambiti: IT STRATEGY definizione di strategie ICT: redazione di piani di sistemi e piani strategici ICT, valutazioni di business case e case for change di iniziative IT complesse, con focus sugli ambiti infrastrutturali e cloud IT ARCHITECTURE E CLOUD, capacità di definire il landscape infrastrutturale anche in ottica cloud, strategie di migrazione al Cloud e conoscenza delle principali soluzioni in ambito. IT INFRASTRUCTURE Capacità nel disegno di infrastrutture complesse e valutazione delle soluzioni di alta affidabilità e Disaster Recovery. Conoscenza delle principali soluzioni IT Operations. IT TELCO. Capacità nel disegno ad alto livello di soluzioni di connettività e valutazione delle stesse rispetto agli ambiti di evoluzione o gestione. IT SOURCING capacità di gestione di gare IT complesse, supporto alla valutazione strategica dell’investimento con modelli di valutazione e business case relativamente all’approvvigionamento di soluzioni tecnologiche, come Datacenter, TLC, Servizi di gestione IT. IT PROCESSES Analisi e disegno di processi IT di trasformazione digitale secondo le metodologie di ITIL Ulteriori aspetti che ti qualificano come il candidato ideale sono: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Elettronica, Gestionale o affini Ottima e comprovata conoscenza della lingua inglese, Buone doti comunicative e relazionali con possibilità di presidio di tavoli internazionali Utilizzo avanzato di software quali: MS Excel, MS Powerpoint, Power BI o similari Forte orientamento agli obiettivi e attitudine al problem solving Disponibilità a frequenti viaggi e trasferte Certificazioni di IT Service Management (ITIL) o altre (SAFe, , ServiceNow etc.) Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico Inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio, RAL indicativa compresa tra € 52.000 e € 65.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi con riferimento specifico alle competenze e all’esperienza del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione. At KPMG, you will have the opportunity to help clients, society, and your colleagues tackle and solve the most current and complex challenges. The experts at Nolan Norton, KPMG’s IT Strategy firm, help organizations face digital transformation challenges and implement IT architectures. Specifically, you will join the CIO Advisory Team in Milan, which specializes in architectures and data management solutions, supporting CIOs in their digital transformation journey toward the cloud—from strategy to execution, and from vision to real value. You will be part of a dynamic and stimulating environment, working with high-profile clients in the financial services, energy, public sector, and consumer and industrial markets. Come As You Are – Your Skills And Qualities You are the ideal candidate if you are interested in working in MILAN and have 6–10 years of experience in consulting firms or in companies strongly focused on technological innovation. To be the ideal candidate, you should have significant experience in at least one of the following areas: IT STRATEGY: Defining ICT strategies, drafting system and strategic ICT plans, evaluating business cases and case-for-change for complex IT initiatives, with a focus on infrastructure and cloud. IT ARCHITECTURE AND CLOUD: Ability to define infrastructure landscapes with a cloud perspective, cloud migration strategies, and knowledge of major solutions in the field. IT INFRASTRUCTURE: Designing complex infrastructures and evaluating high-availability and disaster recovery solutions. Knowledge of major IT operations solutions. IT TELCO: High-level design of connectivity solutions and evaluation in terms of evolution or management. IT SOURCING: Managing complex IT tenders, supporting strategic investment evaluations with assessment models and business cases for procuring technology solutions such as data centers, telecommunications, and IT management services. IT PROCESSES: Analyzing and designing IT processes for digital transformation using ITIL methodologies. Additional qualifications that make you the ideal candidate include: Degree in Computer, Electronic, Management Engineering, or related fields Excellent and proven knowledge of English Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to participate in international meetings Advanced use of software such as MS Excel, MS PowerPoint, Power BI, or similar Strong goal orientation and problem-solving attitude Willingness to travel frequently IT Service Management certifications (ITIL) or others (SAFe, ServiceNow, etc.) Your Future With Us – What You’ll Find at KPMG An inclusive, fair work environment that respects, encourages, and values diversity A stimulating and dynamic context that fosters creativity and teamwork Hybrid work model to promote a healthy work-life balance Advanced training and development programs to stay up to date International mindset and innovative projects Initiatives focused on physical and mental well-being Standard employment contract under the collective labour agreement for the commerce sector, with a starting gross annual salary ranging from €52,000 to €65,000. The salary is determined on the basis of objective criteria, including the candidate’s skills and experience assessed against the requirements of the role. The role combines technical leadership, people management, and operational governance, with a strong focus on building efficient, secure, and scalable software delivery practices. The successful candidate will manage a team of approximately 15 DevOps engineers operating across multiple countries, working closely with software development, cloud infrastructure, and architecture teams to improve engineering standards and ensure reliable application delivery. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Management Lead and develop an international team of DevOps engineers, ensuring effective collaboration across different locations and cultures. Define team priorities, individual objectives, and performance indicators in line with business and technology goals. Manage resource allocation, workload distribution, professional development, and performance evaluation. Foster a culture of accountability, technical excellence, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing. Contribute to talent acquisition and the long-term development of engineering capabilities. DevOps Strategy & Engineering Practices Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of DevOps and DevSecOps methodologies. Establish consistent standards for software integration, automated testing, deployment, and release management. Promote infrastructure automation and configuration management to improve operational efficiency. Support the adoption of modern deployment approaches, version control practices, and engineering workflows. Identify opportunities to streamline delivery processes, address technical debt, and reduce manual activities. Encourage collaboration between engineering teams through shared practices and technical communities. Cloud Operations & Reliability Oversee operational practices supporting the availability, performance, and reliability of cloud-hosted applications. Work alongside infrastructure architects, development teams, and other technology stakeholders to improve delivery processes. Support the implementation of monitoring, logging, and observability solutions. Coordinate operational support arrangements for business-critical systems, including 24/7 coverage requirements. Ensure alignment with internal security policies, compliance standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. Governance & Continuous Improvement Define and monitor operational KPIs to assess team effectiveness and software delivery performance. Provide visibility on engineering initiatives, operational risks, and improvement opportunities to senior IT management. Support organizational transformation initiatives and the adoption of standardized engineering processes. Contribute to project planning, prioritization, and the effective management of technical resources. Required Experience & Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent professional experience. Previous technical background in software development, DevOps engineering, or related disciplines. At least 3–5 years of direct people management experience, ideally leading international or geographically distributed engineering teams. Strong understanding of CI/CD processes, infrastructure automation, cloud operations, and modern software delivery practices. Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git, PowerShell, and Azure DevOps. Knowledge of deployment methodologies, including Blue/Green and Canary releases, branching strategies, and feature management practices. Experience with monitoring and observability solutions such as Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, or Azure Application Insights. Understanding of Agile methodologies and structured project management approaches. Proven ability to define team objectives, manage performance, and implement measurable operational improvements. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills. Ability to operate effectively within a complex, multicultural, and international business environment. What Makes This Opportunity Interesting Leadership of an established, internationally distributed DevOps engineering team. Direct involvement in the evolution of enterprise-scale cloud application delivery. Opportunity to influence engineering methodologies, automation strategies, and operational standards. Exposure to a complex international technology environment with multiple stakeholders. A role combining strategic responsibilities, technical understanding, and people leadership. La figura ricercata sarà il collegamento tra proprietà, consulenti agronomici, personale stagionale e fornitori locali. Principali responsabilità: Pianificare e coordinare tutte le attività di vigneto Gestire potatura secca e verde, legature, sfogliature e trattamenti Pianificare e gestire la vendemmia Monitorare lo stato fitosanitario delle vigne Organizzare e supervisionare le squadre operative, garantendo il corretto utilizzo di attrezzature e mezzi agricoli Assicurare il rispetto degli standard qualitativi aziendali Il profilo/requisiti: Passione autentica per vino e agricoltura, esperienza consolidata nella gestione di vigneti e personale agricolo, ottima conoscenza delle pratiche agronomiche, autonomia organizzativa e leadership. Stiamo cercando una persona che voglia vivere un'autentica esperienza professionale e personale, un progetto capace di rappresentare un vero change life moment.
